1: # 中断系统适配指南
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../en/chip_porting/Interrupt_System_Adaptation_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、实现芯片中断调试
6: 
7: 在调试芯片中断子系统（`bringup`）时，厂商需要实现一系列与架构相关的函数（`arch` 函数），以完成以下任务：
8: 
9: - 初始化中断
10: - 启用和禁用中断
11: - 设置中断优先级
12: 
13: 以下内容提供了具体的要求和实现示例。
14: 
15: ### 1、需要实现的中断相关函数
16: 
17: 以下是厂商（ Vendor）需要实现的中断相关函数及其功能说明。
18: 
19: 1. 初始化中断系统，包括禁用所有中断、配置向量表位置、设置默认优先级以及启用中断。
20: 
21:     ```C
22:     void up_irqinitialize(void)
23:     {
24:         // Disable all interrupts
25:         // Set the NVIC vector location
26:         // Set all interrupts (and exceptions) to the default priority
27:         // Attach the SVCall and Hard Fault exception handlers
28:         // enable interrupts
29:     }
30:     ```
31: 
32: 2. 启用指定中断。
33: 
34:     ```C
35:     void up_enable_irq(int irq)
36:     {
37:         //enable interrupt with irq
38:     }
39:       ```
40: 
41: 3. 禁用指定的中断号。
42: 
43:     ```C
44:     void up_disable_irq(int irq)
45:     {
46:         //disable interrupt with irq
47:     }
48:     ```
49: 
50: 4. 设置中断优先级。 如果启用了 `CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO` 配置，则需要实现以下函数：
51: 
52:     ```C
53:     #ifdef CONFIG_ARCH_IRQPRIO
54:     int up_prioritize_irq(int irq, int priority)
55:     {
56:         // set irq priority
57:     }
58:     #endif
59:     ```
60: 
61: 5. 管理中断状态。
62: 
63:     - 判断 `flags` 当前是否是关中断状态。
64: 
65:         ```C
66:         #define up_irq_is_disabled(flags)
67:         ```
68: 
69:     - 保存当前中断状态并关闭中断。
70: 
71:         ```C
72:         // 关中断
73:         irqstate_t up_irq_save(void)
74:         {
75:         }
76:         ```
77: 
78:     - 恢复指定中断状态。
79: 
80:         ```C
81:         // 恢复flags表示的中断状态
82:         void up_irq_restore(irqstate_t flags)
83:         {
84:         }
85:         ```
86: 
87:     - 开启所有中断。
88: 
89:         ```C
90:         // 开启所有中断
91:         irqstate_t up_irq_enable(void)
92:         {
93:         }
94:         ```
95: 
96:     - 获取当前中断状态。
97: 
98:         ```C
99:         // 获取当前中断状态
100:         irqstate_t irqstate(void)
101:         {
102:         }
103:         ```
104: 
105: 6. 处理核间中断：
106: 
107:     ```C
108:     // 发起核间中断
109:     void up_trigger_irq(int irq, cpu_set_t cpuset)
110:     ```
111: 
112: 7. 设置中断的安全属性。
113: 
114:     - 设置指定中断的安全属性。
115: 
116:         ```C
117:         // 设置中断安全属性
118:         void up_secure_irq(int irq, bool secure)
119:         ```
120: 
121:     - 改变所有中断的安全属性。
122: 
123:         ```C
124:         // 改变所有中断安全属性
125:         void up_secure_irq_all(bool secure)
126:         ```
127: 
128: ### 2、需要定义的中断相关宏
129: 
130: 除上面的函数实现，厂商还需定义一系列中断相关的宏，用于描述 NVIC（Nested vectored interrupt controller） 的配置，这些宏需定义在`chips/chip_name/include/irq.h` 文件中。可参考 [RTL8720C 示例](../../../../../nuttx/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/arch/arm/src/rtl8720c/include/irq.h)。
131: 
132: 以下是必须实现的宏及其功能说明：
133: 
134: 1. 第一个中断向量号。
135: 
136:     ```C
137:     #define NVIC_IRQ_FIRST  (16)   /* Vector number of the first interrupt */
138:     ```
139: 
140: 2. 中断数量。
141: 
142:     ```C
143:     #define NR_IRQS (64)
144:     ```
145: 
146: 3. NVIC 优先级级别。
147: 
148:     - 最低优先级
149: 
150:         ```C
151:         #define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MIN  0xff /* All bits set in minimum priority */
152:         ```
153: 
154:     - 默认优先级
155: 
156:         ```C
157:         #define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_DEFAULT  0x40 /* Midpoint is the default */
158:         ```
159: 
160:     - 最高优先级
161: 
162:         ```C
163:         #define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_MAX   0x00 /* Zero is maximum priority */
164:         ```
165: 
166:     - 优先级步长
167: 
168:         ```C
169:         #define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_STEP 0x40 /* Three bits priority used, bits[7-6] as group */
170:         ```
171: 
172:     - 子优先级步长
173: 
174:         ```C
175:         #define NVIC_SYSH_PRIORITY_SUBSTEP  0x20 /* Three bits priority used, bit[5] as sub */
176:         ```
177: 
178: ## 二、中断绑定处理函数
179: 
180: 在中断处理过程中，可以通过以下三种方式绑定处理函数。每种方式适用于不同场景，具有各自的优缺点。
181: 
182: ### 1、使用`irq_attach`
183: 
184: ```C
185: int irq_attach(int irq, xcpt_t isr, FAR void *arg)
186: ```
187: 
188: 1. 工作机制。
189: 
190:     - 当中断触发时，`isr` 在中断上下文中被调用。
191:     - 这种方式的优点是效率高，因为中断处理直接在中断上下文中完成。
192:     - `isr` 执行期间会屏蔽所有中断应，对实时性要求较高的系统不太合适。
193:     - `isr`中不能调用会导致阻塞的 API（例如 `sleep`、`wait` 等）。
194: 
195: 2. 解除绑定。
196: 
197:     ```C
198:     irq_detach(irq)
199:     ```
200: 
201: 3. 优缺点。
202: 
203:     - 优点：处理效率高。
204:     - 缺点：中断处理期间屏蔽所有中断，影响系统实时性。
205: 
206: ### 2、使用`irq_attach_thread`
207: 
208: ```C
209: int irq_attach_thread(int irq, xcpt_t isr, xcpt_t isrthread, FAR void *arg, int priority, int stack_size)
210: ```
211: 
212: 1. 工作机制。
213: 
214:     - 用户需提供 1 个或者 2 个处理函数：
215:         - `isr` 在中断上下文中被调用，通常用于屏蔽当前中断并快速唤醒 `isrthread`。
216:         - `isrthread` 在线程上下文中被调用，用于处理剩余中断任务。
217:     - 如果 `isr` 为 `NULL`，会直接调用 `isrthread`。
218: 
219: 2. 优势。
220: 
221:     - `isr` 的执行时间被尽可能缩短，从而提升系统实时性。
222:     - `isrthread` 作为线程运行，支持优先级调度，可以被其他高优先级任务抢占。
223: 
224: 3. 劣势。
225: 
226:     - 消耗更多内存（独立线程栈和中断线程结构体）。
227:     - 增加一次上下文切换，降低效率。
228:     - 中断处理完成时间会有一定延迟（约 5 微秒）。
229: 
230: 4. 解除绑定。
231: 
232:     ```C
233:     irq_detach_thread(irq)
234:     ```
235: 
236: ### 3、使用`irq_attach_wqueue`
237: 
238: ```C
239: int irq_attach_wqueue(int irq, xcpt_t isr, xcpt_t isrwork, FAR void *arg, int priority)
240: ```
241: 
242: 1. 工作机制。
243: 
244:     - 用户需提供 1 个或 2 个处理函数：
245:         - `isr` 在中断上下文中被调用。
246:         - `isrwork` 在工作队列上下文中被调用。
247:     - 与 `irq_attach_thread` 的区别在于，`isrwork` 在工作队列中被执行，而不是独立线程中。
248: 
249: 2. 优势。
250: 
251:     - 多个优先级相同的中断可以复用同一个工作队列，从而节省内存。
252:     - 高优先级的工作队列可以抢占低优先级队列。
253:     - 如果中断数量较多，比 `irq_attach_thread` 更节省内存。
254: 
255: 3. 劣势。
256:     - 如果只有一个中断，工作队列的创建会带来额外开销。
257:     - 在多核系统中，控制线程属性和数量的灵活性较差。
258: 
259: 4. 解除绑定。
260: 
261:     ```C
262:     irq_detach_wqueue(irq)
263:     ```
264: 
265: ### 总结对比
266: 
267: | 绑定方式          | 优点                             | 缺点                                               | 使用场景                             |
268: | :---------------- | :------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------- |
269: | irq_attach        | 效率高，直接在中断上下文中处理。 | 中断期间屏蔽所有中断，不适合实时性要求高的系统。   | 处理逻辑简单、实时性要求不高的场景。 |
270: | irq_attach_thread | 提升实时性，支持优先级调度。     | 消耗更多内存，增加上下文切换，处理完成有一定延迟。 | 实时性要求高的场景。                 |
271: | irq_attach_wqueue | 节省内存，支持工作队列复用。     | 单一中断场景效率低，多核场景灵活性不足。           | 中断数量多、内存资源有限的场景。     |
272: 
273: ## 三、中断线程/工作队列的实现示例
274: 
275: 以下是绑定中断并实现中断线程或工作队列的示例代码。
276: 
277: ### 1、绑定中断
278: 
279: 使用 `irq_attach_work` 函数绑定中断处理程序：
280: 
281: ```C
282: irq_attach_work(IRQ, isrhandle, isrwork, arg, 253)
283: ```
284: 
285: - `isrhandle`：中断处理函数，在中断上下文中执行。
286: - `isrwork`：中断线程或工作队列处理函数，在线程上下文中执行。
287: - `arg`：传递给处理函数的参数。
288: - `253`：优先级设置。
289: 
290: ### 2、中断处理函数示例
291: 
292: 在 `isrhandle` 中返回 `IRQ_WAKE_THREAD`，以唤醒中断线程或工作队列。如果返回 `OK`，则不会唤醒中断线程。示例代码如下：
293: 
294: ```C
295: static int isrhandle(int irq, void *regs, void *arg)  
296: {  
297:     up_disabled_irq(irq); // 屏蔽中断，确保退出后中断不会再次触发  
298:     return IRQ_WAKE_THREAD; // 唤醒中断线程或工作队列  
299: }
300: ```
301: 
302: ### 3、中断线程/工作队列处理函数示例
303: 
304: `isrwork` 用于处理中断任务，并在完成后清除中断状态。示例代码如下：
305: 
306: ```C
307: static int isrwork(int irq, void *regs, void *arg)
308: {
309:   // 执行中断处理逻辑
310:   // 清除中断的pending位
311:   up_enabled_irq(irq); // 重新使能中断。
312:   return OK;
313: }
314: ```
315: 
316: ### 4、特殊情况：One-shot 中断
317: 
318: 对于一些 one-shot 中断，可以将 `isrhandle` 设置为 `NULL`，直接使用 `isrwork` 处理中断任务。
319: 
320: ## 四、中断结构体优化
321: 
322: 在中断使用时，系统通常会定义一个全局中断结构体数组：
323: 
324: ```C
325: struct irq_info_s g_irqvector[NR_IRQS];
326: ```
327: 
328: 其中，`NR_IRQS` 表示系统支持的最大中断号，通常大于 200。然而，实际使用的中断数量通常只有十几个，并且这些中断号是离散分布的。这种设计会导致以下问题：
329: 
330: - 内存浪费：即使只使用少量中断，也需要为所有可能的中断号分配内存，存储 `NR_IRQS` 个结构体。
331: - 低效资源利用：大部分中断号对应的结构体未被使用，造成资源浪费。
332: 
333: ### 1、优化策略与实现原理
334: 
335: 为了解决上述问题，可以通过如下动态映射的方式优化中断结构体的存储。
336: 
337: #### 映射关系数组
338: 
339: 定义一个映射关系数组，用于动态建立中断号与中断结构体的映射：
340: 
341: ```C
342: irq_mapped_t g_irqmap[NR_IRQS]
343: ```
344: 
345: - 该数组仅占用 `NR_IRQS` 字节的额外内存。
346: - 在中断使用时，动态建立映射关系。
347: 
348: #### 精简中断结构体数组
349: 
350: 将 `g_irqvector` 定义为：
351: 
352: ```C
353: struct irq_info_s g_irqvector[CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS];
354: ```
355: 
356: - `CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS` 表示系统中可能使用的最大中断数量加 1 。
357: - 通过限制数组大小，仅为实际可能使用的中断分配内存。
358: 
359: #### 中断使用统计
360: 
361: 使用 `g_irqmap_count` 统计当前已使用的中断数量，便于监控和调试。
362: 
363: ### 2、配置示例
364: 
365: 通过以下宏配置启用优化：
366: 
367: ```Makefile
368: CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE_DYNAMINC=y
369: CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE=y
370: CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS=24
371: ```
372: 
373: - `CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE_DYNAMIC`：启用动态映射功能。
374: - `CONFIG_ARCH_MINIMAL_VECTORTABLE`：启用精简中断向量表。
375: - `CONFIG_ARCH_NUSER_INTERRUPTS`：设置最大可能使用的中断数量。
376: 
377: ### 3、优化效果
378: 
379: - 内存节省：仅为实际使用的中断分配存储空间，避免为未使用的中断号浪费内存。
380: - 灵活性提升：通过动态映射关系，支持离散分布的中断号。
381: - 可扩展性：通过配置宏灵活调整中断数量限制。
382: 
383: ## 五、相关仓

\[ [English](../../en/chip_porting/Interrupt_System_Adaptation_Guide.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、实现芯片中断调试

在调试芯片中断子系统（`bringup`）时，厂商需要实现一系列与架构相关的函数（`arch` 函数），以完成以下任务：

- 初始化中断
- 启用和禁用中断
- 设置中断优先级

以下内容提供了具体的要求和实现示例。

### 1、需要实现的中断相关函数

以下是厂商（ Vendor）需要实现的中断相关函数及其功能说明。

1. 初始化中断系统，包括禁用所有中断、配置向量表位置、设置默认优先级以及启用中断。

1: # LCD 驱动
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/LCD_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: ## 一、概述
6: 
7: 对于分辨率要求不高的设备，为了节省内存，通常会采用 Universal mode（SPI/I2C/UART）类型接口的屏幕。在这种情况下，需要适配的主要是 LCD 驱动程序（LCD driver）。
8: 
9: ## 二、openvela LCD 接口
10: 
11: openvela LCD 框架对上层用户提供了标准的 VFS 文件操作接口，用户可以通过以下方式操作 `/dev/lcd0` 设备：
12: 
13: - `open`：打开 LCD 设备。
14: - `ioctl`：执行 LCD 控制命令。
15: - `close`：关闭 LCD 设备。
16: 
17: 通过这些接口，用户可以实现图形绘制和 LCD 的控制操作。
18: 
19: ### 1、驱动层接口
20: 
21: 在驱动层，openvela LCD 框架提供了以下三个函数，驱动开发者需要实现这些接口以适配具体的 LCD 硬件：
22: 
23: ```C
24: #ifdef CONFIG_LCD
25: struct lcd_dev_s; /* Forward reference */
26: 
27: int board_lcd_initialize(void);
28: FAR struct lcd_dev_s *board_lcd_getdev(int lcddev);
29: void board_lcd_uninitialize(void);
30: #endif
31: ```
32: 
33: 1. `board_lcd_initialize`
34: 
35:     用于初始化 LCD 芯片，包括 SPI 初始化、LCD 寄存器配置等硬件相关操作。
36: 
37: 2. `board_lcd_uninitialize`
38: 
39:     用于销毁 LCD 相关资源，例如关闭电源、释放内存等。
40: 
41: 3. `board_lcd_getdev`
42: 
43:     获取 LCD 设备实例，并实现 `struct lcd_dev_s` 定义的一系列方法。该函数是 LCD 驱动的核心，开发者需要实现 `struct lcd_dev_s` 中定义的所有方法。
44: 
45: ### 2、`struct lcd_dev_s` 结构
46: 
47: `struct lcd_dev_s` 是 LCD 驱动的核心结构，封装了与 LCD 控制器交互的接口方法。以下是 `struct lcd_dev_s` 的部分定义示例：
48: 
49: ```C
50: struct lcd_dev_s
51: {
52:   //获取lcd controller的配置信息
53:   int (*getvideoinfo)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev,
54:          FAR struct fb_videoinfo_s *vinfo);
55:   int (*getplaneinfo)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev, unsigned int planeno,
56:          FAR struct lcd_planeinfo_s *pinfo);
57:  
58: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_CMAP
59:   //调色表
60:   int (*getcmap)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev, FAR struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
61:   int (*putcmap)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev,
62:          FAR const struct fb_cmap_s *cmap);
63: #endif
64:  
65: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR
66:   //硬件光标
67:   int (*getcursor)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev,
68:         FAR struct fb_cursorattrib_s *attrib);
69:   int (*setcursor)(FAR struct lcd_dev_s *dev,
70:         FAR struct fb_setcursor_s *settings);
71: #endif
72:   //lcd 特有的控制接口
73:   //获得lcd的电源状态(0: full off - CONFIG_LCD_MAXPOWER: full on). 对于有背光的lcd，这个值一般是背光亮度值
74:   int (*getpower)(struct lcd_dev_s *dev);
75:   //设置lcd的电源状态(0: full off - CONFIG_LCD_MAXPOWER: full on). 对于有背光的lcd，这个值一般是背光亮度值
76:   int (*setpower)(struct lcd_dev_s *dev, int power);
77:   //获取当前对比度 (0-CONFIG_LCD_MAXCONTRAST) 
78:   int (*getcontrast)(struct lcd_dev_s *dev);
79:   //设置当前对比度 (0-CONFIG_LCD_MAXCONTRAST) 
80:   int (*setcontrast)(struct lcd_dev_s *dev, unsigned int contrast);
81: };
82: ```
83: 
84: 开发者可以参考以下文件中的实现：
85: 
86: - `boards/arm/stm32/stm32f4discovery/src/stm32_st7789.c`
87: 
88: 该文件展示了如何实现 `struct lcd_dev_s` 的方法，并适配具体的 LCD 控制器。
89: 
90: ## 三、启用 openvela LCD
91: 
92: 在使用 openvela LCD 功能时，需要启用相关的编译选项，并在系统启动阶段完成初始化和注册操作。以下是具体步骤：
93: 
94: ### 1、启用以下编译选项
95: 
96: 在配置文件中，确保以下选项已启用：
97: 
98: - `CONFIG_LCD`：启用 LCD 支持。
99: - `CONFIG_LCD_DEV`：启用 LCD 设备支持。
100: 
101: ### 2、系统启动阶段的调用方式
102: 
103: 在系统启动阶段，需要调用以下函数完成 LCD 的初始化和注册：
104: 
105: #### 示例代码
106: 
107: ```C
108: #ifdef CONFIG_LCD
109:  // Initialize the LCD board
110:  ret = board_lcd_initialize();
111:  if (ret < 0)
112:  {
113:  syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: board_lcd_initialize() failed: %d\n", ret);
114:  }
115: #ifdef CONFIG_LCD_DEV  
116:     // Register the LCD device  
117:     ret = lcddev_register(0);  
118:     if (ret < 0)  
119:     {  
120:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: lcddev_register() failed: %d\n", ret);  
121:     }  
122: #endif /* CONFIG_LCD_DEV */  
123: #endif /* CONFIG_LCD */
124: ```
125: 
126: #### 代码说明
127: 
128: 1. `board_lcd_initialize`
129:     - 用于初始化 LCD 硬件，例如 SPI 接口、LCD 控制器寄存器等。
130:     - 如果初始化失败，会返回负值并记录错误日志。
131: 2. `lcddev_register`
132:     - 注册 LCD 设备实例，通常用于将 LCD 设备挂载到 `/dev/lcd0`。
133:     - 如果注册失败，会返回负值并记录错误日志。
134: 
135: ### 3、`struct lcd_planeinfo_s` 结构
136: 
137: `struct lcd_planeinfo_s` 是 LCD 驱动的重要结构，定义了与 LCD 数据传输和颜色特性相关的接口和属性。
138: 
139: #### 示例代码
140: 
141: ```C
142: struct lcd_planeinfo_s
143: {
144:   /* LCD Data Transfer */
145:   /* 对某一行写入npixels个数据 */
146:   int (*putrun)(fb_coord_t row, fb_coord_t col, FAR const uint8_t *buffer,
147:                 size_t npixels);
148:   /* 更新矩形区域 */
149:   int (*putarea)(fb_coord_t row_start, fb_coord_t row_end,
150:                  fb_coord_t col_start, fb_coord_t col_end,
151:                  FAR const uint8_t *buffer);
152:   /* 读取某一行npixels个数据 */
153:   int (*getrun)(fb_coord_t row, fb_coord_t col, FAR uint8_t *buffer,
154:                 size_t npixels);
155:   /* 读取一个矩形区域的数据 */
156:   int (*getarea)(fb_coord_t row_start, fb_coord_t row_end,
157:                  fb_coord_t col_start, fb_coord_t col_end,
158:                  FAR uint8_t *buffer);
159:   /* Plane color characteristics */
160:   /* 工作区，每个lcd 设备一个，多个layer共享一个buffer。至少存储一行的数据(bpp * xres/8)，要和像素格式对齐 */
161:   uint8_t *buffer;
162:   /* 一个像素占用的位数 */
163:   uint8_t  bpp;
164: };
165: ```
166: 
167: #### 代码说明
168: 
169: **数据传输接口**
170: 
171: 1. `putrun`
172:     - 向某一行写入指定数量（`npixels`）的像素数据。
173: 2. `putarea`
174:     - 向指定的矩形区域写入像素数据。
175: 3. `getrun`
176:     - 从某一行读取指定数量（`npixels`）的像素数据。
177: 4. `getarea`
178:     - 从指定的矩形区域读取像素数据。
179: 
180: **Plane 颜色特性**
181: 
182: 1. `buffer`
183:     - 功能：工作区缓冲区，每个 LCD 设备一个，多个图层（layer）共享一个缓冲区。
184:     - 要求：缓冲区至少能够存储一行的数据（`bpp * xres / 8`），并与像素格式对齐。
185: 2. `bpp`
186:     - 功能：表示每个像素占用的位数（bits per pixel）。
187: 
188: ## 四、LCD Framebuffer 模式
189: 
190: LCD Framebuffer 是 openvela 对 LCD 驱动程序（LCD driver）的一层 Framebuffer 封装。在启用 LCD Framebuffer 模式后，应用层可以通过 `/dev/fb0` 访问和控制 LCD 设备。需要注意的是，该模式会分配一帧图形缓存（Framebuffer），因此会消耗额外的内存空间。
191: 
192: 参考文件：`drivers/lcd/lcd_framebuffer.c`
193: 
194: ### 1、LCD Framebuffer 模式的核心接口
195: 
196: 根据 [Framebuffer Driver](./Framebuffer_Driver.md) 的描述，LCD Framebuffer 驱动实现了以下三个核心接口：
197: 
198: - `up_fbinitialize`：初始化 Framebuffer 和 LCD 驱动。
199: - `up_fbgetvplane`：获取 Video Plane 信息。
200: - `up_fbuninitialize`：释放 Framebuffer 和相关资源。
201: 
202: 在 `up_fbinitialize` 函数中，完成了对 LCD 驱动的初始化调用。
203: 
204: ### 2、`up_fbinitialize` 函数实现
205: 
206: 以下是 `up_fbinitialize` 函数的实现逻辑。
207: 
208: #### 示例代码
209: 
210: ```C
211: int up_fbinitialize(int display)
212: {
213:   FAR struct lcdfb_dev_s *priv;
214:   FAR struct lcd_dev_s *lcd;
215:   struct fb_videoinfo_s vinfo;
216:   struct fb_area_s area;
217:   int ret;
218: 
219:   lcdinfo("display=%d\n", display);
220:   DEBUGASSERT((unsigned)display < UINT8_MAX);
221: 
222:   /* Allocate the framebuffer state structure */
223:   priv = (FAR struct lcdfb_dev_s *)kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct lcdfb_dev_s));
224:   if (priv == NULL)
225:     {
226:       lcderr("ERROR: Failed to allocate state structure\n");
227:       return -ENOMEM;
228:     }
229: 
230:   /* Initialize the LCD-independent fields of the state structure */
231:   priv->display             = display;
232: 
233:   priv->vtable.getvideoinfo = lcdfb_getvideoinfo,
234:   priv->vtable.getplaneinfo = lcdfb_getplaneinfo,
235: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_CMAP
236:   priv->vtable.getcmap      = lcdfb_getcmap,
237:   priv->vtable.putcmap      = lcdfb_putcmap,
238: #endif
239: #ifdef CONFIG_FB_HWCURSOR
240:   priv->vtable.getcursor    = lcdfb_getcursor,
241:   priv->vtable.setcursor    = lcdfb_setcursor,
242: #endif
243:   priv->vtable.updatearea   = lcdfb_updateearea,
244: 
245: #ifdef CONFIG_LCD_EXTERNINIT
246:   /* Use external graphics driver initialization */
247:   lcd = board_graphics_setup(display);
248:   if (lcd == NULL)
249:     {
250:       gerr("ERROR: board_graphics_setup failed, devno=%d\n", display);
251:       ret = -ENODEV;
252:       goto errout_with_state;
253:     }
254: #else
255:   /* Initialize the LCD device */
256:   ret = board_lcd_initialize();
257:   if (ret < 0)
258:     {
259:       lcderr("ERROR: board_lcd_initialize() failed: %d\n", ret);
260:       goto errout_with_state;
261:     }
262: 
263:   /* Get the device instance */
264:   lcd = board_lcd_getdev(display);
265:   if (lcd == NULL)
266:     {
267:       lcderr("ERROR: board_lcd_getdev failed, devno=%d\n", display);
268:       ret = -ENODEV;
269:       goto errout_with_lcd;
270:     }
271: #endif
272: 
273:   priv->lcd = lcd;
274: 
275:   /* Initialize the LCD-dependent fields of the state structure */
276:   DEBUGASSERT(lcd->getvideoinfo != NULL);
277:   ret = lcd->getvideoinfo(lcd, &vinfo);
278:   if (ret < 0)
279:     {
280:       lcderr("ERROR:  LCD getvideoinfo() failed: %d\n", ret);
281:       goto errout_with_lcd;
282:     }
283: 
284:   priv->xres = vinfo.xres;
285:   priv->yres = vinfo.yres;
286: 
287:   DEBUGASSERT(lcd->getplaneinfo != NULL);
288:   ret = lcd->getplaneinfo(lcd, VIDEO_PLANE, &priv->pinfo);
289:   if (ret < 0)
290:     {
291:       lcderr("ERROR: LCD getplaneinfo() failed: %d\n", ret);
292:       goto errout_with_lcd;
293:     }
294: 
295:   /* Allocate (and clear) the framebuffer */
296:   priv->stride = ((size_t)priv->xres * priv->pinfo.bpp + 7) >> 3;
297:   priv->fblen  = priv->stride * priv->yres;
298: 
299:   priv->fbmem  = (FAR uint8_t *)kmm_zalloc(priv->fblen);
300:   if (priv->fbmem == NULL)
301:     {
302:       lcderr("ERROR: Failed to allocate frame buffer memory\n");
303:       ret = -ENOMEM;
304:       goto errout_with_lcd;
305:     }
306: 
307:   /* Add the state structure to the list of framebuffer interfaces */
308:   priv->flink = g_lcdfb;
309:   g_lcdfb     = priv;
310: 
311:   /* Write the entire framebuffer to the LCD */
312:   area.x = 0;
313:   area.y = 0;
314:   area.w = priv->xres;
315:   area.h = priv->yres;
316: 
317:   ret = lcdfb_updateearea(&priv->vtable, &area);
318:   if (ret < 0)
319:     {
320:       lcderr("FB update failed: %d\n", ret);
321:     }
322: 
323:   /* Turn the LCD on at 75% power */
324:   priv->lcd->setpower(priv->lcd, ((3*CONFIG_LCD_MAXPOWER + 3) / 4));
325:   return OK;
326: 
327: errout_with_lcd:
328: #ifndef CONFIG_LCD_EXTERNINIT
329:   board_lcd_uninitialize();
330: #endif
331: 
332: errout_with_state:
333:   kmm_free(priv);
334:   return ret;
335: }
336: ```
337: 
338: ### 3、配置选项
339: 
340: 在 LCD Framebuffer 模式下，需要启用以下编译选项：
341: 
342: - `CONFIG_LCD`：启用 LCD 支持。
343: - `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB`：启用 Framebuffer 支持。
344: - `CONFIG_LCD_FRAMEBUFFER`：启用 LCD 的 Framebuffer 支持。
345: 
346: **注意**：在该模式下，无需启用 `CONFIG_LCD_DEV` 选项。
347:

## 一、概述

对于分辨率要求不高的设备，为了节省内存，通常会采用 Universal mode（SPI/I2C/UART）类型接口的屏幕。在这种情况下，需要适配的主要是 LCD 驱动程序（LCD driver）。

- `open`：打开 LCD 设备。
- `ioctl`：执行 LCD 控制命令。
- `close`：关闭 LCD 设备。

通过这些接口，用户可以实现图形绘制和 LCD 的控制操作。

So the D13x board uses I2C0 for touch, while the D211BBV example uses I2C3. This is expected - different boards use different I2C channels.

But the issue is that only I2C2 is enabled in the board options, not I2C0. This means the touch driver might not work because the I2C0 bus isn't initialized.

The code skips the Track ID byte, which works for single-point but breaks multi-touch identification. The `touch_up` detection is simulated by comparing consecutive reads rather than using the GT911's built-in event reporting. **Luban-lite**: Reads from 0x814F (correct datasheet address), reads 8 bytes per point including Track ID, properly tracks touch state with arrays. |

**Summary**: 2/12 items passed, 0/12 N/A, 4/12 FAIL, 6/12 WARN

**Critical Issues**:
1. **No touch driver integration in OpenVela D13x board** (Items 5, 6, 11): The `artinchip_boot.c` and `artinchip_appinit.c` files are empty. No `gt9xx_register()` call, no I2C bus initialization, no GPIO setup for RST/INT pins. The touch driver will never be initialized on this board.
2. **I2C bus mismatch in luban-lite reference** (Item 2): Touch configured for `i2c0` but only `i2c2` is enabled in the D13x defconfig. The touch I2C bus may never be initialized even in the reference SDK.
3. **No GT911 configuration in OpenVela driver** (Item 7): The `gt9xx.c` driver writes no configuration registers to the GT911, leaving it in whatever state it powers up in. The luban-lite driver writes a 185-byte configuration table setting resolution, touch points, interrupt mode, and checksum.
4. **OpenVela D13x defconfig has zero I2C and touch configuration** (Items 2, 3): `# CONFIG_AIC_USING_I2C0 is not set` and no touch-related config entries exist.

**Warnings**:
1. **Multi-touch not supported** (Item 10): `gt9xx.c` reads only 1 touch point. GT911 supports 5 simultaneous touches. Luban-lite reads all active points with proper track ID management.
2. **No resolution reporting** (Item 8): `gt9xx.c` has no ioctl handler for `TSIOC_GETRESOLUTION` or `TSIOC_GETMAXPOINTS`. Applications cannot query touch panel capabilities.
3. **Point register offset deviation** (Item 12): `gt9xx.c` starts reading at 0x8150 (X_L) instead of 0x814F (Track ID). Works for single-point touch by coincidence but deviates from datasheet convention. The luban-lite driver correctly starts at 0x814F.
4. **No touch-up/down state tracking** (Item 12): `gt9xx.c` simulates touch events by comparing consecutive coordinate reads. The luban-lite driver properly tracks per-finger state using `s_tp_dowm[]`, `pre_x[]`, `pre_y[]` arrays and correctly generates `RT_TOUCH_EVENT_DOWN`, `RT_TOUCH_EVENT_MOVE`, and `RT_TOUCH_EVENT_UP` events.

5: ## 一、openvela 图形框架

9: ### 1、NX Graphics
10: 
11: openvela 已集成图形库 NxWM，但由于其功能相对简单，无法满足更复杂的需求。
12: 
13: 目前，openvela 系统采用功能更强大的 **LVGL** 图形库，以支持更广泛的应用场景。
14: 
15: ### 2、LVGL
16: 
17: LVGL 是最流行的免费开源嵌入式图形库，可为任何 MCU、MPU 和显示屏类型创建精美的用户界面。
18: 
19: 从消费电子产品到工业自动化，任何应用程序都可以利用 LVGL 的 30 多种内置 Widget、100 多种样式属性、类 Web 布局以及支持多种语言的排版系统。

21: ### 3、Graphics Drivers
22: 
23: 常用的屏幕类型根据数据传输总线的模式，可分为以下两种：
24: 
25: - Universal Mode
26: - Image Transfer (Video Mode)

31: 
32: - Framebuffer Driver
33:     - 针对 Image Transfer (Video Mode) 传输模式的屏幕。

35:         - TTL RGB

37: - LCD Driver

# Display 驱动

\[ [English](../../../en/device_dev_guide/graphics/Display_Driver.md) | 简体中文 \]

## 一、openvela 图形框架

![img](./figures/010.png)

### 1、NX Graphics

openvela 已集成图形库 NxWM，但由于其功能相对简单，无法满足更复杂的需求。

目前，openvela 系统采用功能更强大的 **LVGL** 图形库，以支持更广泛的应用场景。

### 2、LVGL

LVGL 是最流行的免费开源嵌入式图形库，可为任何 MCU、MPU 和显示屏类型创建精美的用户界面。

从消费电子产品到工业自动化，任何应用程序都可以利用 LVGL 的 30 多种内置 Widget、100 多种样式属性、类 Web 布局以及支持多种语言的排版系统。

344:

2.1. 概述¶

345:

芯片集成了 E907 RISC-V 处理器，PSRAM 64Mb 或 32Mb，集成DE（显示引擎）、GE（图像引擎）、VE（图片编解码引擎）， 346: 具有丰富的屏接口，包括RGB、I8080、SPI、LVDS、MIPI DSI，用于工控HMI，串口屏等各种屏显应用方案。

1: D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
2: 芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
3: 芯片系列：D13x
4: 内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
5: 文档版本：v1.0
6: 更新日期：2026-06-13
7: 
8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB
155: - USB: 1×USB2.0（Type-C，支持烧录调试）

161: - 摄像头: 1×DVP 摄像头接口
162: - 以太网: 1×RMII 百兆以太网

164: - 电源: 5V Type-C 或 5~12V 直流

=== 芯片总览 ===
D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。

核心特性：
- CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
- SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
- PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
- Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
- 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
- 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
- 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
- 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
- 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC

11.1.1. 概述¶

357:

GTC（General Timer Counter）通用计数器模块，其功能为CPU提供基础时钟。

358:

本模块输出计数值为52bits，计数的最高频率（基频）为4MHz，计数周期约为35年。

359:

因为计数模块的输出为52bits，而CPU输入为64bits，所以计数值高位寄存器的高12bit固定为0。

360:
361:

11.1.1.1. 特性说明¶

362:
    363:

  • 总线时钟PCLK的频率可选，但必须为4MHz的整数倍频，例如12MHz/24MHz/48MHz/60MHz等

    • 364:

  • 计数器最高计数频率（基频）为4MHz，计数精度为1/4MHz，即250ns

    • 365:

  • 计数时钟频率误差不超过10s/24h，约为100ppm

    • 366:

  • 计数器位宽为52bits，计数周期约35年

    • 367:

  • 计数频率可选，4MHz/1MHz/250KHz

    • 368:

  • 不同的计数频率，计数精度不变，例如4MHz每周期增加1，1MHz每周期增加4，250KHz则每周期增加16

    • 369:

  • 52bits计数值以格雷码（Gray Code）编码方式输出

    • 370:

  • 复位后模块计数从0开始，并且仅支持增量计数

12.5.1. 概述¶

365:
    366:

  • UART是一种与外围设备、数据载体设备、或者数据集等进行串行通信的接口。主处理器（CPU）通过APB总线将数据写到UART，数据转换成串行形式后传输到目标设备。UART也可以接收串行数据和存储，以供主处理器（CPU）读取。

    • 367:

  • UART包含着控制字符长度、波特率、奇偶校验以及生成中断的寄存器。尽管UART只有一个中断输出信号，但有几种优先级的中断类型可响应，每种中断类型都可以通过控制寄存器单独使能/未使能。

    • 368:

  • UART有16450以及16550两种工作模式，因此可与一系列标准软件驱动程序兼容。在16550模式中，数据的发送与接收都由FIFO缓存；而在16450模式中是禁用这些FIFO的。

    • 369:

  • UART支持5-8位的字长，一个可选的奇偶校验位，1/1.5/2个停止位，可通过CPU APB接口编程，包含16位可编程波特率发生器和8位暂存器，以及独立的发送和接收FIFO。提供八条调制解调器控制线和调试回环模式。

    • 370:

  • 中断可在发送缓冲/FIFO、接收缓冲/FIFO、调制解调器状态以及线路状态范围内生成。

    • 371:
372:
373:

374:
    375:

  • 兼容工业标准16550 UART

    • 376:

  • 256x8bit发送与接收FIFO

    • 377:

  • 传输速度可达3Mbps

    • 378:

  • 支持5-8数据位以及1/1.5/2停止位

    • 379:

  • 支持奇校验，偶校验或者无奇偶校验

    • 380:

  • 支持DMA控制器接口

    • 381:

  • 支持软件/硬件流控

    • 382:

  • 支持RS-485 9bit 模式

8.1.1. 概述¶

357:

CMU(Clock Management Unit)用于配置系统时钟，包括PLL频率和展频， AXI/AHB/APB总线时钟，各 358: 模块输入时钟，以及IO输出时钟等等。

361:

    • 363:

    • 364:

  • PLL_FRA 2个，带小数分频和展频功能，可旁路直接输出OSC_24M时钟

  • CPU时钟可选OSC_24M或PLL_INT0进行1~32分频

    • 366:

    • 368:

30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000

79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===

| 1 | board_late_initialize() implementation | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/kernel/boot_process.md` (Section 1, Table row 3) | The function body is **empty** (line 47: `/* 主要驱动初始化 */`). Per the boot process doc, `board_late_initialize` runs in the **AppBringup task context** and is the designated location for "primary driver initialization" including I2C, GPIO, touch, framebuffer, etc. The D13x has LCD, touch panel, I2C, and GPIO hardware that should be initialized here. The function is guarded by `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE` which is correct, but the body does nothing. Per the porting guide Section III.1, the reference `stm32_boot.c` also shows an empty body, so the skeleton is correct -- but the D13x porting analysis (`D13x_full_specs.txt` line 205) lists "I2C, GPIO, Touch, LCD" as key implementation points that should be in bringup. **Missing `artinchip_bringup.c`**: The expected file `artinchip_bringup.c` (per `D13x_full_specs.txt` line 202 and `porting_guide.md` board layout) does not exist. This is the standard NuttX pattern where `board_late_initialize` calls `artinchip_bringup()` to register all device drivers. |
| 2 | Driver registration order | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` (Section III.1), `boot_process.md` (Section I) | The documented initialization sequence is: `board_early_initialize` -> `board_late_initialize` -> `board_app_initialize`. The `artinchip_boot.c` defines all three correctly, and `artinchip_appinit.c` also defines `board_app_initialize` -- **duplicate definition** of `board_app_initialize` in both files. The `Makefile` compiles both `artinchip_boot.c` and `artinchip_appinit.c` (line 10: `CSRCS = artinchip_boot.c artinchip_appinit.c`). The `artinchip_boot.c` `board_app_initialize` has a comment "由 nsh 任务调用" which is correct per docs, while `artinchip_appinit.c` also defines the same function. The `Make.defs` (line 12-14) conditionally includes `artinchip_appinit.c` only when `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y`, but `artinchip_boot.c` always defines it (without the `CONFIG_BOARDCTL` guard). This will cause a **linker error** if `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y` since both files define `board_app_initialize`. Per the porting guide, `artinchip_boot.c` should only define `board_early_initialize` and `board_late_initialize`, while `artinchip_appinit.c` defines `board_app_initialize`. The `artinchip_boot.c` should NOT have `board_app_initialize`. |
| 3 | I2C bus initialization sequence | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md` (Section II.3, II.4) | **No I2C driver implementation exists at all.** The D13x has 3x I2C controllers (I2C0 @ 0x19220000, I2C1 @ 0x19221000, I2C2 @ 0x19222000 per `chip.h` lines 70-72), but there is no `artinchip_i2c.c` in the chips directory, no I2C bus initialization call in `board_late_initialize` or any bringup code, and no I2C Kconfig option defined. Per the I2C master guide, the expected flow is: (1) implement `xxx_i2cbus_initialize()` in chip code, (2) call it in `xxx_bringup.c`, (3) optionally call `i2c_register()` to expose `/dev/i2c-N`. None of this exists. The Kconfig (`chips/d13x/Kconfig`) only defines `D13X_UART0` -- no I2C configuration options. |
| 4 | Input device registration | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Input_Driver_Guide.md` (Section IV, V) | **No input device driver exists.** The D13x Hengshan Pi board has a 4.3-inch capacitive touchscreen (per `D13x_full_specs.txt` line 160), but there is no touch driver implementation, no call to `touch_register()` in any board code, and no `CONFIG_INPUT_TOUCHSCREEN` usage. The Input Driver Guide documents the standard flow: (1) implement `touch_lowerhalf_s`, (2) call `touch_register()` during initialization, (3) use work queue to defer event reporting from ISR. None of this is present in the D13x port. |
| 5 | Video/framebuffer device registration | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md` (Section IV) | **No framebuffer driver exists.** The D13x supports RGB/LVDS/MIPI DSI display output (per `D13x_full_specs.txt`), and has LCD (0x18800000), DE (0x18A00000), and GE (0x18B00000) base addresses defined in `chip.h`. However, there is no `fb_register()` call, no `up_fbinitialize()` implementation, no `up_fbgetvplane()` implementation, and no `CONFIG_VIDEO_FB` usage. The Framebuffer Driver Guide specifies these three functions must be implemented by the driver, and `fb_register()` must be called during system initialization. |
| 6 | LVGL initialization and integration | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Display_Driver.md` (Section I.2), `zh-cn/contest_2026/quickstart/STM32H750.md` | **No LVGL integration exists.** The Display Driver Guide states that openvela uses LVGL as its primary graphics library. The STM32H750 quickstart shows the pattern: `CONFIG_GRAPHICS_LVGL=y` and `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_LVGLDEMO=y` in defconfig, then `lvgldemo` command in nsh. The D13x board has display hardware but no LVGL configuration, no LVGL demo defconfig, and no display initialization code. The board's `defconfig` is referenced in `D13x_openvela_porting_analysis.txt` but no `configs/nsh/defconfig` file was found in the source tree. |
| 7 | Error handling in initialization | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/driver_development.md`, `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` | `board_app_initialize()` in both `artinchip_boot.c` (line 59-63) and `artinchip_appinit.c` (line 28-31) simply `return 0` without any initialization work or error checking. Per the Framebuffer Driver Guide, `fb_register()` failures should be logged with `syslog(LOG_ERR, ...)`. The UART driver `artinchip_uart.c` also lacks error handling -- `d13x_uart_attach()` returns `OK` without checking `irq_attach()` return value (line 76-77). The oneshot timer `artinchip_oneshot.c` similarly does not check `irq_attach()` result (line 216). Per the driver development docs, all driver registration should include error checking and logging. |
| 8 | Resource cleanup on errors | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/graphics/Framebuffer_Driver.md` (Section III.2), `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/bus_driver/I2C/i2c_master_guide.md` | Since no device drivers are registered, there is no resource cleanup to evaluate. However, examining existing code: the `d13x_uart_shutdown()` function (line 68-70) is empty -- it should disable UART interrupts and clean up. Similarly, `d13x_uart_detach()` (line 82-84) is empty -- it should call `up_disable_irq()`. The Framebuffer Driver Guide shows proper cleanup in `errout_with_fb:` label with `kmm_free(fb)`. The heap allocation in `artinchip_allocateheap.c` has no error handling for the PSRAM `umm_addregion()` call. |
| 9 | GPIO export/unexport patterns | **FAIL** | `zh-cn/device_dev_guide/driver/peripheral_driver/gpio/gpio_driver_development_guide.md` (Section I, III) | **No GPIO driver exists.** The GPIO Driver Guide describes two approaches: `ioexpander` framework and `lower_half` method. Neither is implemented for the D13x. The D13x has GPIO base at 0x18700000 and GPIO clock is initialized in `artinchip_start.c` (lines 217-219), but there is no GPIO pin configuration, no `gpio_pin_register()` or `gpio_lower_half()` call, no `xxx_gpio.c` file in the board or chip directories. The guide recommends the `ioexpander` approach for SOC-level adaptation with `CONFIG_IOEXPANDER=y` and `CONFIG_GPIO_LOWER_HALF=y`. |
| 10 | Configuration macro usage (CONFIG_*) | **PASS (partial)** | `zh-cn/chip_porting/porting_guide.md` (Section II.6), `Kconfig` | The Kconfig file (`chips/d13x/Kconfig`) follows the documented pattern with `choice` block for chip selection (lines 9-28), `select` for architecture features (ARCH_RV32, FPU, ONESHOT, etc.), and proper `ARCH_CHIP_CUSTOM` guard. The `CONFIG_BOARD_EARLY_INITIALIZE` and `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE` guards are correctly used in `artinchip_boot.c`. The `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS` guard is correctly used in `artinchip_allocateheap.c` (line 58). **Issue**: The Kconfig only defines `D13X_UART0` -- it is missing configuration options for I2C, GPIO, display/LCD, framebuffer, input/touchscreen, and all other peripherals documented in the D13x specs. The `ONESHOT` and `ONESHOT_COUNT` selects are correct per the porting guide. |

---

**Summary**: 1/10 items passed (and that pass is partial -- only Kconfig structure is correct). 9/10 items failed.

**Critical Issues**:
1. **Missing `artinchip_bringup.c`**: The standard NuttX board file for driver registration is absent. This is the file where `board_late_initialize` should call all driver initialization routines (I2C, GPIO, touch, framebuffer, etc.).
2. **Duplicate `board_app_initialize`**: Defined in both `artinchip_boot.c` and `artinchip_appinit.c`, causing potential linker errors when `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y`.
3. **No device drivers implemented**: I2C, GPIO, touchscreen, and framebuffer drivers are all missing despite the D13x Hengshan Pi having all these peripherals.
4. **No display/LVGL integration**: The board has a 4.3" capacitive touchscreen LCD but zero display initialization code.
5. **No defconfig file found**: The `configs/nsh/defconfig` directory referenced in the porting plan does not exist in the source tree.
6. **Empty initialization bodies**: `board_late_initialize()`, `board_early_initialize()`, and `board_app_initialize()` all contain no functional code.

**Warnings**:
1. **Timer driver GTC frequency mismatch**: `artinchip_oneshot.c` sets `GTC_BASE_FREQ = 4000000` (4MHz), but the luban-lite reference (`system.c` line 34) enables GTC via `*(volatile uint32_t *)(CMU_BASE+0x090c) = 0x3100` which sets the GTC clock to a different frequency. The openvela code does not configure the GTC clock register (CMU+0x90C) before enabling GTC -- it only writes `GTC_CNTCR_EN` to GTC_CNTCR.
2. **Missing `up_irq_save`/`up_irq_restore`**: The `artinchip_irq.c` implements `up_irq_enable()` but does not implement `up_irq_save()` or `up_irq_restore()`, which are required per the Interrupt System Adaptation Guide Section I.1.5. The framework may provide defaults, but these should be explicitly implemented for the CLIC-based E907 core.
3. **UART clock calculation inconsistency**: `chip.h` defines `D13X_UART0_FREQ = 60000000` (60MHz), but the luban-lite specs doc (line 89) says `UART0: PLL_INT1 / 20 = 60MHz`. The divisor calculation `60MHz / (16 * 115200) = 32.55` rounds to 33, which matches the specs doc. However, the actual CMU register write in `artinchip_start.c` line 223 uses divisor value 19, giving `PLL_INT1/(19+1) = 60MHz` which is correct. This is consistent but the naming convention differs between the two codebases.
4. **Missing `riscv_serialinit` guard**: The UART driver provides `riscv_serialinit()` unconditionally (line 193-195). Per the porting guide, this should be guarded by `#ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT` or `#ifdef CONFIG_SERIAL` to avoid compilation issues when serial support is disabled.
5. **No `include/chip.h` and `include/irq.h`**: The chip directory structure per the porting guide requires `include/chip.h` and `include/irq.h` subdirectory files, but only a single top-level `chip.h` exists. The `Make.defs` references `CHIP_INCDIR += $(VENDOR_DIR)/chips/d13x/include` which points to a directory that only exists with no files in it.
6. **Heap allocation uses wrong `umm_addregion`**: `artinchip_allocateheap.c` line 63 calls `umm_addregion()` for PSRAM, but the standard NuttX API for adding heap regions is `up_addregion()` or the `mm_addregion()` family. `umm_addregion` may not be the correct function for NuttX heap management.

No framebuffer driver registered. defconfig has zero display-related CONFIG options (no CONFIG_VIDEO_FB, CONFIG_MIPI_DSI, etc.). |
| 4 | LCD reset GPIO pin number and active level | **FAIL** | `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/文档/D13x官方资料/ic/pinmux/index.html`; luban-lite `Kconfig` | No GPIO pin configured for LCD reset or backlight enable in OpenVela. luban-lite defines `AIC_PANEL_ENABLE_GPIO` defaulting to "PE.19" with active-high logic. The pinmux docs show DSI pins on PD.18-PD.27 (func 4). OpenVela pinmux.c has no display pin configuration (no `AIC_DISP_MIPI_DSI` section like luban-lite pinmux.c lines 150-161). |
| 5 | Display clock source and frequency | **FAIL** | `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/文档/D13x官方资料/ic/clocks_power/cmu/overview.html` (Sec 8.1.1); luban-lite `drv_dsi.c` | OpenVela `board.h` and `sys_clk.c` only define PLL_INT0 (480MHz) and PLL_INT1 (1.2GHz). Missing critical display clocks: PLL_FRA2 (display PLL, fractional with spread spectrum), CLK_SCLK (serial clock for DSI), CLK_PIX (pixel clock), CLK_MIPIDSI (DSI module clock). luban-lite `drv_dsi.c` `aic_dsi_clk_enable()` configures: PLL_FRA2 -> CLK_SCLK -> CLK_PIX -> CLK_MIPIDSI in a chain. D13x supports 1/2/3/4 data lanes, max 1Gbps/lane. luban-lite `disp_conf.h` defines: `LANE_ASSIGNMENTS=0x3210` (direct mapping), `LANE_POLARITIES=0` (no inversion), `CLK_INVERSE=0`, `VIRTUAL_CHANNEL=0`, `MIPI_DSI_LP_RATE=10MHz`. Panel xm91080 uses 4 lanes, st7797 uses 1 lane. None of this exists in OpenVela. |
| 8 | LVGL buffer size and configuration | **FAIL** | N/A (no LVGL docs in workspace, but luban-lite reference exists) | No LVGL integration at all in OpenVela D13x. luban-lite has full LVGL integration under `packages/artinchip/lvgl-ui/`. No CONFIG_LVGL, CONFIG_LV_USE_*, or framebuffer double-buffering options in defconfig. The `AIC_FB_DRAW_BUF_NUM=2` setting in luban-lite `disp_conf.h` (for double-buffering) is absent. |
| 9 | Display power sequence (on/off timing) | **FAIL** | `/home/lladlam/OpenVela/文档/D13x官方资料/ic/media/dsi/function.html` (Sec 10.6.2.5); luban-lite `panel_dsi_xm91080.c` | No display power sequence implemented. luban-lite `panel_dsi_xm91080.c` `panel_enable()` follows correct sequence: (1) di_enable, (2) send_prepare (switch to CMD mode), (3) panel DCS init commands, (4) exit_sleep_mode + 200ms delay, (5) set_display_on + 120ms delay, (6) setup_realmode (switch to Video mode), (7) de_timing_enable, (8) backlight_enable. OpenVela has none of this. |
| 10 | Backlight control GPIO/PWM | **FAIL** | luban-lite `Kconfig` (panel backlight section) | No backlight control in OpenVela. luban-lite supports GPIO backlight (default "PE.19", active-high) or PWM backlight (configurable channel, default brightness 80%). The pinmux docs show PWM0_A on PD.6, PWM0_B on PD.7, PWM1_A on PD.8, etc. for D13x. OpenVela defconfig has no CONFIG options for either mode. |

---

**Summary**: 0/10 items passed

**Critical Issues**:
1. **No display driver infrastructure exists in OpenVela D13x** -- The entire display subsystem (MIPI DSI HAL, DSI driver, panel drivers, framebuffer, display engine, backlight) is completely absent. The board files (`artinchip_boot.c`, `artinchip_appinit.c`) contain only empty stubs. This is a fundamental gap in the porting effort.
2. **Missing MIPI DSI base address** -- `chips/d13x/chip.h` defines `D13X_LCD_BASE` (0x18800000) but is missing `D13X_MIPI_DSI_BASE` (0x18820000) which is critical for DSI register access.
3. **Missing display clock infrastructure** -- No PLL_FRA2, CLK_SCLK, CLK_PIX, CLK_MIPIDSI definitions or initialization. Without these, the DSI controller and PHY cannot be clocked.
4. **No display pinmux configuration** -- DSI pins PD.18-PD.27 need func=4 mux but the OpenVela pinmux is not configured for display.
5. **No Kconfig options for display** -- The chip Kconfig (`chips/d13x/Kconfig`) only has UART0; no display, framebuffer, LVGL, or video options exist.

**Warnings**:
1. The D13x IRQ for LCD (IRQ 55) is defined in `irq.h` but unused -- this is correct for now but indicates the porting is incomplete.
2. The OpenVela NuttX has upstream `drivers/video/mipidsi/` and `drivers/video/fb.c` infrastructure, but no ArtInChip-specific glue code exists to connect them to the D13x hardware.
3. The luban-lite reference implementation is comprehensive and well-structured (HAL -> driver -> panel layered architecture). Any OpenVela port should follow the same architecture pattern but adapted to NuttX driver model.

33: static rt_size_t aic_i2c_master_xfer(struct rt_i2c_bus_device *bus,
34:                                      struct rt_i2c_msg msgs[], rt_uint32_t num)
35: {
36:     CHECK_PARAM(bus, -EINVAL);
37: 
38:     struct aic_i2c_bus *i2c_bus = (struct aic_i2c_bus *)bus;
39:     struct rt_i2c_msg *msg = NULL;
40:     int ret_msg_len = 0;
41:     int32_t bytes_cnt = 0;
42: 
43:     for (uint32_t index = 0; index < num; index++) {
44:         msg = &msgs[index];
45: 
46:         if ((msg->flags & RT_I2C_RD)) {
47:             bytes_cnt = aic_i2c_master_receive_msg(i2c_bus->reg_base, (struct aic_i2c_msg*)msg);
48:         } else {
49:             bytes_cnt = aic_i2c_master_send_msg(i2c_bus->reg_base, (struct aic_i2c_msg*)msg);
50:         }
51: 
52:         if (bytes_cnt == msg->len) {
53:             ret_msg_len++;
54:         }
55:     }
56: 
57:     return ret_msg_len;
58: }

74:     }

207:     } else {

210:     }

213:     read_data[id].width = w;
214:     read_data[id].x_coordinate = x;
215:     read_data[id].y_coordinate = y;
216:     read_data[id].track_id = id;

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

338: static rt_err_t gt911_control(struct rt_touch_device *touch, int cmd, void *arg)
339: {
340:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID) {
341:         return gt911_get_product_id(&gt911_client, arg, 6);
342:     }
343: 
344:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO) {
345:         return gt911_get_info(&gt911_client, arg);
346:     }
347: 
348:     rt_uint8_t buf[4];
349:     rt_uint8_t i = 0;
350:     rt_uint8_t *config;
351: 
352:     config =
353:         (rt_uint8_t *)rt_calloc(1, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_REGITER_LEN);
354:     if (config == RT_NULL) {
355:         LOG_D("malloc config memory failed\n");
356:         return -RT_ERROR;
357:     }
358: 
359:     config[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CONFIG_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
360:     config[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CONFIG_REG & 0xFF);
361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;
367: 
368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
369:             config[4] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range >> 8);
370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;
378: 
379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
380:             config[6] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range >> 8);
381:             config[5] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range & 0xff);
382: 
383:             GT911_CFG_TBL[4] = config[6];
384:             GT911_CFG_TBL[3] = config[5];
385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
398:                     break;
399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }
426: 
427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;
428:     buf[3] = 1;
429: 
430:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, buf, 4);
431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;
434: }

436: static struct rt_touch_ops gt911_touch_ops = {
437:     .touch_readpoint = gt911_read_point,
438:     .touch_control = gt911_control,
439: };
440: 
441: static int rt_hw_gt911_init(const char *name, struct rt_touch_config *cfg)
442: {
443:     struct rt_touch_device *touch_device = RT_NULL;
444: 
445:     touch_device =
446:         (struct rt_touch_device *)rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
447:     if (touch_device == RT_NULL) {
448:         LOG_E("touch device malloc fail");
449:         return -RT_ERROR;
450:     }
451:     rt_memset((void *)touch_device, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
452: 
453:     /* hw init*/
454:     // rst output 0
455:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
456:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_LOW);
457:     rt_thread_delay(10);
458: 
459:     // irq output 0
460:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
461:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
462: 
463:     rt_thread_delay(2);
464:     // rst output 1
465:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
466:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_HIGH);
467: 
468:     rt_thread_delay(5);
469:     // rst input
470:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
471: 
472:     //irq output 0
473:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
474:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
475: 
476:     rt_thread_delay(50);
477: 
478:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
479: 
480:     gt911_client.bus =
481:         (struct rt_i2c_bus_device *)rt_device_find(cfg->dev_name);
482: 
483:     if (gt911_client.bus == RT_NULL) {
484:         LOG_E("Can't find %s device", cfg->dev_name);
485:         return -RT_ERROR;
486:     }
487: 
488:     if (rt_device_open((rt_device_t)gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR) !=
489:         RT_EOK) {
490:         LOG_E("open %s device failed", cfg->dev_name);
491:         return -RT_ERROR;
492:     }
493: 
494:     gt911_client.client_addr = GT911_ADDRESS_HIGH;
495: 
496:     /* register touch device */
497:     touch_device->info.type = RT_TOUCH_TYPE_CAPACITANCE;
498:     touch_device->info.vendor = RT_TOUCH_VENDOR_GT;
499:     rt_memcpy(&touch_device->config, cfg, sizeof(struct rt_touch_config));
500:     touch_device->ops = &gt911_touch_ops;
501: 
502:     if (RT_EOK != rt_hw_touch_register(touch_device, name, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX, RT_NULL)) {
503:         LOG_E("touch device gt911 init failed !!!");
504:         return -RT_ERROR;
505:     }
506: 
507:     LOG_I("touch device gt911 init success");
508:     return RT_EOK;
509: }
510: 
511: static int rt_gt911_gpio_cfg()
512: {
513:     unsigned int g, p;
514:     long pin;
515: 
516:     // RST
517:     pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_RST_PIN);
518:     g = GPIO_GROUP(pin);
519:     p = GPIO_GROUP_PIN(pin);
520:     hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);
521: 
522:     // INT
523:     pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_INT_PIN);
524:     g = GPIO_GROUP(pin);
525:     p = GPIO_GROUP_PIN(pin);
526:     hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);
527:     hal_gpio_set_irq_mode(g, p, 0);
528: 
529:     return 0;
530: }
531: 
532: static int rt_hw_gt911_port(void)
533: {
534:     struct rt_touch_config cfg;
535:     rt_uint8_t rst_pin;
536: 
537:     rt_gt911_gpio_cfg();
538: 
539:     rst_pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_RST_PIN);
540:     cfg.dev_name = GT911_I2C_CHAN;
541:     cfg.irq_pin.pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_INT_PIN);
542:     cfg.irq_pin.mode = PIN_MODE_INPUT;
543:     cfg.user_data = &rst_pin;
544: 
545:     rt_hw_gt911_init("gt911", &cfg);
546: 
547:     return 0;
548: }
549: 
550: INIT_DEVICE_EXPORT(rt_hw_gt911_port);

313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

338: static rt_err_t gt911_control(struct rt_touch_device *touch, int cmd, void *arg)
339: {
340:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID) {
341:         return gt911_get_product_id(&gt911_client, arg, 6);
342:     }
343: 
344:     if (cmd == RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO) {
345:         return gt911_get_info(&gt911_client, arg);
346:     }
347: 
348:     rt_uint8_t buf[4];
349:     rt_uint8_t i = 0;
350:     rt_uint8_t *config;
351: 
352:     config =
353:         (rt_uint8_t *)rt_calloc(1, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_REGITER_LEN);
354:     if (config == RT_NULL) {
355:         LOG_D("malloc config memory failed\n");
356:         return -RT_ERROR;
357:     }
358: 
359:     config[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CONFIG_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
360:     config[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CONFIG_REG & 0xFF);
361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;
367: 
368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
369:             config[4] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range >> 8);
370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;
378: 
379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
380:             config[6] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range >> 8);
381:             config[5] = (rt_uint8_t)(y_range & 0xff);
382: 
383:             GT911_CFG_TBL[4] = config[6];
384:             GT911_CFG_TBL[3] = config[5];
385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
398:                     break;
399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }
426: 
427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;
428:     buf[3] = 1;
429: 
430:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, buf, 4);
431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;
434: }

436: static struct rt_touch_ops gt911_touch_ops = {
437:     .touch_readpoint = gt911_read_point,
438:     .touch_control = gt911_control,
439: };
440: 
441: static int rt_hw_gt911_init(const char *name, struct rt_touch_config *cfg)
442: {
443:     struct rt_touch_device *touch_device = RT_NULL;
444: 
445:     touch_device =
446:         (struct rt_touch_device *)rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
447:     if (touch_device == RT_NULL) {
448:         LOG_E("touch device malloc fail");
449:         return -RT_ERROR;
450:     }
451:     rt_memset((void *)touch_device, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_device));
452: 
453:     /* hw init*/
454:     // rst output 0
455:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
456:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_LOW);
457:     rt_thread_delay(10);
458: 
459:     // irq output 0
460:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
461:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
462: 
463:     rt_thread_delay(2);
464:     // rst output 1
465:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
466:     rt_pin_write(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_HIGH);
467: 
468:     rt_thread_delay(5);
469:     // rst input
470:     rt_pin_mode(*(rt_uint8_t *)cfg->user_data, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
471: 
472:     //irq output 0
473:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_OUTPUT);
474:     rt_pin_write(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_LOW);
475: 
476:     rt_thread_delay(50);
477: 
478:     rt_pin_mode(cfg->irq_pin.pin, PIN_MODE_INPUT);
479: 
480:     gt911_client.bus =
481:         (struct rt_i2c_bus_device *)rt_device_find(cfg->dev_name);
482: 
483:     if (gt911_client.bus == RT_NULL) {
484:         LOG_E("Can't find %s device", cfg->dev_name);
485:         return -RT_ERROR;
486:     }
487: 
488:     if (rt_device_open((rt_device_t)gt911_client.bus, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDWR) !=
489:         RT_EOK) {
490:         LOG_E("open %s device failed", cfg->dev_name);
491:         return -RT_ERROR;
492:     }
493: 
494:     gt911_client.client_addr = GT911_ADDRESS_HIGH;
495: 
496:     /* register touch device */
497:     touch_device->info.type = RT_TOUCH_TYPE_CAPACITANCE;
498:     touch_device->info.vendor = RT_TOUCH_VENDOR_GT;
499:     rt_memcpy(&touch_device->config, cfg, sizeof(struct rt_touch_config));
500:     touch_device->ops = &gt911_touch_ops;
501: 
502:     if (RT_EOK != rt_hw_touch_register(touch_device, name, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX, RT_NULL)) {
503:         LOG_E("touch device gt911 init failed !!!");
504:         return -RT_ERROR;
505:     }
506: 
507:     LOG_I("touch device gt911 init success");
508:     return RT_EOK;
509: }

511: static int rt_gt911_gpio_cfg()
512: {
513:     unsigned int g, p;
514:     long pin;
515: 
516:     // RST
517:     pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_RST_PIN);
518:     g = GPIO_GROUP(pin);
519:     p = GPIO_GROUP_PIN(pin);
520:     hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);
521: 
522:     // INT
523:     pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_INT_PIN);
524:     g = GPIO_GROUP(pin);
525:     p = GPIO_GROUP_PIN(pin);
526:     hal_gpio_direction_input(g, p);
527:     hal_gpio_set_irq_mode(g, p, 0);
528: 
529:     return 0;
530: }
531: 
532: static int rt_hw_gt911_port(void)
533: {
534:     struct rt_touch_config cfg;
535:     rt_uint8_t rst_pin;
536: 
537:     rt_gt911_gpio_cfg();
538: 
539:     rst_pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_RST_PIN);
540:     cfg.dev_name = GT911_I2C_CHAN;
541:     cfg.irq_pin.pin = drv_pin_get(GT911_INT_PIN);
542:     cfg.irq_pin.mode = PIN_MODE_INPUT;
543:     cfg.user_data = &rst_pin;
544: 
545:     rt_hw_gt911_init("gt911", &cfg);
546: 
547:     return 0;
548: }
549: 
550: INIT_DEVICE_EXPORT(rt_hw_gt911_port);

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;

143: /****************************************************************************
144:  * Name: gt9xx_i2c_read
145:  *
146:  * Description:
147:  *   Read a Touch Panel Register over I2C.
148:  *
149:  * Input Parameters:
150:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
151:  *   reg    - I2C Register to be read
152:  *   buf    - Receive Buffer
153:  *   buflen - Number of bytes to be read
154:  *
155:  * Returned Value:
156:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
157:  *
158:  ****************************************************************************/
159: 
160: static int gt9xx_i2c_read(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
161:                           uint16_t reg,
162:                           uint8_t *buf,
163:                           size_t buflen)
164: {
165:   int ret;
166: 
167:   /* Send the Register Address, MSB first */
168: 
169:   uint8_t regbuf[2] =
170:   {
171:     reg >> 8,   /* First Byte: MSB */
172:     reg & 0xff  /* Second Byte: LSB */
173:   };
174: 
175:   /* Compose the I2C Messages */
176: 
177:   struct i2c_msg_s msgv[2] =
178:   {
179:     {
180:       /* Send the I2C Register Address */
181: 
182:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
183:       .addr      = dev->addr,
184:       .flags     = 0,
185:       .buffer    = regbuf,
186:       .length    = sizeof(regbuf)
187:     },
188:     {
189:       /* Receive the I2C Register Values */
190: 
191:       .frequency = CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_I2C_FREQUENCY,
192:       .addr      = dev->addr,
193:       .flags     = I2C_M_READ,
194:       .buffer    = buf,
195:       .length    = buflen
196:     }
197:   };
198: 
199:   const int msgv_len = sizeof(msgv) / sizeof(msgv[0]);
200: 
201:   iinfo("reg=0x%x, buflen=%ld\n", reg, buflen);
202:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && dev->i2c && buf);
203: 
204:   /* Execute the I2C Transfer */
205: 
206:   ret = I2C_TRANSFER(dev->i2c, msgv, msgv_len);
207:   if (ret < 0)
208:     {
209:       ierr("I2C Read failed: %d\n", ret);
210:       return ret;
211:     }
212: 
213: #ifdef CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO
214:   iinfodumpbuffer("gt9xx_i2c_read", buf, buflen);
215: #endif /* CONFIG_DEBUG_INPUT_INFO */
216: 
217:   return OK;
218: }

369: /****************************************************************************
370:  * Name: gt9xx_read_touch_data
371:  *
372:  * Description:
373:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
374:  *   Touch Points.
375:  *
376:  * Input Parameters:
377:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
378:  *   sample - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
379:  *
380:  * Returned Value:
381:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
382:  *
383:  ****************************************************************************/
384: 
385: static int gt9xx_read_touch_data(FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *dev,
386:                                  FAR struct touch_sample_s *sample)
387: {
388:   uint8_t status[1];
389:   uint8_t status_code;
390:   uint8_t touched_points;
391:   uint8_t touch[6];
392:   uint16_t x;
393:   uint16_t y;
394:   uint8_t flags;
395:   int ret;
396: 
397:   /* Erase the Touch Sample and Touch Point */
398: 
399:   iinfo("\n");
400:   DEBUGASSERT(dev && sample);
401:   memset(sample, 0, sizeof(*sample));
402: 
403:   /* Read the Touch Panel Status */
404: 
405:   ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_READ_COOR_ADDR, status, sizeof(status));
406:   if (ret < 0)
407:     {
408:       ierr("Read Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
409:       return ret;
410:     }
411: 
412:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
413: 
414:   status_code = status[0] & 0x80;
415:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
416: 
417:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
418: 
419:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)
420:     {
421:       /* Read the First Touch Point (6 bytes) */
422: 
423:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
424:       if (ret < 0)
425:         {
426:           ierr("Read Touch Point failed: %d\n", ret);
427:           return ret;
428:         }
429: 
430:       /* Decode the Touch Coordinates */
431: 
432:       x = touch[0] + (touch[1] << 8);
433:       y = touch[2] + (touch[3] << 8);
434: 
435:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
436: 
437:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
438:       sample->npoints = 1;
439:       sample->point[0].id = 0;
440:       sample->point[0].x = x;
441:       sample->point[0].y = y;
442:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
443:       iinfo("touch down x=%d, y=%d\n", x, y);
444:     }
445: 
446:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
447: 
448:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
449:   if (ret < 0)
450:     {
451:       ierr("Set Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
452:       return ret;
453:     }
454: 
455:   return OK;
456: }
