458: /****************************************************************************
459:  * Name: gt9xx_read
460:  *
461:  * Description:
462:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
463:  *   Touch Points.
464:  *
465:  * Input Parameters:
466:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
467:  *   buffer - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
468:  *   buflen - Size of buffer
469:  *
470:  * Returned Value:
471:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
472:  *
473:  ****************************************************************************/
474: 
475: static ssize_t gt9xx_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
476:                           size_t buflen)
477: {
478:   FAR struct inode *inode;
479:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
480:   struct touch_sample_s sample;
481:   const size_t outlen = sizeof(sample);
482:   irqstate_t flags;
483:   int ret;
484: 
485:   /* Returned Touch Sample will have 0 or 1 Touch Points */
486: 
487:   iinfo("buflen=%ld\n", buflen);
488:   if (buflen < outlen)
489:     {
490:       ierr("Buffer should be at least %ld bytes, got %ld bytes\n",
491:            outlen, buflen);
492:       return -EINVAL;
493:     }
494: 
495:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
496: 
497:   inode = filep->f_inode;
498:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
499:   priv = inode->i_private;
500: 
501:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent reads */
502: 
503:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
504:   if (ret < 0)
505:     {
506:       return ret;
507:     }
508: 
509:   ret = -EINVAL;
510: 
511:   /* If waiting for Touch Up, return the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
512: 
513:   if (priv->flags & TOUCH_DOWN)
514:     {
515:       /* Begin Critical Section */
516: 
517:       flags = enter_critical_section();
518: 
519:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
520: 
521:       priv->flags = TOUCH_UP | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
522: 
523:       /* End Critical Section */
524: 
525:       leave_critical_section(flags);
526: 
527:       /* Return the Last Touch Point, changed to Touch Up */
528: 
529:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
530:       sample.npoints = 1;
531:       sample.point[0].id = 0;
532:       sample.point[0].x = priv->x;
533:       sample.point[0].y = priv->y;
534:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;
535:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
536:       ret = OK;
537:       iinfo("touch up x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
538:     }
539:   else
540:     {
541:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */
542: 
543:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
544: 
545:       /* Skip duplicates */
546: 
547:       if (sample.npoints >= 1 &&
548:           priv->x == sample.point[0].x &&
549:           priv->y == sample.point[0].y)
550:         {
551:           memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
552:           sample.npoints = 0;
553:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
554:         }
555: 
556:       /* Return the Touch Point */
557: 
558:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
559: 
560:       /* Begin Critical Section */
561: 
562:       flags = enter_critical_section();
563: 
564:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
565: 
566:       priv->int_pending = false;
567: 
568:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
569: 
570:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
571:         {
572:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
573:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
574:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
575:         }
576: 
577:       /* End Critical Section */
578: 
579:       leave_critical_section(flags);
580:     }
581: 
582:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
583: 
584:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
585:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
586: }

588: /****************************************************************************
589:  * Name: gt9xx_open
590:  *
591:  * Description:
592:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
593:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
594:  *   Interrupts.
595:  *
596:  * Input Parameters:
597:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
598:  *
599:  * Returned Value:
600:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
601:  *
602:  ****************************************************************************/
603: 
604: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
605: {
606:   FAR struct inode *inode;
607:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
608:   unsigned int use_count;
609:   int ret;
610: 
611:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
612: 
613:   iinfo("\n");
614:   inode = filep->f_inode;
615:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
616:   priv = inode->i_private;
617: 
618:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
619: 
620:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
621:   if (ret < 0)
622:     {
623:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
624:       return ret;
625:     }
626: 
627:   /* Get next Reference Count */
628: 
629:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
630:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
631:   if (use_count == 1)
632:     {
633:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
634: 
635:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
636:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
637:       if (ret < 0)
638:         {
639:           goto out_lock;
640:         }
641: 
642:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
643: 
644:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
645: 
646:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
647: 
648:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
649:       if (ret < 0)
650:         {
651:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
652: 
653:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
654:           goto out_lock;
655:         }
656: 
657:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
658: 
659:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
660:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
661:     }
662: 
663:   /* Set the Reference Count */
664: 
665:   priv->cref = use_count;
666: 
667:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
668: 
669: out_lock:
670:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
671:   return ret;
672: }
673: 
674: /****************************************************************************
675:  * Name: gt9xx_close
676:  *
677:  * Description:
678:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
679:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
680:  *
681:  * Input Parameters:
682:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
683:  *
684:  * Returned Value:
685:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
686:  *
687:  ****************************************************************************/
688: 
689: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
690: {
691:   FAR struct inode *inode;
692:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
693:   int use_count;
694:   int ret;
695: 
696:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
697: 
698:   iinfo("\n");
699:   inode = filep->f_inode;
700:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
701:   priv = inode->i_private;
702: 
703:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
704: 
705:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
706:   if (ret < 0)
707:     {
708:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
709:       return ret;
710:     }
711: 
712:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
713: 
714:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
715:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
716:   if (use_count == 0)
717:     {
718:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
719: 
720:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
721:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
722: 
723:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
726:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
727:     }
728: 
729:   /* Set the Reference Count */
730: 
731:   priv->cref = use_count;
732: 
733:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
734: 
735:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
736:   return OK;
737: }

739: /****************************************************************************
740:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
741:  *
742:  * Description:
743:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
744:  *
745:  * Input Parameters:
746:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
747:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
748:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
749:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
750:  *
751:  * Returned Value:
752:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
753:  *
754:  ****************************************************************************/
755: 
756: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
757:                       bool setup)
758: {
759:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
760:   FAR struct inode *inode;
761:   bool pending;
762:   int ret = 0;
763:   int i;
764: 
765:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
766: 
767:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
768:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
769:   inode = filep->f_inode;
770:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
771:   priv = inode->i_private;
772: 
773:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
774: 
775:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
776:   if (ret < 0)
777:     {
778:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
779:       return ret;
780:     }
781: 
782:   if (setup)
783:     {
784:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
785: 
786:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
787:         {
788:           ret = -EDEADLK;
789:           goto out;
790:         }
791: 
792:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
793: 
794:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
795:         {
796:           /* Found an available slot */
797: 
798:           if (!priv->fds[i])
799:             {
800:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
801: 
802:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
803:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
804:               break;
805:             }
806:         }
807: 
808:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
809:         {
810:           /* No slots available */
811: 
812:           fds->priv = NULL;
813:           ret = -EBUSY;
814:         }
815:       else
816:         {
817:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
818: 
819:           pending = priv->int_pending;
820:           if (pending)
821:             {
822:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
823:             }
824:         }
825:     }
826:   else if (fds->priv)
827:     {
828:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
829: 
830:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
831:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
832: 
833:       *slot = NULL;
834:       fds->priv = NULL;
835:     }
836: 
837:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
838: 
839: out:
840:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
841:   return ret;
842: }
843: 
844: /****************************************************************************
845:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
846:  *
847:  * Description:
848:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
849:  *
850:  * Input Parameters:
851:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
852:  *   context - IRQ Context
853:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
854:  *
855:  * Returned Value:
856:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
857:  *
858:  ****************************************************************************/
859: 
860: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
861: {
862:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
863:   irqstate_t flags;
864: 
865:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
866: 
867:   /* Begin Critical Section */
868: 
869:   flags = enter_critical_section();
870: 
871:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
872: 
873:   priv->int_pending = true;
874: 
875:   /* End Critical Section */
876: 
877:   leave_critical_section(flags);
878: 
879:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
880:

177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);

184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);

188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));

214:

218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,

249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);

256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);

260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:

269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;

277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));

306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();

314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);

322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */

324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);

331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();

356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */

358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);

361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */

366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);

370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }

390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();

392:   if (psram_size == 0)

394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }

408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)

410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);

423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424:

428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);

468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);

491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;

8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB
155: - USB: 1×USB2.0（Type-C，支持烧录调试）
156: - 调试: 1×JTAG
157: - 串口: 1×UART0（115200 8N1）
158: - TF-Card: 1×TF-Card 接口
159: - 显示: LVDS + RGB 接口、电容式触摸屏接口
160: - 屏幕: 4.3 寸电容触摸屏（预装）
161: - 摄像头: 1×DVP 摄像头接口
162: - 以太网: 1×RMII 百兆以太网
163: - WiFi: 1×SDIO WIFI
164: - 电源: 5V Type-C 或 5~12V 直流
165: 
166: === SDK ===
167: Luban-Lite (RT-Thread): https://gitee.com/artinchip/luban-lite
168: 关键源文件:
169: - startup_gcc.S: 启动汇编
170: - vectors.S: 默认异常处理
171: - system.c: SystemInit()
172: - aic_clk.c: 时钟初始化
173: - aic_soc.h: 基址、寄存器偏移
174: - aic_pinmux.c: 引脚复用
175: - aic_dw_uart.c: 16550 UART 驱动
176: - aic_drv_irq.c: 中断驱动
177: - gcc_aic.ld: 链接脚本
178: 
179: 工具链: RISC-V GCC (xPack 或 SiFive)
180: 烧录: AiBurn / AiBurnPro
181: 调试: OpenOCD + GDB
182: 
183: === openvela 适配方案 ===
184: 需要创建的文件:
185: 
186: 芯片层 (chips/d13x/):
187: - chip.h, include/chip.h, include/irq.h
188: - Kconfig, Make.defs
189: - artinchip_start.c (__start 入口)
190: - artinchip_irq.c (中断适配)
191: - artinchip_lowputc.c (低级串口)
192: - artinchip_uart.c (完整串口驱动)
193: - artinchip_oneshot.c (定时器驱动)
194: - artinchip_allocateheap.c (堆内存初始化)
195: 
196: 板级层 (boards/d13x/hengshan-pi/):
197: - configs/nsh/defconfig
198: - include/board.h
199: - scripts/ld.script
200: - scripts/Make.defs
201: - src/artinchip_boot.c
202: - src/artinchip_bringup.c
203: - src/artinchip_appinit.c
204: 
205: 关键实现要点:
206: 1. 时钟初始化: CMU 0x18020000, PLL_INT0=480MHz, PLL_INT1=1.2GHz
207: 2. UART: 0x18710000, 16550 兼容, 60MHz 时钟, divisor≈33
208: 3. 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展, mtvec mode 3, mtvt 向量表
209: 4. GPIO: 0x18700000, PA0/PA1 PIN_FUN=5 for UART0
210: 5. 内存: SRAM @ 0x20000000 (1MB), PSRAM @ 0x30000000 (8MB)

22: === D13x 芯片 ===
23: - 内核: 玄铁 E907（平头哥 T-Head），RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]，480MHz
24: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（衡山派 1MB）
25: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（衡山派 8MB）
26: - Flash: NOR 16MB（可兼容 NAND）
27: - 显示: RGB / LVDS / MIPI DSI / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
28: - 图形: 2D 加速 + JPEG 解码 + PNG 解码
29: - 通信: UART×8、SPI×4、I2C×3、CAN×2、USB2.0 HS、EMAC(10/100M)
30: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps
31: - PWM: 8路PWM + 24路EPWM + 6路CAP
32: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12通道）
33: 
34: === E907 内核特殊性 ===
35: - mtvec: mode 3（T-Head 自定义模式）+ mtvt 双 CSR
36: - TCM: ITCM (0x30040000) + DTCM (0x30060000)
37: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
38: - PSRAM: 需配置 SYSMAP_ADDR6_ATTR (cacheable/non-cacheable)

41: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
42: SRAM: 0x20000000
43: PSRAM: 0x30000000
44: ITCM: 0x30040000
45: DTCM: 0x30060000
46: CMU: 0x18020000
47: GPIO: 0x18700000
48: UART0: 0x18710000

52: PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz (总线)
53: AXI/AHB: 200MHz
54: APB0: 100MHz
55: UART0: 60MHz
56:

58: 基地址: 0x18710000
59: 时钟: 60MHz
60: 波特率: 115200 8N1
61: divisor ≈ 33
62: IRQ: 76
63: 引脚: PA0(TX)/PA1(RX), PIN_FUN=5
64: 16550 兼容

223: static rt_size_t gt911_read_point(struct rt_touch_device *touch, void *buf,
224:                                   rt_size_t read_num)
225: {
226:     rt_uint8_t point_status = 0;
227:     rt_uint8_t touch_num = 0;
228:     rt_uint8_t write_buf[3];
229:     rt_uint8_t cmd[2];
230:     rt_uint8_t read_buf[8 * GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
231:     rt_uint8_t read_index;
232:     int8_t read_id = 0;
233:     int16_t input_x = 0;
234:     int16_t input_y = 0;
235:     int16_t input_w = 0;
236: 
237:     static rt_uint8_t pre_touch = 0;
238:     static int8_t pre_id[GT911_MAX_TOUCH] = { 0 };
239: 
240:     rt_memset(buf, 0, sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * read_num);
241: 
242:     /* point status register */
243:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
244:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
245: 
246:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, &point_status, 1) != RT_EOK) {
247:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
248:         read_num = 0;
249:         goto exit_;
250:     }
251: 
252:     if (point_status == 0) /* no data */
253:     {
254:         read_num = 0;
255:         goto exit_;
256:     }
257: 
258:     if ((point_status & 0x80) == 0) /* data is not ready */
259:     {
260:         read_num = 0;
261:         goto exit_;
262:     }
263: 
264:     touch_num = point_status & 0x0f; /* get point num */
265: 
266:     if (touch_num > GT911_MAX_TOUCH) /* point num is not correct */
267:     {
268:         read_num = 0;
269:         goto exit_;
270:     }
271: 
272:     cmd[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_POINT1_REG >> 8) & 0xFF);
273:     cmd[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_POINT1_REG & 0xFF);
274: 
275:     /* read point num is touch_num */
276:     if (gt911_read_regs(&gt911_client, cmd, read_buf,
277:                         read_num * GT911_POINT_INFO_NUM) != RT_EOK) {
278:         LOG_D("read point failed\n");
279:         read_num = 0;
280:         goto exit_;
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (pre_touch > touch_num) /* point up */
284:     {
285:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
286:             rt_uint8_t j;
287: 
288:             for (j = 0; j < touch_num; j++) /* this time touch num */
289:             {
290:                 read_id = read_buf[j * 8] & 0x0F;
291: 
292:                 if (pre_id[read_index] == read_id) /* this id is not free */
293:                     break;
294: 
295:                 if (j >= touch_num - 1) {
296:                     rt_uint8_t up_id;
297:                     up_id = pre_id[read_index];
298:                     gt911_touch_up(buf, up_id);
299:                 }
300:             }
301:         }
302:     }
303: 
304:     if (touch_num) /* point down */
305:     {
306:         rt_uint8_t off_set;
307: 
308:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < touch_num; read_index++) {
309:             off_set = read_index * 8;
310:             read_id = read_buf[off_set] & 0x0f;
311:             pre_id[read_index] = read_id;
312:             input_x =
313:                 read_buf[off_set + 1] | (read_buf[off_set + 2] << 8); /* x */
314:             input_y =
315:                 read_buf[off_set + 3] | (read_buf[off_set + 4] << 8); /* y */
316:             input_w =
317:                 read_buf[off_set + 5] | (read_buf[off_set + 6] << 8); /* size */
318: 
319:             gt911_touch_down(buf, read_id, input_x, input_y, input_w);
320:         }
321:     } else if (pre_touch) {
322:         for (read_index = 0; read_index < pre_touch; read_index++) {
323:             gt911_touch_up(buf, pre_id[read_index]);
324:         }
325:     }
326: 
327:     pre_touch = touch_num;
328: 
329: exit_:
330:     write_buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_READ_STATUS >> 8) & 0xFF);
331:     write_buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_READ_STATUS & 0xFF);
332:     write_buf[2] = 0x00;
333:     gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, write_buf, 3);
334: 
335:     return read_num;
336: }

361: 
362:     memcpy(&config[2], GT911_CFG_TBL, sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL));
363: 
364:     switch (cmd) {
365:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE: {
366:             rt_uint16_t x_range;

368:             x_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;

370:             config[3] = (rt_uint8_t)(x_range & 0xff);
371: 
372:             GT911_CFG_TBL[2] = config[4];
373:             GT911_CFG_TBL[1] = config[3];
374:             break;
375:         }
376:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE: {
377:             rt_uint16_t y_range;

379:             y_range = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;

385:             break;
386:         }
387:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_TO_Y: {
388:             config[8] ^= (1 << 3);
389:             break;
390:         }
391:         case RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_MODE: {
392:             rt_uint16_t trig_type;
393:             trig_type = *(rt_uint16_t *)arg;
394: 
395:             switch (trig_type) {
396:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX:
397:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;

399:                 case RT_DEVICE_FLAG_RDONLY:
400:                     config[8] &= 0xFC;
401:                     config[8] |= 0x02;
402:                     break;
403:                 default:
404:                     break;
405:             }
406:             break;
407:         }
408:         default: {
409:             break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:     if (gt911_write_reg(&gt911_client, config,
414:                         sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN) != RT_EOK) {
415:         LOG_D("send config failed");
416:         return -1;
417:     }
418: 
419:     buf[0] = (rt_uint8_t)((GT911_CHECK_SUM >> 8) & 0xFF);
420:     buf[1] = (rt_uint8_t)(GT911_CHECK_SUM & 0xFF);
421:     buf[2] = 0;
422: 
423:     for (i = GT911_ADDR_LEN; i < sizeof(GT911_CFG_TBL) + GT911_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
424:         buf[GT911_ADDR_LEN] += config[i];
425:     }

427:     buf[2] = (~buf[2]) + 1;

431:     rt_free(config);
432: 
433:     return RT_EOK;

<type>file</type>
<content>
1: D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
2: 芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
3: 芯片系列：D13x
4: 内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
5: 文档版本：v1.0
6: 更新日期：2026-06-13
7: 
8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150:

=== 芯片总览 ===
D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。

核心特性：
- CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
- SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
- PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
- Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
- 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
- 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
- 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
- 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
- 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC

406:   if (ret < 0)

409:       return ret;

412:   /* Decode the Status Code and the Touched Points */
413: 
414:   status_code = status[0] & 0x80;
415:   touched_points = status[0] & 0x0f;
416: 
417:   /* If Touch Panel Status is OK and Touched Points is 1 or more */
418: 
419:   if (status_code != 0 && touched_points >= 1)
420:     {
421:       /* Read the First Touch Point (6 bytes) */
422: 
423:       ret = gt9xx_i2c_read(dev, GTP_POINT1, touch, sizeof(touch));
424:       if (ret < 0)

427:           return ret;

429:

431:

433:       y = touch[2] + (touch[3] << 8);
434: 
435:       /* Return the Touch Coordinates as Touch Down */
436: 
437:       flags = TOUCH_DOWN | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
438:       sample->npoints = 1;
439:       sample->point[0].id = 0;
440:       sample->point[0].x = x;
441:       sample->point[0].y = y;
442:       sample->point[0].flags = flags;
443:       iinfo("touch down x=%d, y=%d\n", x, y);
444:     }
445: 
446:   /* Set the Touch Panel Status to 0 */
447: 
448:   ret = gt9xx_set_status(dev, 0);
449:   if (ret < 0)
450:     {
451:       ierr("Set Touch Panel Status failed: %d\n", ret);
452:       return ret;
453:     }

458: /****************************************************************************
459:  * Name: gt9xx_read
460:  *
461:  * Description:
462:  *   Read a Touch Sample from Touch Panel. Returns either 0 or 1
463:  *   Touch Points.
464:  *
465:  * Input Parameters:
466:  *   dev    - Touch Panel Device
467:  *   buffer - Returned Touch Sample (0 or 1 Touch Points)
468:  *   buflen - Size of buffer
469:  *
470:  * Returned Value:
471:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
472:  *
473:  ****************************************************************************/
474: 
475: static ssize_t gt9xx_read(FAR struct file *filep, FAR char *buffer,
476:                           size_t buflen)
477: {
478:   FAR struct inode *inode;
479:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
480:   struct touch_sample_s sample;
481:   const size_t outlen = sizeof(sample);
482:   irqstate_t flags;
483:   int ret;
484: 
485:   /* Returned Touch Sample will have 0 or 1 Touch Points */
486: 
487:   iinfo("buflen=%ld\n", buflen);
488:   if (buflen < outlen)
489:     {
490:       ierr("Buffer should be at least %ld bytes, got %ld bytes\n",
491:            outlen, buflen);
492:       return -EINVAL;
493:     }
494: 
495:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
496: 
497:   inode = filep->f_inode;
498:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
499:   priv = inode->i_private;
500: 
501:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent reads */
502: 
503:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
504:   if (ret < 0)
505:     {
506:       return ret;
507:     }
508: 
509:   ret = -EINVAL;
510: 
511:   /* If waiting for Touch Up, return the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
512: 
513:   if (priv->flags & TOUCH_DOWN)
514:     {
515:       /* Begin Critical Section */
516: 
517:       flags = enter_critical_section();
518: 
519:       /* Mark the Last Touch Point as Touch Up */
520: 
521:       priv->flags = TOUCH_UP | TOUCH_ID_VALID | TOUCH_POS_VALID;
522: 
523:       /* End Critical Section */
524: 
525:       leave_critical_section(flags);
526: 
527:       /* Return the Last Touch Point, changed to Touch Up */
528: 
529:       memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
530:       sample.npoints = 1;
531:       sample.point[0].id = 0;
532:       sample.point[0].x = priv->x;
533:       sample.point[0].y = priv->y;
534:       sample.point[0].flags = priv->flags;
535:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
536:       ret = OK;
537:       iinfo("touch up x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
538:     }
539:   else
540:     {
541:       /* Otherwise read the Touch Point over I2C */
542: 
543:       ret = gt9xx_read_touch_data(priv, &sample);
544: 
545:       /* Skip duplicates */
546: 
547:       if (sample.npoints >= 1 &&
548:           priv->x == sample.point[0].x &&
549:           priv->y == sample.point[0].y)
550:         {
551:           memset(&sample, 0, sizeof(sample));
552:           sample.npoints = 0;
553:           iinfo("skip duplicate x=%d, y=%d\n", priv->x, priv->y);
554:         }
555: 
556:       /* Return the Touch Point */
557: 
558:       memcpy(buffer, &sample, sizeof(sample));
559: 
560:       /* Begin Critical Section */
561: 
562:       flags = enter_critical_section();
563: 
564:       /* Clear the Interrupt Pending Flag */
565: 
566:       priv->int_pending = false;
567: 
568:       /* Remember the Last Touch Point */
569: 
570:       if (sample.npoints >= 1)
571:         {
572:           priv->x = sample.point[0].x;
573:           priv->y = sample.point[0].y;
574:           priv->flags = sample.point[0].flags;
575:         }
576: 
577:       /* End Critical Section */
578: 
579:       leave_critical_section(flags);
580:     }
581: 
582:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow next read */
583: 
584:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
585:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : outlen;
586: }
587: 
588: /****************************************************************************
589:  * Name: gt9xx_open
590:  *
591:  * Description:
592:  *   Open the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the first open, we power on
593:  *   the Touch Panel, probe for the Touch Panel and enable Touch Panel
594:  *   Interrupts.
595:  *
596:  * Input Parameters:
597:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
598:  *
599:  * Returned Value:
600:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
601:  *
602:  ****************************************************************************/
603: 
604: static int gt9xx_open(FAR struct file *filep)
605: {
606:   FAR struct inode *inode;
607:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
608:   unsigned int use_count;
609:   int ret;
610: 
611:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
612: 
613:   iinfo("\n");
614:   inode = filep->f_inode;
615:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
616:   priv = inode->i_private;
617: 
618:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
619: 
620:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
621:   if (ret < 0)
622:     {
623:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
624:       return ret;
625:     }
626: 
627:   /* Get next Reference Count */
628: 
629:   use_count = priv->cref + 1;
630:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count < UINT8_MAX && use_count > priv->cref);
631:   if (use_count == 1)
632:     {
633:       /* If first user, power on the Touch Panel */
634: 
635:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power != NULL);
636:       ret = priv->board->set_power(priv->board, true);
637:       if (ret < 0)
638:         {
639:           goto out_lock;
640:         }
641: 
642:       /* Let Touch Panel power up before probing */
643: 
644:       nxsig_usleep(100 * 1000);
645: 
646:       /* Check that Touch Panel exists on I2C */
647: 
648:       ret = gt9xx_probe_device(priv);
649:       if (ret < 0)
650:         {
651:           /* No such device, power off the Touch Panel */
652: 
653:           priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
654:           goto out_lock;
655:         }
656: 
657:       /* Enable Touch Panel Interrupts */
658: 
659:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
660:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, true);
661:     }
662: 
663:   /* Set the Reference Count */
664: 
665:   priv->cref = use_count;
666: 
667:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
668: 
669: out_lock:
670:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
671:   return ret;
672: }
673: 
674: /****************************************************************************
675:  * Name: gt9xx_close
676:  *
677:  * Description:
678:  *   Close the Touch Panel Device.  If this is the final close, we disable
679:  *   Touch Panel Interrupts and power off the Touch Panel.
680:  *
681:  * Input Parameters:
682:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
683:  *
684:  * Returned Value:
685:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
686:  *
687:  ****************************************************************************/
688: 
689: static int gt9xx_close(FAR struct file *filep)
690: {
691:   FAR struct inode *inode;
692:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
693:   int use_count;
694:   int ret;
695: 
696:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
697: 
698:   iinfo("\n");
699:   inode = filep->f_inode;
700:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
701:   priv = inode->i_private;
702: 
703:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Reference Count */
704: 
705:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
706:   if (ret < 0)
707:     {
708:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
709:       return ret;
710:     }
711: 
712:   /* Decrement the Reference Count */
713: 
714:   use_count = priv->cref - 1;
715:   DEBUGASSERT(use_count >= 0);
716:   if (use_count == 0)
717:     {
718:       /* If final user, disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
719: 
720:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board && priv->board->irq_enable);
721:       priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
722: 
723:       /* Power off the Touch Panel */
724: 
725:       DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->set_power);
726:       priv->board->set_power(priv->board, false);
727:     }
728: 
729:   /* Set the Reference Count */
730: 
731:   priv->cref = use_count;
732: 
733:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Reference Count */
734: 
735:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
736:   return OK;
737: }
738: 
739: /****************************************************************************
740:  * Name: gt9xx_poll
741:  *
742:  * Description:
743:  *   Setup or teardown a poll for the Touch Panel Device.
744:  *
745:  * Input Parameters:
746:  *   filep - File Struct for Touch Panel
747:  *   fds   - The structure describing the events to be monitored, OR NULL if
748:  *           this is a request to stop monitoring events.
749:  *   setup - true: Setup the poll; false: Teardown the poll
750:  *
751:  * Returned Value:
752:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
753:  *
754:  ****************************************************************************/
755: 
756: static int gt9xx_poll(FAR struct file *filep, FAR struct pollfd *fds,
757:                       bool setup)
758: {
759:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
760:   FAR struct inode *inode;
761:   bool pending;
762:   int ret = 0;
763:   int i;
764: 
765:   /* Get the Touch Panel Device */
766: 
767:   iinfo("setup=%d\n", setup);
768:   DEBUGASSERT(fds);
769:   inode = filep->f_inode;
770:   DEBUGASSERT(inode->i_private);
771:   priv = inode->i_private;
772: 
773:   /* Begin Mutex: Lock to prevent concurrent update to Poll Waiters */
774: 
775:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&priv->devlock);
776:   if (ret < 0)
777:     {
778:       ierr("Lock Mutex failed: %d\n", ret);
779:       return ret;
780:     }
781: 
782:   if (setup)
783:     {
784:       /* If Poll Setup: Ignore waits that do not include POLLIN */
785: 
786:       if ((fds->events & POLLIN) == 0)
787:         {
788:           ret = -EDEADLK;
789:           goto out;
790:         }
791: 
792:       /* Find an available slot for the Poll Waiter */
793: 
794:       for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS; i++)
795:         {
796:           /* Found an available slot */
797: 
798:           if (!priv->fds[i])
799:             {
800:               /* Bind the poll structure and this slot */
801: 
802:               priv->fds[i] = fds;
803:               fds->priv = &priv->fds[i];
804:               break;
805:             }
806:         }
807: 
808:       if (i >= CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS)
809:         {
810:           /* No slots available */
811: 
812:           fds->priv = NULL;
813:           ret = -EBUSY;
814:         }
815:       else
816:         {
817:           /* If Interrupt Pending is set, notify the Poll Waiters */
818: 
819:           pending = priv->int_pending;
820:           if (pending)
821:             {
822:               poll_notify(&fds, 1, POLLIN);
823:             }
824:         }
825:     }
826:   else if (fds->priv)
827:     {
828:       /* If Poll Teardown: Remove the poll setup */
829: 
830:       FAR struct pollfd **slot = (FAR struct pollfd **)fds->priv;
831:       DEBUGASSERT(slot != NULL);
832: 
833:       *slot = NULL;
834:       fds->priv = NULL;
835:     }
836: 
837:   /* End Mutex: Unlock to allow update to Poll Waiters */
838: 
839: out:
840:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->devlock);
841:   return ret;
842: }
843: 
844: /****************************************************************************
845:  * Name: gt9xx_isr_handler
846:  *
847:  * Description:
848:  *   Interrupt Handler for Touch Panel.
849:  *
850:  * Input Parameters:
851:  *   irq     - IRQ Number
852:  *   context - IRQ Context
853:  *   arg     - Touch Panel Device
854:  *
855:  * Returned Value:
856:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
857:  *
858:  ****************************************************************************/
859: 
860: static int gt9xx_isr_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
861: {
862:   FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv = (FAR struct gt9xx_dev_s *)arg;
863:   irqstate_t flags;
864: 
865:   DEBUGASSERT(priv);
866: 
867:   /* Begin Critical Section */
868: 
869:   flags = enter_critical_section();
870: 
871:   /* Set the Interrupt Pending Flag */
872: 
873:   priv->int_pending = true;
874: 
875:   /* End Critical Section */
876: 
877:   leave_critical_section(flags);
878: 
879:   /* Notify the Poll Waiters */
880: 
881:   poll_notify(priv->fds, CONFIG_INPUT_GT9XX_NPOLLWAITERS, POLLIN);
882:   return OK;
883: }
884: 
885: /****************************************************************************
886:  * Public Functions
887:  ****************************************************************************/
888: 
889: /****************************************************************************
890:  * Name: gt9xx_register
891:  *
892:  * Description:
893:  *   Register the driver for Goodix GT9XX Touch Panel.  Attach the
894:  *   Interrupt Handler for the Touch Panel and disable Touch Interrupts.
895:  *
896:  * Input Parameters:
897:  *   devpath      - Device Path (e.g. "/dev/input0")
898:  *   dev          - I2C Bus
899:  *   i2c_devaddr  - I2C Address of Touch Panel
900:  *   board_config - Callback for Board-Specific Operations
901:  *
902:  * Returned Value:
903:  *   Zero (OK) on success; a negated errno value is returned on any failure.
904:  *
905:  ****************************************************************************/
906: 
907: int gt9xx_register(FAR const char *devpath,
908:                    FAR struct i2c_master_s *i2c_dev,
909:                    uint8_t i2c_devaddr,
910:                    const struct gt9xx_board_s *board_config)
911: {
912:   struct gt9xx_dev_s *priv;
913:   int ret = 0;
914: 
915:   iinfo("devpath=%s, i2c_devaddr=%d\n", devpath, i2c_devaddr);
916:   DEBUGASSERT(devpath != NULL && i2c_dev != NULL && board_config != NULL);
917: 
918:   /* Allocate the Touch Panel Device Structure */
919: 
920:   priv = kmm_zalloc(sizeof(struct gt9xx_dev_s));
921:   if (!priv)
922:     {
923:       ierr("GT9XX Memory Allocation failed\n");
924:       return -ENOMEM;
925:     }
926: 
927:   /* Setup the Touch Panel Device Structure */
928: 
929:   priv->addr = i2c_devaddr;
930:   priv->i2c = i2c_dev;
931:   priv->board = board_config;
932:   nxmutex_init(&priv->devlock);
933: 
934:   /* Register the Touch Input Driver */
935: 
936:   ret = register_driver(devpath, &g_gt9xx_fileops, 0666, priv);
937:   if (ret < 0)
938:     {
939:       nxmutex_destroy(&priv->devlock);
940:       kmm_free(priv);
941:       ierr("GT9XX Registration failed: %d\n", ret);
942:       return ret;
943:     }
944: 
945:   /* Attach the Interrupt Handler */
946: 
947:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_attach);
948:   priv->board->irq_attach(priv->board, gt9xx_isr_handler, priv);
949: 
950:   /* Disable Touch Panel Interrupts */
951: 
952:   DEBUGASSERT(priv->board->irq_enable);
953:   priv->board->irq_enable(priv->board, false);
954: 
955:   iinfo("GT9XX Touch Panel registered\n");
956:   return OK;
957: }

9.1. 配置触摸屏¶

356:

luban-lite 可以支持两种触摸屏：

357:
    358:

  • 电容屏：CTP；

    • 359:

  • 电阻屏：RTP；

    • 360:

9.1.1. 配置 CTP¶

363:
364:

9.1.1.1. 配置¶

365:

CTP 配置部分，以 D211BBV-DEMO-V2-0 配置 GT911 为例：

366:
    367:

  • 数据通道采用 i2c3；

    • 368:

  • RST 引脚使用 PA8；

    • 369:

  • INT 引脚使用 PA9；

    • 370:
371:

通过 scons --menuconfig 命令，进入配置页面，完成如下配置：

372:

387:                 (PA.8) gt911 reset pin                  # 复位引脚
388:                 (PA.9) gt911 irq pin                    # 中断引脚
389:     Drivers examples  --->
390:         [*] Enable touch panel driver test command      # test_gt911 测试程序

1: D13x 芯片全参数、信息与方案文档
2: 芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）
3: 芯片系列：D13x
4: 内核架构：RISC-V（平头哥玄铁 E907）
5: 文档版本：v1.0
6: 更新日期：2026-06-13
7: 
8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):
128:    - save_boot_params
129:    - 初始化 gp
130:    - 设置 mtvec = Default_Handler | 3 (mode 3)
131:    - 设置 mtvt = __Vectors
132:    - 设置 sp = g_top_irqstack
133:    - 使能 ICache/DCache
134:    - 使能 TCM (ITCM + DTCM)
135:    - 配置 SRAM1
136:    - 配置 PSRAM 属性
137:    - 清零 BSS
138:    - SystemInit()
139:    - 跳转 entry()/main()
140: 4. SystemInit(): FPU, Cache, CLIC, tick
141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB
155: - USB: 1×USB2.0（Type-C，支持烧录调试）
156: - 调试: 1×JTAG
157: - 串口: 1×UART0（115200 8N1）
158: - TF-Card: 1×TF-Card 接口
159: - 显示: LVDS + RGB 接口、电容式触摸屏接口
160: - 屏幕: 4.3 寸电容触摸屏（预装）
161: - 摄像头: 1×DVP 摄像头接口
162: - 以太网: 1×RMII 百兆以太网
163: - WiFi: 1×SDIO WIFI
164: - 电源: 5V Type-C 或 5~12V 直流
165: 
166: === SDK ===
167: Luban-Lite (RT-Thread): https://gitee.com/artinchip/luban-lite
168: 关键源文件:
169: - startup_gcc.S: 启动汇编
170: - vectors.S: 默认异常处理
171: - system.c: SystemInit()
172: - aic_clk.c: 时钟初始化
173: - aic_soc.h: 基址、寄存器偏移
174: - aic_pinmux.c: 引脚复用
175: - aic_dw_uart.c: 16550 UART 驱动
176: - aic_drv_irq.c: 中断驱动
177: - gcc_aic.ld: 链接脚本
178: 
179: 工具链: RISC-V GCC (xPack 或 SiFive)
180: 烧录: AiBurn / AiBurnPro
181: 调试: OpenOCD + GDB
182: 
183: === openvela 适配方案 ===
184: 需要创建的文件:
185: 
186: 芯片层 (chips/d13x/):
187: - chip.h, include/chip.h, include/irq.h
188: - Kconfig, Make.defs
189: - artinchip_start.c (__start 入口)
190: - artinchip_irq.c (中断适配)
191: - artinchip_lowputc.c (低级串口)
192: - artinchip_uart.c (完整串口驱动)
193: - artinchip_oneshot.c (定时器驱动)
194: - artinchip_allocateheap.c (堆内存初始化)
195: 
196: 板级层 (boards/d13x/hengshan-pi/):
197: - configs/nsh/defconfig
198: - include/board.h
199: - scripts/ld.script
200: - scripts/Make.defs
201: - src/artinchip_boot.c
202: - src/artinchip_bringup.c
203: - src/artinchip_appinit.c
204: 
205: 关键实现要点:
206: 1. 时钟初始化: CMU 0x18020000, PLL_INT0=480MHz, PLL_INT1=1.2GHz
207: 2. UART: 0x18710000, 16550 兼容, 60MHz 时钟, divisor≈33
208: 3. 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展, mtvec mode 3, mtvt 向量表
209: 4. GPIO: 0x18700000, PA0/PA1 PIN_FUN=5 for UART0

芯片厂商：广东匠芯创科技有限公司（ArtInChip）

文档版本：v1.0

=== 芯片总览 ===
D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。

核心特性：
- CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
- SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
- PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
- Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
- 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
- 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
- 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
- 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
- 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC

4.3.1.2. CAP 工作原理¶

392:

CAP模块支持PWM模式，可输出PWM信号，并且支持中断触发。将CAP看作一个定时器，软件上基于此实现了微秒级精度的HRTimer。

393:
394: 395:

图 4.5 CAP模块的PWM模式硬件框图¶

396:
397:

PWM信号通常指具有特定占空比的矩形脉冲信号，HRTimer只关心产生中断的时间间隔，不需要配置IO来输出PWM信号。

398:

以D21x为例，CAP模块支持3路，所以最多可实现3个HRTimer。

4.1.1.2. 模块简介¶

390:

CMU 模块用于配置系统时钟，PLL 时钟频率和展频，AXI/AHB/APB 总线时钟，各模块输入时钟，IO 输出时钟，以及各个模块的 Reset 信号的复位或释放。

391:

CMU 模块的基本特性如下：

392:
    393:

  • 两种锁相环共 5 个 PLL

    • 394:

  • 整数 PLL 时钟 PLL_INT 2 个，无小数分频和展频功能，可旁路输出 24M 时钟

    • 395:

  • 小数 PLL 时钟 PLL_FRA 3 个，有小数分频和展频功能，可旁路输出 24M 时钟

    • 396:

  • CPU 时钟源可选 CLK_24M、CLK_32K、PLL_INT0，可进行 1~32 分频

    • 397:

  • AXI/AHB0/APB0/APB1 时钟源可选 CLK_24M 或 PLL_INT1，可进行 1~32 分频

    • 398:

  • 每个模块的时钟可进行 1~32 分频

    • 399:

  • 每个模块的总线时钟、模块时钟、复位开关可独立配置

    • 400:

  • 4 路可配置频率和时钟源的时钟输出，用作于外设的时钟输入

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_irq.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 中断系统适配（CLIC 中断控制器）
5:  * CLIC 寄存器来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type 结构体
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /****************************************************************************
19:  * Pre-processor Definitions
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21: 
22: /* CLIC 寄存器结构 (来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type)
23:  *
24:  * CLIC 基地址: 0x20800000
25:  * 每个中断源占 4 字节: IP(1B), IE(1B), ATTR(1B), CTL(1B)
26:  * CLICINT[] 数组起始偏移: 0x1000
27:  *
28:  * struct CLIC_Type {
29:  *   uint32_t CLICCFG;      // offset 0x000
30:  *   uint32_t CLICINFO;     // offset 0x004
31:  *   uint32_t MINTTHRESH;   // offset 0x008
32:  *   uint32_t RESERVED[1021];
33:  *   CLIC_INT_Control CLICINT[4096];  // offset 0x1000
34:  * };
35:  *
36:  * struct CLIC_INT_Control {
37:  *   uint8_t IP;    // offset +0x000 (pending)
38:  *   uint8_t IE;    // offset +0x001 (enable)
39:  *   uint8_t ATTR;  // offset +0x002 (attribute: vector/shv)
40:  *   uint8_t CTL;   // offset +0x003 (control: priority)
41:  * };
42:  */
43: 
44: #define D13X_CLIC_BASE         D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE   /* 0x20800000 */
45: #define D13X_CLIC_CFG          (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0000)
46: #define D13X_CLIC_INFO         (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0004)
47: #define D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH   (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0008)
48: #define D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE     (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x1000)  /* CLICINT[] 起始 */
49: 
50: /* 中断向量表地址（RISC-V 使用 __trap_vec） */
51: 
52: extern uint32_t __trap_vec[];
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * Private Functions
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: /****************************************************************************
59:  * Name: d13x_clic_set_irq
60:  *
61:  * Description:
62:  *   设置指定中断的 IE/IP/ATTR 寄存器
63:  *
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static inline void d13x_clic_enable_irq(int irq)
67: {
68:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 1 */
69: 
70:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
71:   *ie = 1;
72: }
73: 
74: static inline void d13x_clic_disable_irq(int irq)
75: {
76:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 0 */
77: 
78:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
79:   *ie = 0;
80: }
81: 
82: static inline void d13x_clic_clear_pending(int irq)
83: {
84:   /* CLICINT[irq].IP = 0 (W1C) */
85: 
86:   volatile uint8_t *ip = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 0);
87:   *ip = 0;
88: }
89: 
90: static inline void d13x_clic_set_attr(int irq, uint8_t attr)
91: {
92:   /* CLICINT[irq].ATTR = attr */
93: 
94:   volatile uint8_t *attrp = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 2);
95:   *attrp = attr;
96: }
97: 
98: /****************************************************************************
99:  * Public Functions
100:  ****************************************************************************/
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: void up_irqinitialize(void)
111: {
112:   int i;
113: 
114:   /* 配置 mtvec (mode 3) + mtvt 双 CSR */
115: 
116:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x3;
117:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
118: 
119:   /* mtvt CSR (T-Head 扩展，CSR 编号 0x7C0) */
120: 
121:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
122:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7C0, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
123: 
124:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
125: 
126:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
127: 
128:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
129:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
130: 
131:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
132:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
133: 
134:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
135: 
136:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
139:     {
140:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
141:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 1);  /* use vector interrupt */
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
145: 
146:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x3);
147: 
148:   /* 使能全局中断 */
149: 
150:   up_irq_enable();
151: }
152: 
153: /****************************************************************************
154:  * Name: up_enable_irq
155:  *
156:  * Description:
157:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
162: {
163:   d13x_clic_enable_irq(irq);
164: }
165: 
166: /****************************************************************************
167:  * Name: up_disable_irq
168:  *
169:  * Description:
170:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
171:  *
172:  ****************************************************************************/
173: 
174: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
175: {
176:   d13x_clic_disable_irq(irq);
177: }
178: 
179: /****************************************************************************
180:  * Name: riscv_dispatch_irq
181:  *
182:  * Description:
183:  *   Process interrupt and dispatch to registered handler
184:  *
185:  ****************************************************************************/
186: 
187: void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uint32_t mcause, uint32_t *regs)
188: {
189:   int irq;
190: 
191:   /* 读取中断号 */
192: 
193:   irq = (int)(mcause & 0x7FFFFFFF);
194: 
195:   /* 调用中断处理函数 */
196: 
197:   irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
198: 
199:   return regs;
200: }
201: 
202: /****************************************************************************
203:  * Name: up_irq_enable
204:  *
205:  * Description:
206:  *   Enable all interrupts
207:  *
208:  ****************************************************************************/
209: 
210: irqstate_t up_irq_enable(void)
211: {
212:   irqstate_t flags;
213: 
214:   /* 读取当前中断状态 */
215: 
216:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, mstatus" : "=r"(flags));
217: 
218:   /* 使能中断 */
219: 
220:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrsi mstatus, 0x8");
221: 
222:   return flags;
223: }

23: 
24: /* GTC 寄存器偏移 (来源: D13x User Manual §11.1.3 表 11-1) */
25: 
26: #define GTC_CNTCR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0000)  /* 计数器控制 */
27: #define GTC_CNTSR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0004)  /* 计数器状态 */
28: #define GTC_CNTVL                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0008)  /* 计数值低位 [31:0] */
29: #define GTC_CNTVH                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x000C)  /* 计数值高位 [51:32] */
30: #define GTC_CNTFID0              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0020)  /* 计数频率 ID0 = 4MHz */
31: #define GTC_CNTFID1              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0024)  /* 计数频率 ID1 = 1MHz */
32: #define GTC_CNTFID2              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0028)  /* 计数频率 ID2 = 250KHz */
33: #define GTC_CONFG                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x00C0)  /* 配置: FDIV 分频 */
34: 
35: /* GTC_CNTCR 位定义 */
36: 
37: #define GTC_CNTCR_EN             (1 << 0)   /* 计数器使能 */
38: #define GTC_CNTCR_HDBG           (1 << 1)   /* 调试时保持 */
39: 
40: /* GTC 中断号: GTC 通过 CLIC 直接产生中断，IRQ 号取决于硬件连线
41:  * luban-lite 使用 CORET (IRQ 7) 作为系统 tick，GTC 仅用于使能计数
42:  * NuttX arch_alarm 模型需要一个 IRQ，使用 CORET_IRQn (7) 或
43:  * 通过 oneshot 软件比较实现。此处使用 CORET_IRQn 作为中断源。
44:  */
45: 
46: #define D13X_IRQ_GTC             7   /* CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致 */
47: 
48: /* GTC 时钟频率: 基频 4MHz (D13x User Manual §11.1.1)
49:  * PCLK 可选 12/24/48/60 MHz，GTC 内部分频到 4MHz 基频
50:  * luban-lite system.c 中: *(volatile uint32_t *)GTC_BASE = 0x0001 (使能)
51:  * 计数频率由 GTC_CONFG 的 FDIV 字段控制
52:  */
53: 
54: #define GTC_BASE_FREQ            4000000    /* 4MHz 基频 */
55:

57:  * Private Types
58:  ****************************************************************************/

60: struct d13x_oneshot_lowerhalf_s
61: {
62:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s lower;
63: };
64:

75: /****************************************************************************
76:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_current
77:  *
78:  * Description:
79:  *   Get the current timer value (clkcnt_t API)
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_current(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
84: {
85:   /* 读取 64-bit 计数值: 先读高 32 位，再读低 32 位，再读高 32 位
86:    * 如果高 32 位变化了，说明发生了进位，需要重读
87:    */
88: 
89:   uint32_t high1, low, high2;
90: 
91:   do
92:     {
93:       high1 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
94:       low   = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
95:       high2 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
96:     }
97:   while (high1 != high2);
98: 
99:   return (clkcnt_t)(((uint64_t)high1 << 32) | low);
100: }
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Start the oneshot timer with a relative delay (clkcnt_t API)
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: static void d13x_oneshot_start(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
111:                                clkcnt_t delay)
112: {
113:   uint32_t now_lo = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
114:   uint32_t cmp = now_lo + (uint32_t)delay;
115: 
116:   putreg32(cmp, GTC_CNTVL);  /* 写入比较值到低 32 位 */
117: }
118:

120:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start_absolute
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   Start the oneshot timer with an absolute counter value (clkcnt_t API)
124:  *
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: static void d13x_oneshot_start_absolute(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
128:                                         clkcnt_t cnt)
129: {
130:   putreg32((uint32_t)cnt, GTC_CNTVL);
131: }
132:

134:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_cancel
135:  *
136:  * Description:
137:  *   Cancel the oneshot timer (clkcnt_t API)
138:  *
139:  ****************************************************************************/
140: 
141: static void d13x_oneshot_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
142: {
143:   /* 清除比较匹配: 写入一个不会匹配的值 */
144:   putreg32(0xFFFFFFFF, GTC_CNTVL);
145: }

152:  *
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154:

156: {
157:   return (clkcnt_t)0xFFFFFFFF;
158: }

164:  *   Timer interrupt handler (CORET_IRQn)
165:  *
166:  ****************************************************************************/
167: 
168: static int d13x_oneshot_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
169: {
170:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower = arg;
171: 
172:   /* 调用上层回调 */
173: 
174:   if (lower->callback)
175:     {
176:       lower->callback(lower, lower->arg);
177:     }
178: 
179:   return OK;
180: }

169:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);

173: {
174:   uint32_t timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
175: 
176:   while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_STATUS) & DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY)
177:     {
178:       if (--timeout == 0)
179:         {
180:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
181:         }

203: static int dw_i2c_xfer_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,

206:   uint32_t timeout;
207:   int i;
208: 
209:   /* 设置目标地址 */
210: 
211:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
212: 
213:   /* 发送写命令 */
214: 
215:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
216:     {
217:       uint32_t cmd = msg->buffer[i];
218: 
219:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
220: 
221:       if (i == msg->length - 1)

223:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
224:         }
225: 
226:       /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
227: 
228:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
229:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_TXFLR) >= DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
230:         {
231:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
232:             {
233:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
234:               return -EIO;
235:             }
236: 
237:           if (--timeout == 0)
238:             {
239:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
240:             }
241: 
242:           up_udelay(1);
243:         }
244: 
245:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
246:     }
247: 
248:   /* 等待传输完成 */
249: 
250:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
251:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
252:     {
253:       if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
254:         {
255:           dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
256:           return -EIO;
257:         }
258: 
259:       if (--timeout == 0)
260:         {
261:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
262:         }
263: 
264:       up_udelay(1);
265:     }
266: 
267:   /* 清除中断标志 */
268: 
269:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
270: 
271:   return msg->length;
272: }
273: 
274: static int dw_i2c_xfer_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
275:                             struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
276: {
277:   uint32_t timeout;
278:   int i;
279:   int rx_cnt = 0;
280: 
281:   /* 设置目标地址 */
282: 
283:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
284: 
285:   /* 发送读命令 */
286: 
287:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
288:     {
289:       uint32_t cmd = DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
290: 
291:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
292: 
293:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
294:         {
295:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
296:         }
297: 
298:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* 读取数据 */
302: 
303:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
304:     {
305:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
306: 
307:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
308:         {
309:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
310:             {
311:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
312:               return -EIO;
313:             }
314: 
315:           if (--timeout == 0)
316:             {
317:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
318:             }
319: 
320:           up_udelay(1);
321:         }
322: 
323:       msg->buffer[i] = (uint8_t)(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xFF);
324:       rx_cnt++;
325:     }
326: 
327:   /* 等待 STOP 检测 */
328: 
329:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
330:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
331:     {
332:       if (--timeout == 0)
333:         {
334:           break;
335:         }
336: 
337:       up_udelay(1);
338:     }
339: 
340:   /* 清除中断标志 */
341: 
342:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
343: 
344:   return rx_cnt;
345: }

347: /****************************************************************************
348:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
349:  *
350:  * Description:
351:  *   执行 I2C 传输
352:  *
353:  ****************************************************************************/
354: 
355: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
356:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
357: {
358:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
359:   int ret = 0;
360:   int i;
361: 
362:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
363: 
364:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
365:     {
366:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
367: 
368:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
369:         {
370:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
371:         }
372:       else
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
375:         }
376: 
377:       if (ret < 0)
378:         {
379:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
380:           break;
381:         }
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
385:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
386: }

389:  * Public Functions
390:  ****************************************************************************/

392: /****************************************************************************
393:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
394:  *
395:  * Description:
396:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线
397:  *
398:  ****************************************************************************/
399: 
400: int d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
401: {
402:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
403:   uint32_t reg;
404: 
405:   switch (bus)
406:     {
407: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
408:       case 0:
409:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
410:         break;
411: #endif
412: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
413:       case 1:
414:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
415:         break;
416: #endif
417: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
418:       case 2:
419:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
420:         break;
421: #endif
422:       default:
423:         return -EINVAL;
424:     }
425: 
426:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
427: 
428:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
429:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
430:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
431: 
432:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
433: 
434:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
435: 
436:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
437: 
438:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
439:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
440: 
441:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ 24MHz APB0)
442:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
443:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
444:    */
445: 
446:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
447:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
448: 
449:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
450: 
451:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
452: 
453:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
454: 
455:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
456:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
457: 
458:   /* 使能 I2C */
459: 
460:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
461: 
462:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
463: 
464:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
465: 
466:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
467: 
468:   return OK;
469: }
