8: === 芯片总览 ===
9: D13x 是匠芯创推出的国产高性能全高清显示和智能控制工业级 MCU，采用国产自主 RISC-V 内核，内置 PSRAM，集成显示引擎（DE）、图像引擎（GE）、视频编解码引擎（VE），配备丰富的屏显接口和通用外设。
10: 
11: 核心特性：
12: - CPU: 平头哥玄铁 E907，RV32IMAFDCP，480MHz@1.1V
13: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（按型号）
14: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封）
15: - Flash: NOR 2/4/8/16MB（合封）或外部 NAND
16: - 显示: RGB888 / LVDS / MIPI DSI 4-lane / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
17: - 图形: 2D 加速引擎，旋转/缩放/透明叠加
18: - 视频: JPEG 编解码、PNG/.9.PNG 硬解、MJPEG 硬解 1366×768@60fps
19: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps 输入，5M 拍照
20: - 以太网: 1×10/100M EMAC
21: - USB: 1×USB 2.0 HS-USB
22: - 串口: 8×UART
23: - SPI: 4×SPI
24: - I2C: 3×I2C
25: - CAN: 2×CAN 2.0B
26: - PWM: 8 路 PWM + 24 路 EPWM + 6 路 CAP
27: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12 通道）
28: - 封装: QFN68 / QFN88 / QFN100
29: 
30: === 本次大赛使用型号 ===
31: D133EBS（衡山派开发板），QFN100 封装，1MB SRAM + 8MB PSRAM
32: 
33: === CPU 内核参数 ===
34: 架构: RISC-V
35: 指令集: RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]
36: 位宽: 32 位
37: 主频: 480MHz @ 1.1V
38: 流水线: 5 级按序流水线
39: 浮点单元: 可选单精度 F / 双精度 D
40: 中断控制器: CLIC（Core Local Interrupt Controller）
41: 
42: E907 与标准 RISC-V 差异：
43: - 向量表 CSR: mtvec（mode 3）+ mtvt 双 CSR
44: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
45: - TCM: ITCM + DTCM
46: - 栈保护: mscratch + SPSWAPEN 扩展
47: - FPU 控制: MXSTATUS 扩展
48: - Cache 控制: T-Head 扩展的 icache_enable/dcache_enable
49: 
50: === 存储系统 ===
51: 片上存储:
52: - BROM: 64KB（Boot ROM，出厂固化）
53: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB
54: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（片上合封，16 位控制器）
55: - ITCM: 可配置，地址 0x30040000
56: - DTCM: 可配置，地址 0x30060000
57: 
58: 外部存储接口:
59: - QSPI: 2 套
60: - eMMC: eMMC 4.5
61: - SD/SDIO: SD 3.01 / SDIO 3.0
62: 
63: 启动方式: SD Card → SPI NOR → SPI NAND → eMMC
64: 
65: === 内存地址映射 ===
66: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
67: SRAM: 0x20000000
68: PSRAM: 0x30000000
69: ITCM: 0x30040000
70: DTCM: 0x30060000
71: 外设区域: 0x18000000~
72: 
73: 外设基地址:
74: - CMU: 0x18020000
75: - GPIO: 0x18700000
76: - UART0: 0x18710000
77: 
78: === 时钟系统（CMU）===
79: 时钟源: OSC24M（内部振荡器）24MHz
80: 
81: PLL 配置:
82: - PLL_INT0: 480MHz（CPU 时钟）
83: - PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz（总线/模块时钟源）
84: 
85: 模块时钟:
86: - CPU: PLL_INT0 = 480MHz
87: - AXI/AHB: PLL_INT1 ÷6 = 200MHz
88: - APB0: PLL_INT1 ÷12 = 100MHz
89: - UART0: PLL_INT1 ÷20 = 60MHz
90: 
91: CMU 初始化流程:
92: 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 (PLL_IN = 0x180200A4, bit1=1)
93: 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO (PLL_COM = 0x180200A0)
94: 3. 配置 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49)
95: 4. 配置 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19)
96: 5. 总线时钟: AXI/AHB=200M, APB0=100M
97: 6. CPU 时钟: 480MHz
98: 7. 打开 GPIO 时钟
99: 8. 打开 UART0 时钟 (60MHz)
100: 
101: === UART 详情 ===
102: 基地址: 0x18710000
103: 模块时钟: 60MHz
104: 波特率: 115200 8N1
105: divisor = 60M / (16 × 115200) ≈ 33
106: 控制器类型: 16550 兼容
107: IRQ: 76
108: 调试串口引脚: PA0 (TX) / PA1 (RX)，PIN_FUN = 5
109: 
110: 16550 寄存器偏移:
111: - RBR/THR: 0x00
112: - DLL: 0x00
113: - DLH: 0x04
114: - FCR: 0x08
115: - LCR: 0x0C
116: - MCR: 0x10
117: - LSR: 0x14
118: - MSR: 0x18
119: 
120: === GPIO 详情 ===
121: 基地址: 0x18700000
122: 时钟: APB0 总线时钟, CLK_GPIO @ 0x1802083C
123: 
124: === 启动流程 ===
125: 1. BROM (64KB) 扫描启动源
126: 2. SPL/Bootloader 初始化 DDR/PSRAM
127: 3. startup_gcc.S (Reset_Handler):

141: 5. aic_clk_init(): 时钟初始化
142: 6. board_uart_init(): 引脚复用
143: 7. uart_init(): 16550 初始化
144: 8. 系统就绪
145: 
146: === 向量表结构 ===
147: 表长度: 100 项 × 4 字节
148: 位置: .data 段（可写 RAM）
149: 通过 mtvt CSR 绑定
150: 
151: === 开发板：衡山派 D133EBS ===
152: - 主控: D133EBS，QFN100 封装
153: - SRAM: 1MB, PSRAM: 8MB
154: - NOR FLASH: 16MB

15: - 技术难度: 30%（新芯片适配与底层驱动扩展）

18: - AI 开发: 10%
19: - 商业潜力: 10%
20: - 展示效果: 10%
21: 
22: === D13x 芯片 ===
23: - 内核: 玄铁 E907（平头哥 T-Head），RV32IMA[F][D]C[P]，480MHz
24: - SRAM: 256KB / 512KB / 1MB（衡山派 1MB）
25: - PSRAM: 32Mb / 64Mb / 8MB（衡山派 8MB）
26: - Flash: NOR 16MB（可兼容 NAND）
27: - 显示: RGB / LVDS / MIPI DSI / SPI / I8080，最大 1366×768@60fps
28: - 图形: 2D 加速 + JPEG 解码 + PNG 解码
29: - 通信: UART×8、SPI×4、I2C×3、CAN×2、USB2.0 HS、EMAC(10/100M)
30: - 摄像头: DVP YUV422/BT.656，720P@60fps
31: - PWM: 8路PWM + 24路EPWM + 6路CAP
32: - ADC: 2×12bit GPADC（12通道）
33: 
34: === E907 内核特殊性 ===
35: - mtvec: mode 3（T-Head 自定义模式）+ mtvt 双 CSR
36: - TCM: ITCM (0x30040000) + DTCM (0x30060000)
37: - 中断: CLIC + T-Head 扩展
38: - PSRAM: 需配置 SYSMAP_ADDR6_ATTR (cacheable/non-cacheable)
39: 
40: === 内存映射 ===
41: Flash (NOR): 0x00000000
42: SRAM: 0x20000000
43: PSRAM: 0x30000000
44: ITCM: 0x30040000
45: DTCM: 0x30060000
46: CMU: 0x18020000
47: GPIO: 0x18700000
48: UART0: 0x18710000
49: 
50: === 时钟系统 ===
51: PLL_INT0: 480MHz (CPU)
52: PLL_INT1: 1.2GHz (总线)
53: AXI/AHB: 200MHz
54: APB0: 100MHz
55: UART0: 60MHz
56: 
57: === UART ===
58: 基地址: 0x18710000
59: 时钟: 60MHz
60: 波特率: 115200 8N1
61: divisor ≈ 33
62: IRQ: 76
63: 引脚: PA0(TX)/PA1(RX), PIN_FUN=5
64: 16550 兼容
65: 
66: === openvela 移植框架 ===
67: 芯片层 (chips/d13x/):
68: - artinchip_start.c: __start() 入口

72: - artinchip_oneshot.c: 定时器驱动
73: - artinchip_allocateheap.c: 堆内存初始化
74: - Kconfig, Make.defs

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_irq.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 中断系统适配（CLIC 中断控制器）
5:  * CLIC 寄存器来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type 结构体
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /****************************************************************************
19:  * Pre-processor Definitions
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21: 
22: /* CLIC 寄存器结构 (来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type)
23:  *
24:  * CLIC 基地址: 0x20800000
25:  * 每个中断源占 4 字节: IP(1B), IE(1B), ATTR(1B), CTL(1B)
26:  * CLICINT[] 数组起始偏移: 0x1000
27:  *
28:  * struct CLIC_Type {
29:  *   uint32_t CLICCFG;      // offset 0x000
30:  *   uint32_t CLICINFO;     // offset 0x004
31:  *   uint32_t MINTTHRESH;   // offset 0x008
32:  *   uint32_t RESERVED[1021];
33:  *   CLIC_INT_Control CLICINT[4096];  // offset 0x1000
34:  * };
35:  *
36:  * struct CLIC_INT_Control {
37:  *   uint8_t IP;    // offset +0x000 (pending)
38:  *   uint8_t IE;    // offset +0x001 (enable)
39:  *   uint8_t ATTR;  // offset +0x002 (attribute: vector/shv)
40:  *   uint8_t CTL;   // offset +0x003 (control: priority)
41:  * };
42:  */
43: 
44: #define D13X_CLIC_BASE         D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE   /* 0x20800000 */
45: #define D13X_CLIC_CFG          (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0000)
46: #define D13X_CLIC_INFO         (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0004)
47: #define D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH   (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0008)
48: #define D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE     (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x1000)  /* CLICINT[] 起始 */
49: 
50: /* 中断向量表地址（RISC-V 使用 __trap_vec） */
51: 
52: extern uint32_t __trap_vec[];
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * Private Functions
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: /****************************************************************************
59:  * Name: d13x_clic_set_irq
60:  *
61:  * Description:
62:  *   设置指定中断的 IE/IP/ATTR 寄存器
63:  *
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static inline void d13x_clic_enable_irq(int irq)
67: {
68:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 1 */
69: 
70:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
71:   *ie = 1;
72: }
73: 
74: static inline void d13x_clic_disable_irq(int irq)
75: {
76:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 0 */
77: 
78:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
79:   *ie = 0;
80: }
81: 
82: static inline void d13x_clic_clear_pending(int irq)
83: {
84:   /* CLICINT[irq].IP = 0 (W1C) */
85: 
86:   volatile uint8_t *ip = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 0);
87:   *ip = 0;
88: }
89: 
90: static inline void d13x_clic_set_attr(int irq, uint8_t attr)
91: {
92:   /* CLICINT[irq].ATTR = attr */
93: 
94:   volatile uint8_t *attrp = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 2);
95:   *attrp = attr;
96: }
97: 
98: /****************************************************************************
99:  * Public Functions
100:  ****************************************************************************/
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: void up_irqinitialize(void)
111: {
112:   int i;
113: 
114:   /* 配置 mtvec (mode 3) + mtvt 双 CSR */
115: 
116:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x3;
117:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
118: 
119:   /* mtvt CSR (T-Head 扩展，CSR 编号 0x7C0) */
120: 
121:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
122:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7C0, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
123: 
124:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
125: 
126:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
127: 
128:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
129:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
130: 
131:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
132:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
133: 
134:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
135: 
136:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
139:     {
140:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
141:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 1);  /* use vector interrupt */
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
145: 
146:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x3);
147: 
148:   /* 使能全局中断 */
149: 
150:   up_irq_enable();
151: }
152: 
153: /****************************************************************************
154:  * Name: up_enable_irq
155:  *
156:  * Description:
157:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
162: {
163:   d13x_clic_enable_irq(irq);
164: }
165: 
166: /****************************************************************************
167:  * Name: up_disable_irq
168:  *
169:  * Description:
170:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
171:  *
172:  ****************************************************************************/
173: 
174: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
175: {
176:   d13x_clic_disable_irq(irq);
177: }
178: 
179: /****************************************************************************
180:  * Name: riscv_dispatch_irq
181:  *
182:  * Description:
183:  *   Process interrupt and dispatch to registered handler
184:  *
185:  ****************************************************************************/
186: 
187: void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uint32_t mcause, uint32_t *regs)
188: {
189:   int irq;
190: 
191:   /* 读取中断号 */
192: 
193:   irq = (int)(mcause & 0x7FFFFFFF);
194: 
195:   /* 调用中断处理函数 */
196: 
197:   irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
198: 
199:   return regs;
200: }
201: 
202: /****************************************************************************
203:  * Name: up_irq_enable
204:  *
205:  * Description:
206:  *   Enable all interrupts
207:  *
208:  ****************************************************************************/
209: 
210: irqstate_t up_irq_enable(void)
211: {
212:   irqstate_t flags;
213: 
214:   /* 读取当前中断状态 */
215: 
216:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrr %0, mstatus" : "=r"(flags));
217: 
218:   /* 使能中断 */
219: 
220:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrsi mstatus, 0x8");
221: 
222:   return flags;
223: }

26: 
27: #define CMU_PLL_IN          (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x0A4)
28: #define CMU_PLL_COM         (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x0A0)
29: #define CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN    (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x000)
30: #define CMU_PLL_INT0_CFG    (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x040)
31: #define CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN    (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x004)
32: #define CMU_PLL_INT1_CFG    (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x044)
33: #define CMU_CLK_CPU         (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x200)
34: #define CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB     (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x100)
35: #define CMU_CLK_APB0        (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x120)
36: #define CMU_CLK_UART0       (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x840)
37: #define CMU_CLK_GPIO        (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x83C)
38: 
39: /* PLL_INTx_GEN 位域 */
40: 
41: #define PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT   8
42: #define PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK    (0xFF << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT)
43: #define PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT         (1 << 17)
44: #define PLL_GEN_ENABLE           (1 << 16)  /* PLL_EN bit16, 非 bit0 (FACTOR_P) */
45: 
46: /* CLK 位域 */
47: 
48: #define CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1         (1 << 8)
49: #define CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0         (1 << 8)
50: 
51: /* UART0 时钟位域 */
52: 
53: #define UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN        (1 << 13)
54: #define UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN      (1 << 12)
55: #define UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN      (1 << 8)
56: 
57: /* eFuse 寄存器 */
58: 
59: #define EFUSE_CMU_REG       (D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x904)
60: #define EFUSE_218_REG       (D13X_SID_BASE + 0x218)
61: 
62: /* WDOG 寄存器 (来源: D13x User Manual §11.2) */
63: 
64: #define WDOG_CTL            (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x000)
65: #define WDOG_CNT            (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x004)
66: #define WDOG_IRQ_EN         (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x008)
67: #define WDOG_IRQ_STA        (D13X_WDT_BASE + 0x00C)
68: 
69: /* XSPI 控制器寄存器 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
70: 
71: #define XSPI_CTL            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x000)
72: #define XSPI_CLK            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x004)
73: #define XSPI_TCR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x008)
74: #define XSPI_STAS           (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x00C)
75: #define XSPI_FCR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x028)
76: #define XSPI_START          (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x030)
77: #define XSPI_ADDR           (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x034)
78: #define XSPI_LCKCR          (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x054)
79: #define XSPI_LUT_UP         (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x058)
80: #define XSPI_CS0_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x014)
81: #define XSPI_CS1_DCTL       (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x01C)
82: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x070)
83: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x074)
84: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x078)
85: #define XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x07C)
86: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x080)
87: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x084)
88: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x088)
89: #define XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4     (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x08C)
90: #define XSPI_TDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x200)
91: #define XSPI_RDR            (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x300)
92: #define XSPI_LUTN(n)        (D13X_XSPI_BASE + 0x100 + 0x4 * (n))
93: 
94: /* XSPI_CTL 位域 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
95: 
96: #define CTL_XSPI_EN         (1 << 0)
97: #define CTL_XIP_EN          (1 << 2)
98: #define CTL_AXI_BURST       (1 << 3)
99: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT 4
100: #define CTL_XSPI_MODE_MASK  (0x3 << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT)
101: #define CTL_PARALLEL_MODE   (1 << 6)
102: #define CTL_TIMEOUT_EN      (1 << 7)
103: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_EN     (1 << 12)
104: #define CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL    (1 << 13)
105: 
106: /* XSPI 模式 */
107: 
108: #define XSPI_MODE_XCCELA    0
109: #define XSPI_MODE_HYPERBUS  1
110: #define XSPI_MODE_OPI       2
111: #define XSPI_MODE_SPI       3
112: 
113: /* XSPI_STAS 位域 */
114: 
115: #define STAS_BUSY            (1 << 0)
116: 
117: /* XSPI_FCR 位域 */
118: 
119: #define FCR_RF_RST           (1 << 15)
120: #define FCR_TF_RST           (1 << 31)
121: 
122: /* LUT 指令 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h) */
123: 
124: #define LUT_STOP             0x0
125: #define LUT_CMD              0x1
126: #define LUT_CMD_EX           0x2
127: #define LUT_ADDR             0x3
128: #define LUT_WRITE            0x4
129: #define LUT_READ             0x5
130: #define LUT_CMD_DDR          0x11
131: #define LUT_ADDR_DDR         0x13
132: #define LUT_WRITE_DDR        0x14
133: #define LUT_READ_DDR         0x15
134: #define LUT_DUMMY            0x10
135: 
136: /* LUT IO 模式 */
137: 
138: #define LUT_IO_1             0x0
139: #define LUT_IO_2             0x1
140: #define LUT_IO_4             0x2
141: #define LUT_IO_8             0x3
142: 
143: /* LUT 锁定 */
144: 
145: #define LUT_LOCK             0x1
146: #define LUT_UNLOCK           0x2
147: 
148: /* LUT 条目编码宏 */
149: 
150: #define LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l) \
151:   (((ins_h) << 26) | ((io_h) << 24) | ((op_h) << 16) | \
152:    ((ins_l) << 10) | ((io_l) << 8) | (op_l))
153: 
154: /* BSS 段符号 */
155: 
156: extern uint32_t _sbss[];
157: extern uint32_t _ebss[];
158: extern uint32_t _sdata[];
159: extern uint32_t _edata[];
160: extern uint32_t _eronly[];
161: 
162: /****************************************************************************
163:  * Private Functions
164:  ****************************************************************************/
165: 
166: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
167: {
168:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
169: }
170: 
171: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
172: {
173:   uint32_t reg;
174: 
175:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
176: 
177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
180: 
181:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
182: 
183:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
185:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
186: 
187:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
202: 
203:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
204: 
205:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
206: 
207:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
208: 
209:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
210: 
211:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
212: 
213:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
214: 
215:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
216: 
217:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
225: }
226: 
227: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
228: {
229:   uint32_t divisor;
230: 
231:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
232:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
233:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
234:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
235:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
236:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
237:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
238:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
239:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
240: }
241: 
242: /****************************************************************************
243:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
244:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
248: {
249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
252:   return val;
253: }
254: 
255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
274:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
275:  */
276: 
277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }
284: 
285: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }
289: 
290: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
291: {
292:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
293: }
294: 
295: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
296: {
297:   xspi_wait_idle();
298:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
299:   xspi_wait_idle();
300: }
301: 
302: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
303: 
304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
325: }
326: 
327: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
328: {
329:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
330:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
336: 
337:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
338:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
339: 
340:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
341: }
342: 
343: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
344: {
345:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
346: 
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
350: }
351: 
352: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
353: {
354:   uint8_t mr4;
355: 
356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
357: 
358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
359: 
360:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
365: 
366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
367: }
368: 
369: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }
386: 
387: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
388: {
389:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
391: 
392:   if (psram_size == 0)
393:     return 0;
394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }
407: 
408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
509: 
510:   /* 8. 验证 */
511: 
512:   d13x_psram_verify();
513: }
514:

3:  *
4:  * D13x 定时器驱动（arch_alarm 模型）
5:  * GTC 寄存器来源: D13x User Manual §11.1 + luban-lite
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/timers/oneshot.h>
15: #include <nuttx/timers/arch_alarm.h>
16: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
17: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
18: #include "chip.h"
19: 
20: /****************************************************************************
21:  * Pre-processor Definitions
22:  ****************************************************************************/
23: 
24: /* GTC 寄存器偏移 (来源: D13x User Manual §11.1.3 表 11-1) */
25: 
26: #define GTC_CNTCR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0000)  /* 计数器控制 */
27: #define GTC_CNTSR                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0004)  /* 计数器状态 */
28: #define GTC_CNTVL                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0008)  /* 计数值低位 [31:0] */
29: #define GTC_CNTVH                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x000C)  /* 计数值高位 [51:32] */
30: #define GTC_CNTFID0              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0020)  /* 计数频率 ID0 = 4MHz */
31: #define GTC_CNTFID1              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0024)  /* 计数频率 ID1 = 1MHz */
32: #define GTC_CNTFID2              (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x0028)  /* 计数频率 ID2 = 250KHz */
33: #define GTC_CONFG                (D13X_GTC_BASE + 0x00C0)  /* 配置: FDIV 分频 */
34: 
35: /* GTC_CNTCR 位定义 */
36: 
37: #define GTC_CNTCR_EN             (1 << 0)   /* 计数器使能 */
38: #define GTC_CNTCR_HDBG           (1 << 1)   /* 调试时保持 */
39: 
40: /* GTC 中断号: GTC 通过 CLIC 直接产生中断，IRQ 号取决于硬件连线
41:  * luban-lite 使用 CORET (IRQ 7) 作为系统 tick，GTC 仅用于使能计数
42:  * NuttX arch_alarm 模型需要一个 IRQ，使用 CORET_IRQn (7) 或
43:  * 通过 oneshot 软件比较实现。此处使用 CORET_IRQn 作为中断源。
44:  */
45: 
46: #define D13X_IRQ_GTC             7   /* CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致 */
47: 
48: /* GTC 时钟频率: 基频 4MHz (D13x User Manual §11.1.1)
49:  * PCLK 可选 12/24/48/60 MHz，GTC 内部分频到 4MHz 基频
50:  * luban-lite system.c 中: *(volatile uint32_t *)GTC_BASE = 0x0001 (使能)
51:  * 计数频率由 GTC_CONFG 的 FDIV 字段控制
52:  */
53: 
54: #define GTC_BASE_FREQ            4000000    /* 4MHz 基频 */
55:

57:  * Private Types
58:  ****************************************************************************/
59: 
60: struct d13x_oneshot_lowerhalf_s
61: {
62:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s lower;
63: };
64: 
65: /****************************************************************************
66:  * Private Data
67:  ****************************************************************************/

69: static struct d13x_oneshot_lowerhalf_s g_d13x_oneshot;
70:

73:  ****************************************************************************/
74: 
75: /****************************************************************************
76:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_current
77:  *
78:  * Description:
79:  *   Get the current timer value (clkcnt_t API)
80:  *
81:  ****************************************************************************/
82: 
83: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_current(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
84: {
85:   /* 读取 64-bit 计数值: 先读高 32 位，再读低 32 位，再读高 32 位
86:    * 如果高 32 位变化了，说明发生了进位，需要重读
87:    */
88: 
89:   uint32_t high1, low, high2;
90: 
91:   do
92:     {
93:       high1 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
94:       low   = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
95:       high2 = getreg32(GTC_CNTVH);
96:     }
97:   while (high1 != high2);
98: 
99:   return (clkcnt_t)(((uint64_t)high1 << 32) | low);
100: }
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Start the oneshot timer with a relative delay (clkcnt_t API)
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: static void d13x_oneshot_start(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
111:                                clkcnt_t delay)
112: {
113:   uint32_t now_lo = getreg32(GTC_CNTVL);
114:   uint32_t cmp = now_lo + (uint32_t)delay;
115: 
116:   putreg32(cmp, GTC_CNTVL);  /* 写入比较值到低 32 位 */
117: }
118: 
119: /****************************************************************************
120:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_start_absolute
121:  *
122:  * Description:
123:  *   Start the oneshot timer with an absolute counter value (clkcnt_t API)
124:  *
125:  ****************************************************************************/
126: 
127: static void d13x_oneshot_start_absolute(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower,
128:                                         clkcnt_t cnt)
129: {
130:   putreg32((uint32_t)cnt, GTC_CNTVL);
131: }
132: 
133: /****************************************************************************
134:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_cancel
135:  *
136:  * Description:
137:  *   Cancel the oneshot timer (clkcnt_t API)
138:  *
139:  ****************************************************************************/
140: 
141: static void d13x_oneshot_cancel(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
142: {
143:   /* 清除比较匹配: 写入一个不会匹配的值 */
144:   putreg32(0xFFFFFFFF, GTC_CNTVL);
145: }

148:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_maxdelay
149:  *
150:  * Description:
151:  *   Get the maximum delay value (clkcnt_t API)
152:  *
153:  ****************************************************************************/
154: 
155: static clkcnt_t d13x_oneshot_maxdelay(struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower)
156: {
157:   return (clkcnt_t)0xFFFFFFFF;
158: }
159:

161:  * Name: d13x_oneshot_handler
162:  *
163:  * Description:
164:  *   Timer interrupt handler (CORET_IRQn)
165:  *
166:  ****************************************************************************/
167: 
168: static int d13x_oneshot_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
169: {
170:   struct oneshot_lowerhalf_s *lower = arg;
171: 
172:   /* 调用上层回调 */
173: 
174:   if (lower->callback)
175:     {
176:       lower->callback(lower, lower->arg);
177:     }
178: 
179:   return OK;
180: }

191:   .cancel         = d13x_oneshot_cancel,
192:   .max_delay      = d13x_oneshot_maxdelay,
193: };

201:  *
202:  * Description:
203:  *   This function is called during start-up to initialize the timer
204:  *   interrupt.
205:  *
206:  ****************************************************************************/
207: 
208: void up_timer_initialize(void)
209: {
210:   /* 使能 GTC 计数器 (来源: luban-lite system.c aic_gtc_enable) */
211: 
212:   putreg32(GTC_CNTCR_EN, GTC_CNTCR);

214:   /* 绑定中断处理函数 (使用 CORET_IRQn, 与 luban-lite 一致) */
215: 
216:   irq_attach(D13X_IRQ_GTC, d13x_oneshot_handler, &g_d13x_oneshot.lower);
217:   up_enable_irq(D13X_IRQ_GTC);

220: 
221:   oneshot_count_init(&g_d13x_oneshot.lower, GTC_BASE_FREQ);
222: 
223:   /* 创建 oneshot 实例并绑定系统定时器 */
224: 
225:   g_d13x_oneshot.lower.ops = &g_d13x_oneshot_ops;
226:   up_alarm_set_lowerhalf(&g_d13x_oneshot.lower);
227: }

12.6.1. 概述¶

365:

I2C模块是CPU主机与I2C总线之间的接口，包括一根串行数据线（SDA）和一根串行时钟线（SCL）。所有挂在I2C总线的设备之间都可进行通信，每个设备可通过唯一的地址被其他设备寻址建立通信，每个设备可作为发送者也可以作为接收者。此外，在通信期间设备也会分为master和slave，master可以发起数据传输以及生成时钟信号，被master寻址的则为slave。

366:
367:

    • 373:

Mater发起寻址，发起START信号，生成SCL，生成STOP信号，可发送和接收；Slave作为被寻址的一方，发起ACK或Not ACK信号，可发送和接收。注意I2C_DATA_CMD[8]只能在master模式下配置，I2C任何的通信行为都由master主动发起。

12.6.2.4. Restart说明¶

441:

重复起始条件和起始条件类似，重复起始条件发生在停止条件之前。master想继续给slave发送消息时，在一个字节传输完成后可以发送重复起始条件来启动下一次传输，而不是产生停止条件。

12.6.2.6. START BYTE机制¶

476:

START BYTE机制服务于当片上系统没有专用的I2C模块的情况。START BYTE会将开始条件的过程延长，在生成START条件后，继续发送1个Byte信号（0000_0001），master持续的将SDA线拉低7个周期

477:

当I2C被设为slave时，无需使用START BYTE机制；当I2C被设为master，启用START BYTE可以让轮询总线的处理器以较低的频率采样SDA线。当采样到起始字节中任意一个0时，切换到更快的频率，找到0000_0001后产生restart，然后开始传输。

12.6.2.7. 通用广播地址（General call address）¶

494:

通用广播地址是为了寻址总线上所有设备。如果一个设备不需要使用广播功能,可以不响应广播。如果设备需要使用广播功能，则它在检测到广播地址后发送响应，并作为slave接收读取总线上发送的数据。

master不知道总线上有多少slave发送响应，总线上所有可以响应广播的slave读取广播地址后的第二个以及后面的字节。而不能处理这些广播数据的slave通过不发送响应的方式忽略它。同样的，master也检测不到没有响应的slave。

12.6.2.8. 总线挂死恢复机制¶

530:

SDA挂死恢复

531:

I2C某些通信异常会造成总线挂死情况，例如slave设备应答ACK拉低SDA时出现异常，此时slave无法释放总线，造成master无法继续掌握总线进行通信。

532:

因此检测到SDA挂死条件，则触发恢复机制。原理如下：

533:
    534:

  1. Master尝试在SDA发送逻辑1并且检查SDA是否恢复，最多连续发送9个时钟周期

    2. 535:

  2. 如果SDA在9个时钟周期内恢复，master则发送一个STOP信号释放总线

    3. 536:

  3. 如果SDA在9个时钟周期内未恢复，则系统需要硬件复位

171: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
172: {
173:   uint32_t reg;
174: 
175:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
176: 
177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
180: 
181:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
182: 
183:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
185:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
186: 
187:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
202: 
203:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
204: 
205:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
206: 
207:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
208: 
209:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
210: 
211:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
212: 
213:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
214: 
215:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
216: 
217:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);

255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;

277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }

286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }

304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);

408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();

23: static int d13x_uart0_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
24: {
25:   FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev = arg;
26: 
27:   /* 处理接收中断: 使用 NuttX 标准 API 读取数据入缓冲区
28:    * uart_recvchars 内部调用 dev->ops->receive 循环读取
29:    */
30: 
31:   uart_recvchars(dev);
32: 
33:   return OK;
34: }
35: 
36: static int d13x_uart_setup(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
37: {
38:   uint32_t divisor;
39: 
40:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
41: 
42:   /* 等待 UART 空闲 (来源: User Manual §12.4) */
43: 
44:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
45: 
46:   /* 禁用中断 */
47: 
48:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
49: 
50:   /* 设置 DLAB=1 以访问 DLL/DLH */
51: 
52:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
53: 
54:   /* 写入波特率除数 */
55: 
56:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
57:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
58: 
59:   /* 使能 FIFO, 清除 DLAB, 设置 8N1 */
60: 
61:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
62:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
63:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
64: 
65:   return OK;
66: }
67: 
68: static void d13x_uart_shutdown(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
69: {
70: }
71: 
72: static int d13x_uart_attach(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
73: {
74:   /* 绑定 UART0 中断处理函数 */
75: 
76:   irq_attach(D13X_UART0_IRQ, d13x_uart0_handler, dev);
77:   up_enable_irq(D13X_UART0_IRQ);
78: 
79:   return OK;
80: }
81: 
82: static void d13x_uart_detach(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
83: {
84: }
85: 
86: static int d13x_uart_ioctl(FAR struct file *filep, int cmd,
87:                             unsigned long arg)
88: {
89:   return -ENOTTY;
90: }
91: 
92: static int d13x_uart_receive(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev,
93:                               FAR unsigned int *status)
94: {
95:   *status = getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR);
96:   return (int)(getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL) & 0xFF);
97: }
98: 
99: static void d13x_uart_rxint(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, bool enable)
100: {
101:   /* 使能/禁用接收中断 */
102: 
103:   uint32_t ier = getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
104: 
105:   if (enable)
106:     {
107:       ier |= 0x01;
108:     }
109:   else
110:     {
111:       ier &= ~0x01;
112:     }
113: 
114:   putreg32(ier, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
115: }
116: 
117: static bool d13x_uart_rxavailable(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
118: {
119:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_DR) != 0;
120: }
121: 
122: static void d13x_uart_send(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, int ch)
123: {
124:   while (!(getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_THRE));
125:   putreg32((uint32_t)ch, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
126: }
127: 
128: static void d13x_uart_txint(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev, bool enable)
129: {
130: }
131: 
132: static bool d13x_uart_txready(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
133: {
134:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_THRE) != 0;
135: }
136: 
137: static bool d13x_uart_txempty(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
138: {
139:   return (getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_TEMT) != 0;
140: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_i2c.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x DesignWare I2C Master Driver (NuttX)
5:  * 寄存器来源: luban-lite hal_i2c.h + D13x User Manual §10
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
15: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/i2c/i2c_master.h>
18: #include <debug.h>
19: #include "chip.h"
20: 
21: /****************************************************************************
22:  * Pre-processor Definitions
23:  ****************************************************************************/
24: 
25: /* DesignWare I2C 寄存器偏移 (来源: luban-lite hal_i2c.h) */
26: 
27: #define DW_I2C_CTL               0x00
28: #define DW_I2C_TAR               0x04
29: #define DW_I2C_SAR               0x08
30: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD          0x10
31: #define DW_I2C_SS_SCL_HCNT       0x20
32: #define DW_I2C_SS_SCL_LCNT       0x24
33: #define DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT       0x28
34: #define DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT       0x2C
35: #define DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD          0x30
36: #define DW_I2C_INTR_MASK         0x38
37: #define DW_I2C_INTR_CLR          0x3C
38: #define DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT     0x40
39: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE            0x48
40: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE_STATUS     0x4C
41: #define DW_I2C_STATUS            0x50
42: #define DW_I2C_TX_ABRT_SOURCE    0x54
43: #define DW_I2C_TXFLR             0x98
44: #define DW_I2C_RXFLR             0x9C
45: 
46: /* CTL 位域 */
47: 
48: #define DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER        (0x0 << 0)
49: #define DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_SS      (0x1 << 4)
50: #define DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS      (0x2 << 4)
51: #define DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN    (1 << 6)
52: 
53: /* DATA_CMD 位域 */
54: 
55: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ     (1 << 8)
56: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP     (1 << 9)
57: #define DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART  (1 << 10)
58: 
59: /* INTR 位域 */
60: 
61: #define DW_I2C_INTR_TX_EMPTY     (1 << 4)
62: #define DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT      (1 << 6)
63: #define DW_I2C_INTR_RX_FULL      (1 << 2)
64: #define DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET     (1 << 9)
65: 
66: /* ENABLE 位域 */
67: 
68: #define DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT        (1 << 0)
69: 
70: /* STATUS 位域 */
71: 
72: #define DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY   (1 << 0)
73: 
74: /* FIFO 深度 */
75: 
76: #define DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH        8
77: 
78: /* 超时 (微秒) */
79: 
80: #define DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US        100000
81: 
82: /****************************************************************************
83:  * Private Types
84:  ****************************************************************************/
85: 
86: struct d13x_i2c_priv_s
87: {
88:   struct i2c_master_s  dev;     /* NuttX I2C master 接口 */
89:   uint32_t             base;    /* I2C 控制器基地址 */
90:   uint8_t              irq;     /* 中断号 */
91:   mutex_t              lock;    /* 互斥锁 */
92: };
93: 
94: /****************************************************************************
95:  * Private Data
96:  ****************************************************************************/
97: 
98: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
99:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count);
100: 
101: static const struct i2c_ops_s g_d13x_i2c_ops =
102: {
103:   .transfer = d13x_i2c_transfer,
104: };
105: 
106: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
107: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c0_priv =
108: {
109:   .dev =
110:   {
111:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
112:   },
113:   .base = D13X_I2C0_BASE,
114:   .irq  = 84,
115: };
116: #endif
117: 
118: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
119: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c1_priv =
120: {
121:   .dev =
122:   {
123:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
124:   },
125:   .base = D13X_I2C1_BASE,
126:   .irq  = 85,
127: };
128: #endif
129: 
130: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
131: static struct d13x_i2c_priv_s g_i2c2_priv =
132: {
133:   .dev =
134:   {
135:     .ops = &g_d13x_i2c_ops,
136:   },
137:   .base = D13X_I2C2_BASE,
138:   .irq  = 86,
139: };
140: #endif
141: 
142: /****************************************************************************
143:  * Private Functions
144:  ****************************************************************************/
145: 
146: static inline void dw_i2c_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
147:                                 uint32_t offset, uint32_t value)
148: {
149:   putreg32(value, priv->base + offset);
150: }
151: 
152: static inline uint32_t dw_i2c_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
153:                                    uint32_t offset)
154: {
155:   return getreg32(priv->base + offset);
156: }
157: 
158: static void dw_i2c_enable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
159: {
160:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
161:   reg |= DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
162:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
163: }
164: 
165: static void dw_i2c_disable(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
166: {
167:   uint32_t reg = dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE);
168:   reg &= ~DW_I2C_ENABLE_BIT;
169:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_ENABLE, reg);
170: }
171: 
172: static int dw_i2c_wait_bus_idle(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv)
173: {
174:   uint32_t timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
175: 
176:   while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_STATUS) & DW_I2C_STATUS_ACTIVITY)
177:     {
178:       if (--timeout == 0)
179:         {
180:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
181:         }
182: 
183:       up_udelay(1);
184:     }
185: 
186:   return OK;
187: }
188: 
189: static int dw_i2c_send_addr(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
190:                             uint16_t addr, bool restart)
191: {
192:   uint32_t cmd = addr & 0x7FF;
193: 
194:   if (restart)
195:     {
196:       cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_RESTART;
197:     }
198: 
199:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
200:   return OK;
201: }
202: 
203: static int dw_i2c_xfer_write(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
204:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
205: {
206:   uint32_t timeout;
207:   int i;
208: 
209:   /* 设置目标地址 */
210: 
211:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
212: 
213:   /* 发送写命令 */
214: 
215:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
216:     {
217:       uint32_t cmd = msg->buffer[i];
218: 
219:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
220: 
221:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
222:         {
223:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
224:         }
225: 
226:       /* 等待 TX FIFO 有空间 */
227: 
228:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
229:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_TXFLR) >= DW_I2C_FIFO_DEPTH)
230:         {
231:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
232:             {
233:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
234:               return -EIO;
235:             }
236: 
237:           if (--timeout == 0)
238:             {
239:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
240:             }
241: 
242:           up_udelay(1);
243:         }
244: 
245:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
246:     }
247: 
248:   /* 等待传输完成 */
249: 
250:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
251:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
252:     {
253:       if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
254:         {
255:           dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
256:           return -EIO;
257:         }
258: 
259:       if (--timeout == 0)
260:         {
261:           return -ETIMEDOUT;
262:         }
263: 
264:       up_udelay(1);
265:     }
266: 
267:   /* 清除中断标志 */
268: 
269:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
270: 
271:   return msg->length;
272: }
273: 
274: static int dw_i2c_xfer_read(struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv,
275:                             struct i2c_msg_s *msg)
276: {
277:   uint32_t timeout;
278:   int i;
279:   int rx_cnt = 0;
280: 
281:   /* 设置目标地址 */
282: 
283:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_TAR, msg->addr);
284: 
285:   /* 发送读命令 */
286: 
287:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
288:     {
289:       uint32_t cmd = DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_READ;
290: 
291:       /* 最后一个字节时设置 STOP 位 */
292: 
293:       if (i == msg->length - 1)
294:         {
295:           cmd |= DW_I2C_DATA_CMD_STOP;
296:         }
297: 
298:       dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD, cmd);
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* 读取数据 */
302: 
303:   for (i = 0; i < msg->length; i++)
304:     {
305:       timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
306: 
307:       while (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_RXFLR) == 0)
308:         {
309:           if (dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_TX_ABRT)
310:             {
311:               dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
312:               return -EIO;
313:             }
314: 
315:           if (--timeout == 0)
316:             {
317:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
318:             }
319: 
320:           up_udelay(1);
321:         }
322: 
323:       msg->buffer[i] = (uint8_t)(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_DATA_CMD) & 0xFF);
324:       rx_cnt++;
325:     }
326: 
327:   /* 等待 STOP 检测 */
328: 
329:   timeout = DW_I2C_TIMEOUT_US;
330:   while (!(dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_RAW_STAT) & DW_I2C_INTR_STOP_DET))
331:     {
332:       if (--timeout == 0)
333:         {
334:           break;
335:         }
336: 
337:       up_udelay(1);
338:     }
339: 
340:   /* 清除中断标志 */
341: 
342:   dw_i2c_read(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR);
343: 
344:   return rx_cnt;
345: }
346: 
347: /****************************************************************************
348:  * Name: d13x_i2c_transfer
349:  *
350:  * Description:
351:  *   执行 I2C 传输
352:  *
353:  ****************************************************************************/
354: 
355: static int d13x_i2c_transfer(struct i2c_master_s *dev,
356:                              struct i2c_msg_s *msgs, int count)
357: {
358:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv = (struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *)dev;
359:   int ret = 0;
360:   int i;
361: 
362:   nxmutex_lock(&priv->lock);
363: 
364:   for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
365:     {
366:       struct i2c_msg_s *msg = &msgs[i];
367: 
368:       if (msg->flags & I2C_M_READ)
369:         {
370:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_read(priv, msg);
371:         }
372:       else
373:         {
374:           ret = dw_i2c_xfer_write(priv, msg);
375:         }
376: 
377:       if (ret < 0)
378:         {
379:           ierr("I2C 传输失败: %d\n", ret);
380:           break;
381:         }
382:     }
383: 
384:   nxmutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
385:   return (ret < 0) ? ret : count;
386: }
387: 
388: /****************************************************************************
389:  * Public Functions
390:  ****************************************************************************/
391: 
392: /****************************************************************************
393:  * Name: d13x_i2c_initialize
394:  *
395:  * Description:
396:  *   初始化指定的 I2C 总线
397:  *
398:  ****************************************************************************/
399: 
400: int d13x_i2c_initialize(int bus)
401: {
402:   struct d13x_i2c_priv_s *priv;
403:   uint32_t reg;
404: 
405:   switch (bus)
406:     {
407: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
408:       case 0:
409:         priv = &g_i2c0_priv;
410:         break;
411: #endif
412: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
413:       case 1:
414:         priv = &g_i2c1_priv;
415:         break;
416: #endif
417: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
418:       case 2:
419:         priv = &g_i2c2_priv;
420:         break;
421: #endif
422:       default:
423:         return -EINVAL;
424:     }
425: 
426:   /* 使能 I2C 模块时钟 */
427: 
428:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
429:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
430:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x844 + bus * 4);
431: 
432:   /* 禁用 I2C 以配置 */
433: 
434:   dw_i2c_disable(priv);
435: 
436:   /* 配置为主模式, Fast Mode (400kHz), 重启使能 */
437: 
438:   reg = DW_I2C_CTL_MASTER | DW_I2C_CTL_SPEED_FS | DW_I2C_CTL_RESTART_EN;
439:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_CTL, reg);
440: 
441:   /* 配置 SCL 时序 (400kHz @ 24MHz APB0)
442:    * FS_SCL_HCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 8 = 22
443:    * FS_SCL_LCNT = 24000000 / (2 * 400000) - 1 = 29
444:    */
445: 
446:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_HCNT, 22);
447:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_FS_SCL_LCNT, 29);
448: 
449:   /* 设置 SDA 保持时间 */
450: 
451:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_SDA_HOLD, 12);
452: 
453:   /* 设置 TX/RX FIFO 阈值 */
454: 
455:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_CLR, 0xFFFF);
456:   dw_i2c_write(priv, DW_I2C_INTR_MASK, 0);
457: 
458:   /* 使能 I2C */
459: 
460:   dw_i2c_enable(priv);
461: 
462:   /* 初始化互斥锁 */
463: 
464:   nxmutex_init(&priv->lock);
465: 
466:   iinfo("I2C%d 初始化完成, 基地址=0x%08X\n", bus, priv->base);
467: 
468:   return OK;
469: }
470: 
471: /****************************************************************************
472:  * Name: d13x_i2c_get_bus
473:  *
474:  * Description:
475:  *   获取指定 I2C 总线的 master 接口
476:  *
477:  ****************************************************************************/
478: 
479: struct i2c_master_s *d13x_i2c_get_bus(int bus)
480: {
481:   switch (bus)
482:     {
483: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C0
484:       case 0:
485:         return &g_i2c0_priv.dev;
486: #endif
487: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C1
488:       case 1:
489:         return &g_i2c1_priv.dev;
490: #endif
491: #ifdef CONFIG_D13X_I2C2
492:       case 2:
493:         return &g_i2c2_priv.dev;
494: #endif
495:       default:
496:         return NULL;
497:     }
498: }

11.1.1. 概述¶

357:

GTC（General Timer Counter）通用计数器模块，其功能为CPU提供基础时钟。

358:

本模块输出计数值为52bits，计数的最高频率（基频）为4MHz，计数周期约为35年。

359:

因为计数模块的输出为52bits，而CPU输入为64bits，所以计数值高位寄存器的高12bit固定为0。

360:
361:

11.1.1.1. 特性说明¶

362:
    363:

  • 总线时钟PCLK的频率可选，但必须为4MHz的整数倍频，例如12MHz/24MHz/48MHz/60MHz等

    • 364:

  • 计数器最高计数频率（基频）为4MHz，计数精度为1/4MHz，即250ns

    • 365:

  • 计数时钟频率误差不超过10s/24h，约为100ppm

    • 366:

  • 计数器位宽为52bits，计数周期约35年

    • 367:

  • 计数频率可选，4MHz/1MHz/250KHz

    • 368:

  • 不同的计数频率，计数精度不变，例如4MHz每周期增加1，1MHz每周期增加4，250KHz则每周期增加16

    • 369:

  • 52bits计数值以格雷码（Gray Code）编码方式输出

    • 370:

  • 复位后模块计数从0开始，并且仅支持增量计数

    • 371:

12.5.1. 概述¶

365:
    366:

  • UART是一种与外围设备、数据载体设备、或者数据集等进行串行通信的接口。主处理器（CPU）通过APB总线将数据写到UART，数据转换成串行形式后传输到目标设备。UART也可以接收串行数据和存储，以供主处理器（CPU）读取。

    • 367:

  • UART包含着控制字符长度、波特率、奇偶校验以及生成中断的寄存器。尽管UART只有一个中断输出信号，但有几种优先级的中断类型可响应，每种中断类型都可以通过控制寄存器单独使能/未使能。

    • 368:

  • UART有16450以及16550两种工作模式，因此可与一系列标准软件驱动程序兼容。在16550模式中，数据的发送与接收都由FIFO缓存；而在16450模式中是禁用这些FIFO的。

    • 369:

  • UART支持5-8位的字长，一个可选的奇偶校验位，1/1.5/2个停止位，可通过CPU APB接口编程，包含16位可编程波特率发生器和8位暂存器，以及独立的发送和接收FIFO。提供八条调制解调器控制线和调试回环模式。

    • 370:

  • 中断可在发送缓冲/FIFO、接收缓冲/FIFO、调制解调器状态以及线路状态范围内生成。

    • 371:
372:
373:

12.5.1.1. 特性说明¶

374:
    375:

  • 兼容工业标准16550 UART

    • 376:

  • 256x8bit发送与接收FIFO

    • 377:

  • 传输速度可达3Mbps

    • 378:

  • 支持5-8数据位以及1/1.5/2停止位

    • 379:

  • 支持奇校验，偶校验或者无奇偶校验

    • 380:

  • 支持DMA控制器接口

    • 381:

  • 支持软件/硬件流控

    • 382:

  • 支持RS-485 9bit 模式

    • 383:

  • 支持RS-485硬件自动控制收发方向

    • 384:

12.6.1. 概述¶

365:

I2C模块是CPU主机与I2C总线之间的接口，包括一根串行数据线（SDA）和一根串行时钟线（SCL）。所有挂在I2C总线的设备之间都可进行通信，每个设备可通过唯一的地址被其他设备寻址建立通信，每个设备可作为发送者也可以作为接收者。此外，在通信期间设备也会分为master和slave，master可以发起数据传输以及生成时钟信号，被master寻址的则为slave。

366:
367:

12.6.1.1. 特性说明¶

368:
    369:

  • 支持master和slave模式

    • 370:

  • 支持最高400Kb/s传输

    • 371:

  • 支持7bit和10bit寻址

    • 372:

  • 支持时钟同步

    • 373:

  • 支持中断和轮询模式

    • 374:

  • 可编程SDA保持时间

    • 375:

  • 可编程防止I2C通信异常总线挂死

    • 376:

18: /****************************************************************************
19:  * Pre-processor Definitions
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21: 
22: /* CLIC 寄存器结构 (来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type)
23:  *
24:  * CLIC 基地址: 0x20800000
25:  * 每个中断源占 4 字节: IP(1B), IE(1B), ATTR(1B), CTL(1B)
26:  * CLICINT[] 数组起始偏移: 0x1000
27:  *
28:  * struct CLIC_Type {
29:  *   uint32_t CLICCFG;      // offset 0x000
30:  *   uint32_t CLICINFO;     // offset 0x004
31:  *   uint32_t MINTTHRESH;   // offset 0x008
32:  *   uint32_t RESERVED[1021];
33:  *   CLIC_INT_Control CLICINT[4096];  // offset 0x1000
34:  * };
35:  *
36:  * struct CLIC_INT_Control {
37:  *   uint8_t IP;    // offset +0x000 (pending)
38:  *   uint8_t IE;    // offset +0x001 (enable)
39:  *   uint8_t ATTR;  // offset +0x002 (attribute: vector/shv)
40:  *   uint8_t CTL;   // offset +0x003 (control: priority)
41:  * };
42:  */
43: 
44: #define D13X_CLIC_BASE         D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE   /* 0x20800000 */
45: #define D13X_CLIC_CFG          (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0000)
46: #define D13X_CLIC_INFO         (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0004)
47: #define D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH   (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0008)
48: #define D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE     (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x1000)  /* CLICINT[] 起始 */
49: 
50: /* 中断向量表地址（RISC-V 使用 __trap_vec） */
51: 
52: extern uint32_t __trap_vec[];
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * Private Functions
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: /****************************************************************************
59:  * Name: d13x_clic_set_irq
60:  *
61:  * Description:
62:  *   设置指定中断的 IE/IP/ATTR 寄存器
63:  *
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static inline void d13x_clic_enable_irq(int irq)
67: {
68:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 1 */
69: 
70:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
71:   *ie = 1;
72: }
73: 
74: static inline void d13x_clic_disable_irq(int irq)
75: {
76:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 0 */
77: 
78:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
79:   *ie = 0;
80: }
81: 
82: static inline void d13x_clic_clear_pending(int irq)
83: {
84:   /* CLICINT[irq].IP = 0 (W1C) */
85: 
86:   volatile uint8_t *ip = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 0);
87:   *ip = 0;
88: }
89: 
90: static inline void d13x_clic_set_attr(int irq, uint8_t attr)
91: {
92:   /* CLICINT[irq].ATTR = attr */
93: 
94:   volatile uint8_t *attrp = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 2);
95:   *attrp = attr;
96: }

99:  * Public Functions
100:  ****************************************************************************/
101:

103:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: void up_irqinitialize(void)
111: {
112:   int i;
113: 
114:   /* 配置 mtvec (mode 3) + mtvt 双 CSR */
115: 
116:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x3;
117:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
118: 
119:   /* mtvt CSR (T-Head 扩展，CSR 编号 0x7C0) */
120: 
121:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
122:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7C0, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
123: 
124:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
125: 
126:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
127: 
128:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
129:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
130: 
131:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
132:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
133: 
134:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
135: 
136:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
139:     {
140:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
141:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 1);  /* use vector interrupt */
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
145: 
146:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x3);
147: 
148:   /* 使能全局中断 */
149: 
150:   up_irq_enable();
151: }

188: {

192: 
193:   irq = (int)(mcause & 0x7FFFFFFF);
194: 
195:   /* 调用中断处理函数 */
196: 
197:   irq_dispatch(irq, regs);
198: 
199:   return regs;
200: }

217: 
218:   /* 使能中断 */

222:   return flags;

12: #include <rtthread.h>
13: #include <rtdevice.h>
14: #include "gt911.h"
15: 
16: #define THREAD_PRIORITY   25
17: #define THREAD_STACK_SIZE 1024
18: #define THREAD_TIMESLICE  5
19: 
20: static rt_thread_t  gt911_thread = RT_NULL;
21: static rt_sem_t     gt911_sem = RT_NULL;
22: static rt_device_t  dev = RT_NULL;
23: static struct rt_touch_data *read_data;
24: static struct rt_touch_info info;
25: 
26: static void gt911_entry(void *parameter)
27: {
28:     rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO, &info);
29: 
30:     read_data = (struct rt_touch_data *)rt_malloc(sizeof(struct rt_touch_data) * info.point_num);
31: 
32:     while (1)
33:     {
34:         rt_sem_take(gt911_sem, RT_WAITING_FOREVER);
35: 
36:         if (rt_device_read(dev, 0, read_data, info.point_num) == info.point_num)
37:         {
38:             for (rt_uint8_t i = 0; i < info.point_num; i++)
39:             {
40:                 if (read_data[i].event == RT_TOUCH_EVENT_DOWN || read_data[i].event == RT_TOUCH_EVENT_MOVE)
41:                 {
42:                     rt_kprintf("%d %d %d %d %d\n", read_data[i].track_id,
43:                                read_data[i].x_coordinate,
44:                                read_data[i].y_coordinate,
45:                                read_data[i].timestamp,
46:                                read_data[i].width);
47:                 }
48:             }
49:         }
50:         rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_ENABLE_INT, RT_NULL);
51:     }
52: }
53: 
54: static rt_err_t rx_callback(rt_device_t dev, rt_size_t size)
55: {
56:     rt_sem_release(gt911_sem);
57:     rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_DISABLE_INT, RT_NULL);
58:     return 0;
59: }
60: 
61: /* Test function */
62: static void test_gt911(void *parameter)
63: {
64:     void *id;
65: 
66:     dev = rt_device_find("gt911");
67:     if (dev == RT_NULL)
68:     {
69:         rt_kprintf("can't find device:%s\n", "gt911");
70:         return;
71:     }
72: 
73:     if (rt_device_open(dev, RT_DEVICE_FLAG_INT_RX) != RT_EOK)
74:     {
75:         rt_kprintf("open device failed!");
76:         return;
77:     }
78: 
79:     id = rt_malloc(sizeof(rt_uint8_t) * 8);
80:     rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_ID, id);
81:     rt_uint8_t * read_id = (rt_uint8_t *)id;
82:     rt_kprintf("id = GT%d%d%d \n", read_id[0] - '0', read_id[1] - '0', read_id[2] - '0');
83:     // rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_X_RANGE, &x);  /* if possible you can set your x y coordinate*/
84:     // rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_SET_Y_RANGE, &y);
85:     rt_device_control(dev, RT_TOUCH_CTRL_GET_INFO, id);
86:     rt_kprintf("range_x = %d \n", (*(struct rt_touch_info*)id).range_x);
87:     rt_kprintf("range_y = %d \n", (*(struct rt_touch_info*)id).range_y);
88:     rt_kprintf("point_num = %d \n", (*(struct rt_touch_info*)id).point_num);
89:     rt_free(id);
90: 
91:     rt_device_set_rx_indicate(dev, rx_callback);
92:     gt911_sem = rt_sem_create("dsem", 0, RT_IPC_FLAG_FIFO);
93:     if (gt911_sem == RT_NULL)
94:     {
95:         rt_kprintf("create dynamic semaphore failed.\n");
96:         return;
97:     }
98: 
99:     gt911_thread = rt_thread_create("gt911",
100:                                      gt911_entry,
101:                                      RT_NULL,
102:                                      THREAD_STACK_SIZE,
103:                                      THREAD_PRIORITY,
104:                                      THREAD_TIMESLICE);
105: 
106:     if (gt911_thread != RT_NULL)
107:         rt_thread_startup(gt911_thread);
108: 
109:     return;
110: }
111: MSH_CMD_EXPORT(test_gt911, test gt911 sample);

61:  * Name: mipi_dsi_transfer
62:  *
63:  * Description:
64:  *   Transfer message to display modules
65:  *
66:  * Input Parameters:
67:  *   device - DSI peripheral
68:  *   msg - Message to transfer
69:  *
70:  * Returned Value:
71:  *   The number of bytes successfully transfered or a negative error code on
72:  *   failure.
73:  *
74:  ****************************************************************************/
75: 
76: ssize_t mipi_dsi_transfer(FAR struct mipi_dsi_device *device,
77:                           FAR struct mipi_dsi_msg *msg)
78: {
79:   FAR const struct mipi_dsi_host_ops *ops = device->host->ops;
80: 
81:   if (ops == NULL || ops->transfer == NULL)
82:     {
83:       return -ENOSYS;
84:     }
85: 
86:   if ((device->mode_flags & MIPI_DSI_MODE_LPM) != 0)
87:     {
88:       msg->flags |= MIPI_DSI_MSG_USE_LPM;
89:     }
90: 
91:   if ((device->mode_flags & MIPI_DSI_MODE_AFTER_FRAME) != 0)
92:     {
93:       msg->flags |= MIPI_DSI_MSG_AFTER_FRAME;
94:     }
95: 
96:   return ops->transfer(device->host, msg);
97: }

420:                                   FAR const void *data,
421:                                   size_t len)

448: /****************************************************************************
449:  * Name: mipi_dsi_dcs_write
450:  *
451:  * Description:
452:  *   Send DCS write command.
453:  *   This function will automatically choose the right data type depending on
454:  *   the command payload length.
455:  *
456:  * Input Parameters:
457:  *   device - DSI peripheral device
458:  *   cmd - DCS command
459:  *   data - buffer containing the command payload
460:  *   len - command payload length
461:  *
462:  * Returned Value:
463:  *   The number of bytes successfully transmitted or a negative error
464:  *   code on failure.
465:  *
466:  ****************************************************************************/
467: 
468: ssize_t mipi_dsi_dcs_write(FAR struct mipi_dsi_device *device,
469:                            uint8_t cmd,
470:                            FAR const void *data,
471:                            size_t len)
472: {
473:   ssize_t ret;
474:   uint8_t stack_tx[8];
475:   FAR uint8_t *tx = stack_tx;
476: 
477:   if (len > sizeof(stack_tx) - 1)
478:     {
479:       tx = kmm_malloc(len + 1);
480:       if (tx == NULL)
481:         {
482:           return -ENOMEM;
483:         }
484:     }
485: 
486:   /* concatenate the DCS command byte and the payload */
487: 
488:   tx[0] = cmd;
489:   if (data != NULL)
490:     {
491:       memcpy(&tx[1], data, len);
492:     }
493: 
494:   ret = mipi_dsi_dcs_write_buffer(device, tx, len + 1);
495: 
496:   if (tx != stack_tx)
497:     {
498:       kmm_free(tx);
499:     }
500: 
501:   return ret;
502: }

4:  * D13x RISC-V 启动汇编 (来源: NuttX rv32m1_head.S 模式 + luban-lite startup_gcc.S)

10: #include <arch/irq.h>
11: #include "chip.h"
12:

14:   .global _sbss
15:   .global _ebss

18:   .global _eronly

23:  * __start - 复位入口点

25: 
26: __start:
27: 
28:   /* 禁用全局中断 */
29: 
30:   csrci mstatus, 0x8
31:   csrw mie, zero
32: 
33:   /* 初始化 GP 寄存器 (来源: luban-lite startup_gcc.S) */
34: 
35:   .option push
36:   .option norelax
37:   la    gp, __global_pointer$
38:   .option pop
39: 
40:   /* 设置栈指针到 IDLE 线程栈顶 */
41: 
42:   la    sp, _ebss
43:   li    t0, CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE
44:   add   sp, sp, t0
45:   andi  sp, sp, ~0x7
46: 
47:   /* 清零 BSS 段 */
48: 
49:   la    t0, _sbss
50:   la    t1, _ebss
51: .Lclear_bss:
52:   bgeu  t0, t1, .Lbss_done
53:   sw    zero, 0(t0)
54:   addi  t0, t0, 4
55:   j     .Lclear_bss
56: .Lbss_done:
57: 
58:   /* 拷贝 .data 段 (从 Flash 到 SRAM) */
59: 
60:   la    t0, _eronly      /* Flash 中 .data 的加载地址 */
61:   la    t1, _sdata       /* SRAM 中 .data 的目标地址 */
62:   la    t2, _edata
63: .Lcopy_data:
64:   bgeu  t1, t2, .Ldata_done
65:   lw    t3, 0(t0)
66:   sw    t3, 0(t1)
67:   addi  t0, t0, 4
68:   addi  t1, t1, 4
69:   j     .Lcopy_data
70: .Ldata_done:
71: 
72:   /* 跳转到 NuttX C 入口 (artinchip_start.c 中的 __start_c) */
73: 
74:   jal   x1, __start_c
75:

5.1. CPU¶

353:

CPU内核采用平头哥E907，是一款基于RISC-V指令集的高性能嵌入式微处理器。

354:
355:

5.1.1. 特性说明¶

356:
    357:

  • RV32IMAFDCP 指令集

    • 358:

  • 单双精度浮点单元

    • 359:

  • 5级单发按序执行流水线

    • 360:

  • 一级哈佛结构，ICACHE 32KB，DCACHE 32KB，缓存行大小为32字节

    • 361:

  • 支持紧耦合存储(TCM)，系统SRAM可切换为TCM，I/DTCM最大可配置128KB

    • 362:

  • PMP物理内存保护单元

    • 363:

  • 核内中断CLINT和中断控制器CLIC，支持中断嵌套

    • 364:

  • 支持平头哥 MCU 特性扩展技术，包括中断处理加速技术、MCU扩展特性

    • 365:

  • 机器模式和用户模式

    • 366:

  • 标准2线JTAG调试接口

42:     u32 pixclk = comp->panel->timings->pixelclock;
43: 
44:     hal_clk_set_freq(CLK_PLL_FRA2, comp->pll_disp_rate);
45:     hal_clk_set_rate(CLK_SCLK, comp->sclk_rate, comp->pll_disp_rate);
46:     hal_clk_set_rate(CLK_PIX, pixclk, comp->sclk_rate);
47: 
48:     hal_clk_enable(CLK_PLL_FRA2);
49:     hal_clk_enable(CLK_SCLK);
50:     hal_clk_enable(CLK_MIPIDSI);
51: 
52:     hal_reset_deassert(RESET_MIPIDSI);
53: 
54:     aic_dsi_release_drvdata();
55:     return 0;
56: }

58: static int aic_dsi_clk_disable(void)
59: {

61:

63:     hal_clk_disable(CLK_SCLK);
64:     return 0;

68: {
69:     struct aic_dsi_comp *comp = aic_dsi_request_drvdata();
70:     struct panel_dsi *dsi = comp->panel->dsi;
71:     ulong lp_rate = MIPI_DSI_LP_RATE;
72: 
73:     reg_set_bit(comp->regs + DSI_CTL, DSI_CTL_EN);
74: 
75:     dsi_set_lane_assign(comp->regs, comp->ln_assign);
76:     dsi_set_lane_polrs(comp->regs, comp->ln_polrs);
77:     dsi_set_data_clk_polrs(comp->regs, comp->dc_inv);
78: 
79:     if (lp_rate < 10000000 || lp_rate > 20000000) {
80:         lp_rate = 10000000;
81:         pr_warn("Invalid lp rate, use default lp rate: %ld\n", lp_rate);
82:     }
83: 
84:     dsi_set_clk_div(comp->regs, comp->sclk_rate, lp_rate);
85:     dsi_pkg_init(comp->regs);
86:     dsi_phy_init(comp->regs, comp->sclk_rate, dsi->lane_num);
87:     dsi_hs_clk(comp->regs, 1);
88: 
89:     aic_dsi_release_drvdata();
90:     return 0;
91: }

98: static int aic_dsi_attach_panel(struct aic_panel *panel)
99: {
100:     struct aic_dsi_comp *comp = aic_dsi_request_drvdata();
101:     u32 div[DSI_MAX_LANE_NUM] = {24, 24, 18, 16};
102:     u32 pixclk = panel->timings->pixelclock;
103:     struct panel_dsi *dsi = panel->dsi;
104:     u64 pll_disp_rate = 0;
105:     int i = 0;
106: 
107:     comp->panel = panel;
108: 
109:     if (dsi->lane_num <= DSI_MAX_LANE_NUM)
110:     {
111:         comp->sclk_rate = pixclk * div[dsi->format] / dsi->lane_num;
112:     }
113:     else
114:     {
115:         pr_err("Invalid lane number %d\n", dsi->lane_num);
116:         return -EINVAL;
117:     }
118: 
119:     pll_disp_rate = comp->sclk_rate;
120:     while (pll_disp_rate < PLL_DISP_FREQ_MIN)
121:     {
122:         pll_disp_rate = comp->sclk_rate * (2 << i);
123:         i++;
124:     }
125:     comp->pll_disp_rate = pll_disp_rate;
126: 
127:     comp->ln_assign = LANE_ASSIGNMENTS;
128:     comp->ln_polrs = LANE_POLARITIES;
129:     comp->dc_inv = CLK_INVERSE;
130: 
131:     aic_dsi_release_drvdata();
132:     return 0;
133: }

140:     if (enable) {

142:         dsi_set_vm(comp->regs, dsi->mode, dsi->format,
143:             dsi->lane_num, comp->vc_num, timing);
144:     } else {
145:         dsi_set_vm(comp->regs, DSI_MOD_CMD_MODE, dsi->format,
146:             dsi->lane_num, comp->vc_num, timing);

150:                 (u8[]){ MIPI_DCS_GET_DISPLAY_ID }, 1);

152: 
153:         pr_info("mipi-dsi screen id: %x\n", readl(comp->regs + DSI_GEN_PD_CFG));
154: #endif

159: }

简介¶

336:

D13x 系列是一款高性能的显示交互和智能控制MCU，采用国产自主高算力RISC-V 内核， 337: 内置片上256KB~1MB大容量SRAM以及32Mb/64Mb PSRAM，并提供丰富的互联外设接口，配备了2D 图像加速引擎和PNG解码/JPEG编解码引擎， 338: 可以满足各类交互设计场景和多媒体互动需求，具有高可靠性、高安全性、高开放度的特点，可以面向于泛工业领域应用。

CMU(Clock Management Unit)用于配置系统时钟，包括PLL频率和展频， AXI/AHB/APB总线时钟，各 358: 模块输入时钟，以及IO输出时钟等等。

359:
360:

8.1.1.1. 特性说明¶

361:
    362:

  • 两种锁相环共4个PLL

    • 363:

  • PLL_INT 2个，无小数分频和展频功能，可旁路直接输出OSC_24M时钟

    • 364:

  • PLL_FRA 2个，带小数分频和展频功能，可旁路直接输出OSC_24M时钟

    • 365:

  • CPU时钟可选OSC_24M或PLL_INT0进行1~32分频

    • 366:

  • AXI/AHB0/APB0时钟可选OSC_24M或PLL_INT1进行1~32除频，APB1使用OSC_24M时钟

    • 367:

  • 每个模块固定时钟如1.1.2图所示，模块时钟可选1~32除频

    • 368:

  • 每个模块总线时钟、模块时钟、复位三个开关可独立配置

    • 369:

  • 4路可配置频率时钟输出，用作于外设的时钟输入

    • 370:
