166: static inline void xspi_wait_idle(void)
167: {
168:   while (getreg32(XSPI_STAS) & STAS_BUSY);
169: }
170: 
171: static void d13x_clock_init(void)
172: {
173:   uint32_t reg;
174: 
175:   /* 1. 打开 24MHz 振荡器 */
176: 
177:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_IN);
178:   reg |= (1 << 1);
179:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_IN);
180: 
181:   /* 2. PLL 公共电路 LDO */
182: 
183:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_COM);
184:   reg |= (1 << 31) | (1 << 0);
185:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_COM);
186: 
187:   /* 3. 使能 PLL_INT1 → 1.2GHz (N=49) */
188: 
189:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
190:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
191:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN);
192:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT1_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
193: 
194:   /* 4. 使能 PLL_INT0 → 480MHz (N=19) */
195: 
196:   reg = getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
197:   reg &= ~PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_MASK;
198:   reg |= (19 << PLL_GEN_FACTOR_N_SHIFT);
199:   reg |= PLL_GEN_ENABLE;
200:   putreg32(reg, CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN);
201:   while (!(getreg32(CMU_PLL_INT0_GEN) & PLL_GEN_LOCK_BIT));
202: 
203:   /* 5. AXI/AHB = 200MHz (PLL_INT1/(5+1)) */
204: 
205:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 5, CMU_CLK_AXI_AHB);
206: 
207:   /* 6. APB0 = 100MHz (PLL_INT1/(11+1)) */
208: 
209:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT1 | 11, CMU_CLK_APB0);
210: 
211:   /* 7. CPU = 480MHz (PLL_INT0/1) */
212: 
213:   putreg32(CLK_SRC_PLL_INT0 | 0, CMU_CLK_CPU);
214: 
215:   /* 8. GPIO 时钟 */
216: 
217:   reg = getreg32(CMU_CLK_GPIO);
218:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12);
219:   putreg32(reg, CMU_CLK_GPIO);
220: 
221:   /* 9. UART0 = 60MHz (PLL_INT1/(19+1)), 含 MOD_BUS_EN */
222: 
223:   putreg32(UART_CLK_MOD_RSTN | UART_CLK_MOD_BUS_EN | UART_CLK_MOD_CLK_EN | 19,
224:            CMU_CLK_UART0);
225: }
226: 
227: static void d13x_uart_init(void)
228: {
229:   uint32_t divisor;
230: 
231:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
232:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
233:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
234:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
235:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
236:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
237:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
238:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
239:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
240: }
241: 
242: /****************************************************************************
243:  * PSRAM 驱动 (LUT-based XSPI 控制器)
244:  * 来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_v1.0.h + hal_xspi.c + xspi_psram.c
245:  ****************************************************************************/
246: 
247: static uint32_t d13x_psram_read_efuse(uint32_t reg_addr)
248: {
249:   putreg32(0x1100, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
250:   uint32_t val = getreg32(reg_addr);
251:   putreg32(0x0, EFUSE_CMU_REG);
252:   return val;
253: }
254: 
255: static uint32_t d13x_psram_get_size(void)
256: {
257:   uint32_t fuse_218 = d13x_psram_read_efuse(EFUSE_218_REG);
258:   uint8_t mark_id = fuse_218 & 0xFF;
259: 
260:   switch (mark_id)
261:     {
262:       case 0x00: return 0;
263:       case 0x01: return 4 * 1024 * 1024;
264:       case 0x02: case 0x03: case 0x04: case 0x05:
265:       case 0xA1: case 0xA2:
266:         return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
267:       case 0x06: case 0x07:
268:         return 16 * 1024 * 1024;
269:       default: return 8 * 1024 * 1024;
270:     }
271: }
272: 
273: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 (同步 CPU 模式)
274:  * LUT 编码: 每个条目 32 位, 包含两阶段 (ins_h/io_h/op_h + ins_l/io_l/op_l)
275:  */
276: 
277: static void d13x_xspi_lut_write(int lut_id,
278:                                  int ins_l, int io_l, int op_l,
279:                                  int ins_h, int io_h, int op_h)
280: {
281:   uint32_t entry = LUT_ENTRY(ins_h, io_h, op_h, ins_l, io_l, op_l);
282:   putreg32(entry, XSPI_LUTN(lut_id));
283: }
284: 
285: static void d13x_xspi_lut_update(void)
286: {
287:   putreg32(1, XSPI_LUT_UP);
288: }
289: 
290: static void __attribute__((unused)) d13x_xspi_lut_lock(int lock)
291: {
292:   putreg32(lock ? LUT_LOCK : LUT_UNLOCK, XSPI_LCKCR);
293: }
294: 
295: static void d13x_xspi_trigger(int lut_id)
296: {
297:   xspi_wait_idle();
298:   putreg32(lut_id, XSPI_START);
299:   xspi_wait_idle();
300: }
301: 
302: /* 通过 LUT 执行 PSRAM 命令 */
303: 
304: static void d13x_psram_write_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t mr_val)
305: {
306:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xC0 (WRITE_MR) on 1-line */
307:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xC0, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
308:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
309:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
310:   /* LUT[2]: WRITE 1-byte on 1-line */
311:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_WRITE, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
312:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
313: 
314:   /* 设置地址 = MR 地址 */
315: 
316:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
317: 
318:   /* 写入数据到 TDR */
319: 
320:   putreg32((uint32_t)mr_val, XSPI_TDR);
321: 
322:   /* 触发 LUT 序列: LUT[0] → LUT[1] → LUT[2] → STOP */
323: 
324:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
325: }
326: 
327: static void d13x_psram_read_mr(uint8_t mr_addr, uint8_t *mr_val)
328: {
329:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0x40 (READ_MR) on 1-line */
330:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0x40, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
331:   /* LUT[1]: ADDR 1-byte on 1-line */
332:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(1, LUT_ADDR, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
333:   /* LUT[2]: READ 1-byte on 1-line */
334:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(2, LUT_READ, LUT_IO_1, 1, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
335:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
336: 
337:   putreg32(mr_addr, XSPI_ADDR);
338:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
339: 
340:   *mr_val = (uint8_t)getreg32(XSPI_RDR);
341: }
342: 
343: static void d13x_psram_device_reset(void)
344: {
345:   /* LUT[0]: CMD 0xFF (RESET) on 1-line */
346: 
347:   d13x_xspi_lut_write(0, LUT_CMD, LUT_IO_1, 0xFF, LUT_STOP, 0, 0);
348:   d13x_xspi_lut_update();
349:   d13x_xspi_trigger(0);
350: }
351: 
352: static void d13x_psram_device_init(void)
353: {
354:   uint8_t mr4;
355: 
356:   /* 读取 MR4 检查当前配置 */
357: 
358:   d13x_psram_read_mr(0x04, &mr4);
359: 
360:   /* 配置 MR0: Burst Length = 32, Latency = 3 */
361: 
362:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x00, 0x19);
363: 
364:   /* 配置 MR4: 使能 XIP */
365: 
366:   d13x_psram_write_mr(0x04, 0x80);
367: }
368: 
369: static void d13x_psram_xip_enable(void)
370: {
371:   uint32_t ctl;
372: 
373:   /* 配置 XIP LUT (OPI 模式下的 XIP 读/写序列)
374:    * LUT[16]: XIP READ (OPI 8-line, DDR)
375:    * LUT[0]:  XIP WRITE (OPI 8-line, DDR)
376:    * 这里使用简化配置: 启用 XIP 位, 由硬件处理 LUT 路由
377:    */
378: 
379:   /* 使能 XIP (CTL bit2) */
380: 
381:   xspi_wait_idle();
382:   ctl = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
383:   ctl |= CTL_XIP_EN;
384:   putreg32(ctl, XSPI_CTL);
385: }
386: 
387: static uint32_t d13x_psram_verify(void)
388: {
389:   volatile uint32_t *psram = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_PSRAM_BASE;
390:   uint32_t psram_size = d13x_psram_get_size();
391: 
392:   if (psram_size == 0)
393:     return 0;
394: 
395:   psram[0] = 0x12345678;
396:   psram[1] = 0x9ABCDEF0;
397: 
398:   if (psram[0] != 0x12345678)
399:     return 0;
400:   if (psram[1] != 0x9ABCDEF0)
401:     return 0;
402: 
403:   psram[0] = 0;
404:   psram[1] = 0;
405:   return psram_size;
406: }
407: 
408: static void d13x_psram_init(void)
409: {
410:   uint32_t reg;
411: 
412:   /* 首先验证 PSRAM 是否已由 bootloader 初始化 */
413: 
414:   if (d13x_psram_verify() > 0)
415:     return;
416: 
417:   /* 1. 使能 XSPI 时钟 (CMU_BASE + 0x45C) */
418: 
419:   reg = getreg32(D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
420:   reg |= (1 << 13) | (1 << 12) | (1 << 8);
421:   putreg32(reg, D13X_CMU_BASE + 0x45C);
422: 
423:   /* 2. 复位 XSPI 控制器 (写 0 到 CTL) */
424: 
425:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CTL);
426: 
427:   /* 3. 配置 XSPI 控制器 (来源: luban-lite hal_xspi_init) */
428: 
429:   /* 时钟分频: div=0 → 最高频率 */
430: 
431:   putreg32(0, XSPI_CLK);
432: 
433:   /* TCR: 写保持=8, 读保持=2 */
434: 
435:   xspi_wait_idle();
436:   putreg32((8 << 16) | (2 << 20), XSPI_TCR);
437: 
438:   /* XSPI 模式 = OPI (bits[5:4] = 2) */
439: 
440:   xspi_wait_idle();
441:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
442:   reg |= (XSPI_MODE_OPI << CTL_XSPI_MODE_SHIFT);
443:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
444: 
445:   /* 使能 wrap burst split */
446: 
447:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
448:   reg |= CTL_AXI_BURST;
449:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
450: 
451:   /* Boundary = 1K */
452: 
453:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
454:   reg |= CTL_BOUNDARY_EN | CTL_BOUNDARY_CTL;
455:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
456: 
457:   /* IO 驱动配置 */
458: 
459:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG1);
460:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG2);
461:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG3);
462:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS0_IOCFG4);
463:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG1);
464:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG2);
465:   putreg32(0x36363636, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG3);
466:   putreg32(0x37, XSPI_CS1_IOCFG4);
467: 
468:   /* DLL 配置 (来源: luban-lite xspi_hw_set_dll_ctl) */
469: 
470:   /* CS0 DLL: ICP=150-200MHz, Phase=90度 */
471: 
472:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
473:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);  /* ICP_150_200M, phase_90b, LDO, LVS */
474:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
475: 
476:   /* 使能 DLL/VCDL/CP, 禁用 BYPASS */
477: 
478:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);  /* EN_DLL, EN_VCDL, EN_CP */
479:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);  /* EN_BYPASS = 0 */
480:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS0_DCTL);
481: 
482:   /* CS1 DLL: 同上 */
483: 
484:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
485:   reg |= (2 << 12) | (3 << 8) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 5);
486:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
487:   reg |= (1 << 0) | (1 << 1) | (1 << 2);
488:   reg &= ~(1 << 3);
489:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CS1_DCTL);
490: 
491:   /* 4. 使能 XSPI 模块 */
492: 
493:   xspi_wait_idle();
494:   reg = getreg32(XSPI_CTL);
495:   reg |= CTL_XSPI_EN;
496:   putreg32(reg, XSPI_CTL);
497: 
498:   /* 5. 复位 PSRAM 设备 */
499: 
500:   d13x_psram_device_reset();
501: 
502:   /* 6. 配置 PSRAM 模式寄存器 */
503: 
504:   d13x_psram_device_init();
505: 
506:   /* 7. 使能 XIP 模式 */
507: 
508:   d13x_psram_xip_enable();
509: 
510:   /* 8. 验证 */
511: 
512:   d13x_psram_verify();
513: }
514:

23: static int d13x_uart0_handler(int irq, FAR void *context, FAR void *arg)
24: {
25:   FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev = arg;
26: 
27:   /* 处理接收中断: 使用 NuttX 标准 API 读取数据入缓冲区
28:    * uart_recvchars 内部调用 dev->ops->receive 循环读取
29:    */
30: 
31:   uart_recvchars(dev);
32: 
33:   return OK;

36: static int d13x_uart_setup(FAR struct uart_dev_s *dev)
37: {
38:   uint32_t divisor;
39: 
40:   divisor = D13X_UART0_FREQ / (16 * D13X_UART0_BAUDRATE);
41: 
42:   /* 等待 UART 空闲 (来源: User Manual §12.4) */
43: 
44:   UART_WAIT_IDLE(D13X_UART0_BASE);
45: 
46:   /* 禁用中断 */
47: 
48:   putreg32(0, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
49: 
50:   /* 设置 DLAB=1 以访问 DLL/DLH */
51: 
52:   putreg32(UART_LCR_DLAB, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
53: 
54:   /* 写入波特率除数 */
55: 
56:   putreg32(divisor & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
57:   putreg32((divisor >> 8) & 0xFF, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
58: 
59:   /* 使能 FIFO, 清除 DLAB, 设置 8N1 */
60: 
61:   putreg32(UART_FCR_FIFOE | UART_FCR_RFIFOR | UART_FCR_XFIFOR,
62:            D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_FCR_IIR);
63:   putreg32(0x03, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LCR);
64: 
65:   return OK;
66: }

100: {
101:   /* 使能/禁用接收中断 */
102: 
103:   uint32_t ier = getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);
104: 
105:   if (enable)
106:     {
107:       ier |= 0x01;
108:     }
109:   else
110:     {
111:       ier &= ~0x01;
112:     }
113: 
114:   putreg32(ier, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_DLH_IER);

123: {
124:   while (!(getreg32(D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_LSR) & UART_LSR_THRE));
125:   putreg32((uint32_t)ch, D13X_UART0_BASE + UART_RBR_THR_DLL);
126: }

138: {

2:  * vendor/artinchip/chips/d13x/artinchip_irq.c
3:  *
4:  * D13x 中断系统适配（CLIC 中断控制器）
5:  * CLIC 寄存器来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type 结构体
6:  *
7:  ****************************************************************************/
8: 
9: /****************************************************************************
10:  * Included Files
11:  ****************************************************************************/
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/config.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
16: #include "chip.h"
17: 
18: /****************************************************************************
19:  * Pre-processor Definitions
20:  ****************************************************************************/
21: 
22: /* CLIC 寄存器结构 (来源: luban-lite core_rv32.h CLIC_Type)
23:  *
24:  * CLIC 基地址: 0x20800000
25:  * 每个中断源占 4 字节: IP(1B), IE(1B), ATTR(1B), CTL(1B)
26:  * CLICINT[] 数组起始偏移: 0x1000
27:  *
28:  * struct CLIC_Type {
29:  *   uint32_t CLICCFG;      // offset 0x000
30:  *   uint32_t CLICINFO;     // offset 0x004
31:  *   uint32_t MINTTHRESH;   // offset 0x008
32:  *   uint32_t RESERVED[1021];
33:  *   CLIC_INT_Control CLICINT[4096];  // offset 0x1000
34:  * };
35:  *
36:  * struct CLIC_INT_Control {
37:  *   uint8_t IP;    // offset +0x000 (pending)
38:  *   uint8_t IE;    // offset +0x001 (enable)
39:  *   uint8_t ATTR;  // offset +0x002 (attribute: vector/shv)
40:  *   uint8_t CTL;   // offset +0x003 (control: priority)
41:  * };
42:  */
43: 
44: #define D13X_CLIC_BASE         D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE   /* 0x20800000 */
45: #define D13X_CLIC_CFG          (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0000)
46: #define D13X_CLIC_INFO         (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0004)
47: #define D13X_CLIC_MINTTHRESH   (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x0008)
48: #define D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE     (D13X_CLIC_BASE + 0x1000)  /* CLICINT[] 起始 */
49: 
50: /* 中断向量表地址（RISC-V 使用 __trap_vec） */
51: 
52: extern uint32_t __trap_vec[];
53: 
54: /****************************************************************************
55:  * Private Functions
56:  ****************************************************************************/
57: 
58: /****************************************************************************
59:  * Name: d13x_clic_set_irq
60:  *
61:  * Description:
62:  *   设置指定中断的 IE/IP/ATTR 寄存器
63:  *
64:  ****************************************************************************/
65: 
66: static inline void d13x_clic_enable_irq(int irq)
67: {
68:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 1 */
69: 
70:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
71:   *ie = 1;
72: }
73: 
74: static inline void d13x_clic_disable_irq(int irq)
75: {
76:   /* CLICINT[irq].IE = 0 */
77: 
78:   volatile uint8_t *ie = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 1);
79:   *ie = 0;
80: }
81: 
82: static inline void d13x_clic_clear_pending(int irq)
83: {
84:   /* CLICINT[irq].IP = 0 (W1C) */
85: 
86:   volatile uint8_t *ip = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 0);
87:   *ip = 0;
88: }
89: 
90: static inline void d13x_clic_set_attr(int irq, uint8_t attr)
91: {
92:   /* CLICINT[irq].ATTR = attr */
93: 
94:   volatile uint8_t *attrp = (volatile uint8_t *)(D13X_CLIC_INT_BASE + irq * 4 + 2);
95:   *attrp = attr;
96: }
97: 
98: /****************************************************************************
99:  * Public Functions
100:  ****************************************************************************/
101: 
102: /****************************************************************************
103:  * Name: up_irqinitialize
104:  *
105:  * Description:
106:  *   Initialize the interrupt subsystem
107:  *
108:  ****************************************************************************/
109: 
110: void up_irqinitialize(void)
111: {
112:   int i;
113: 
114:   /* 配置 mtvec (mode 3) + mtvt 双 CSR */
115: 
116:   uint32_t mtvec = (uint32_t)__trap_vec | 0x3;
117:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw mtvec, %0" :: "r"(mtvec));
118: 
119:   /* mtvt CSR (T-Head 扩展，CSR 编号 0x7C0) */
120: 
121:   uint32_t mtvt = (uint32_t)__trap_vec;
122:   __asm__ __volatile__("csrw 0x7C0, %0" :: "r"(mtvt));
123: 
124:   /* 初始化 CLIC 中断控制器 (来源: luban-lite system.c SystemInit) */
125: 
126:   /* 读取 CLIC 配置信息 */
127: 
128:   volatile uint32_t *cliccfg = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_CFG;
129:   volatile uint32_t *clicinfo = (volatile uint32_t *)D13X_CLIC_INFO;
130: 
131:   uint32_t info = *clicinfo;
132:   uint32_t nlbits = (info >> 21) & 0xF;
133: 
134:   *cliccfg = (nlbits << 1) & 0x1E;
135: 
136:   /* 初始化所有中断: 清除 pending, 使能向量中断 */
137: 
138:   for (i = 0; i < MAX_IRQn; i++)
139:     {
140:       d13x_clic_clear_pending(i);
141:       d13x_clic_set_attr(i, 1);  /* use vector interrupt */
142:     }
143: 
144:   /* tspend 使用正向中断 (来源: luban-lite system.c) */
145: 
146:   d13x_clic_set_attr(Machine_Software_IRQn, 0x3);
147: 
148:   /* 使能全局中断 */
149: 
150:   up_irq_enable();
151: }
152:

154:  * Name: up_enable_irq
155:  *
156:  * Description:
157:  *   Enable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
158:  *
159:  ****************************************************************************/
160: 
161: void up_enable_irq(int irq)
162: {
163:   d13x_clic_enable_irq(irq);
164: }

167:  * Name: up_disable_irq
168:  *
169:  * Description:
170:  *   Disable the interrupt specified by 'irq'
171:  *
172:  ****************************************************************************/
173: 
174: void up_disable_irq(int irq)
175: {
176:   d13x_clic_disable_irq(irq);
177: }

179: /****************************************************************************
180:  * Name: riscv_dispatch_irq
181:  *
182:  * Description:
183:  *   Process interrupt and dispatch to registered handler
184:  *
185:  ****************************************************************************/
186: 
187: void *riscv_dispatch_irq(uint32_t mcause, uint32_t *regs)
188: {

Clock enabled at CMU+0x844 with bits 13,12,8 set (RSTN+BUS_EN+CLK_EN). **HCNT=22**: FS_SCL_HCNT = 24MHz/(2*400kHz) - 8 = 30-8 = 22. **LCNT=29**: FS_SCL_LCNT = 24MHz/(2*400kHz) - 1 = 30-1 = 29. SCL low period = (29+1)/24MHz = 1.25 us, which is below the I2C Fast Mode minimum of 1.3 us per the I2C spec. This is marginally non-compliant, though the same values are used in the vendor's luban-lite reference. |
| 9 | GPIO configuration | WARNING | GPIO clock enabled in `d13x_clock_init()` with bits 13+12 only (`(1<<13)|(1<<12)`), which sets MOD_RSTN and MOD_BUS_EN. **Bit 8 (MOD_CLK_EN) is missing** -- compare with I2C clock enable which sets all three bits (13,12,8). Per the CMU docs, each module has independent bus clock, module clock, and reset controls. Without bit 8, the GPIO module clock may not be active, potentially causing GPIO register access issues. |
| 10 | Interrupt controller (CLIC) | PASS | CLIC at `0x20800000` matches `D13X_E907_CLIC_BASE`. `NR_IRQS=128`, `MAX_IRQn=96`. mtvec set to mode 3 (vectored). mtvt CSR (0x7C0) set for T-Head extension. 1. **Item 7 -- Timer/oneshot compare mechanism likely incorrect**: `d13x_oneshot_start()` writes the target counter value to `GTC_CNTVL` (offset 0x008), which is the GTC counter *value* register, not a compare/match register. The D13x User Manual describes GTC as a free-running 52-bit counter without compare output. The CORET (IRQ 7) interrupt is sourced from the E907 core-local timer, whose compare register is accessed through different registers/CSRs. This implementation may not produce timer interrupts as intended, which would break `arch_alarm` / oneshot functionality.

2. **Item 8 -- I2C Fast Mode SCL low period marginally short**: `FS_SCL_LCNT=29` yields an actual SCL low period of (29+1)/24MHz = 1.25 us, which is 50 ns below the I2C specification minimum of 1.3 us for Fast Mode. While this matches the vendor's luban-lite reference and likely works with the GT911, it is technically non-compliant. Consider increasing LCNT to 30 or 31 for margin.

3. **Item 9 -- GPIO module clock enable potentially missing bit 8**: `d13x_clock_init()` sets bits 13+12 for GPIO clock but omits bit 8 (MOD_CLK_EN). Other peripherals (I2C, UART) set all three bits (13,12,8). If the GPIO controller requires its own module clock for register access, GPIO operations (used by GT911 touch reset/interrupt) could fail.

4. **Item 4 -- No pinmux configuration for UART0**: The BSP contains no pinmux setup code. If the BROM does not default UART0 pins to their alternate function, the serial console will be non-functional with no diagnostic output.

1: # 快速入门（Ubuntu）
2: 
3: [ [English](../../en/quickstart/openvela_ubuntu_quick_start.md) | 简体中文 ]
4: 
5: 本指南将指导您在 **Ubuntu 22.04** 操作系统上完成 openvela 的开发环境准备、源代码下载、编译构建，并最终通过 Vela Emulator 运行编译产物。
6: 
7: > **环境要求**
8: >
9: > 本文仅适配 **Ubuntu 22.04**。不支持在 Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) 或 Docker 容器环境中进行编译。
10: 
11: > **AI 辅助搭建（可选）**
12: >
13: > 如果您使用 AI 编程助手（如 [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code)），可以通过 openvela AI Skills 自动完成以下全部搭建流程：
14: >
15: > ```bash
16: > git clone https://github.com/open-vela/.claude.git .claude
17: > ```
18: >
19: > 然后告诉 AI 助手："帮我搭建 openvela 开发环境"。
20: >
21: > AI 将自动完成环境检测、依赖安装、代码源选择、源码下载、编译和模拟器启动，并在遇到问题时提供针对性的解决方案。
22: >
23: > 如需手动搭建，请继续阅读以下步骤。
24: 
25: ## 步骤一：准备工作
26: 
27: 在开始之前，请确保您的开发环境满足以下要求。
28: 
29: ### 1. 硬件要求
30: 
31: - **硬盘：** 至少 40 GB 可用空间，用于存放源代码和编译产物。
32: - **内存：** 至少 16 GB RAM。
33: 
34: ### 2. 操作系统要求
35: 
36: - **操作系统：** Ubuntu 22.04 (arm64/x86_64)
37: 
38: ### 3. 安装开发工具
39: 
40: 在开始之前，您需要安装编译 openvela 所需的软件包。
41: 
42: 打开终端，执行以下命令，更新软件包列表并安装 Git、curl、CMake、Python 3、libc++abi-dev 和 build-essential 工具链。
43: 
44: ```Bash
45: sudo apt update
46: sudo apt install git curl cmake python3 libc++abi-dev build-essential
47: ```
48: 
49: ### 4. 安装 Git LFS 组件
50: 
51: > **说明**：本项目包含大体积的二进制文件（如模型权重、数据集）。请务必配置 **Git LFS**，**否则拉取的文件将损坏（仅显示为几 KB 的指针文本）而无法运行**。
52: 
53: 请在 Ubuntu 终端中执行以下命令进行安装和初始化：
54: 
55: ```bash
56: # 第一步：配置官方源并安装 (确保获取最新版)
57: curl -s https://packagecloud.io/install/repositories/github/git-lfs/script.deb.sh | sudo bash
58: sudo apt-get install git-lfs
59: 
60: # 第二步：初始化配置 (重要：必须执行此步，否则 LFS 不会生效)
61: git lfs install
62: ```
63: 
64: ## 步骤二：下载源代码
65: 
66: openvela 使用 `repo` 工具管理其分布在多个 Git 仓库中的源代码。
67: 
68: ### 1. 安装 Repo 工具
69: 
70: `repo` 是一个构建于 Git 之上的代码库管理工具。执行以下命令来安全地下载并安装它。
71: 
72: ```Bash
73: curl -sSL "https://storage.googleapis.com/git-repo-downloads/repo" > repo
74: chmod +x repo
75: sudo mv repo /usr/local/bin
76: ```
77: 
78: 安装完成后，可运行 `repo --version` 进行验证。
79: 
80: ### 2. 初始化并同步代码库
81: 
82: 1. 创建一个工作目录，用于存放 openvela 的所有源代码。
83: 
84:     ```bash
85:     mkdir openvela && cd openvela
86:     ```
87: 
88: 2. 使用 `repo` 初始化项目清单，并指定 `dev` 分支。
89: 
90:     请根据您的网络环境和偏好，从以下任一平台选择一种方式（推荐使用 SSH）来初始化仓库。
91: 
92:     #### 选项 A：从 GitHub 下载
93: 
94:     - 方式一：SSH（推荐）
95: 
96:         此方式需要您先将 SSH 公钥添加至您的 GitHub 账户，请参考 [GitHub 官方文档](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh/adding-a-new-ssh-key-to-your-github-account)。

30: 
31: ## 提交方式
32:

38:

42: 
43: 本赛道作品在评分体系「技术难度」维度（30 分）中具备显著优势：

47: - 适配了全新架构（如 RISC-V、MIPS）或国产芯片平台

49: - 代码质量高、文档完整，可直接合入 openvela 主线
50: - 编写了详细的适配指南，方便后续开发者复现
51: 
52: ## 参考资源
53: 
54: | 资源                                                                                             | 说明                                                                                                 |

60: | [openvela 芯片移植指南](../../chip_porting/porting_guide.md)                                     | 完整的芯片移植流程                                                                                   |
61: | [openvela AI 驱动开发技能集](../../../../../../.claude/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/README_zh-cn.md) | AI 辅助驱动开发：`nuttx-driver-development` / `driver-code-reviewer` skill + `driver-workflow` agent |
62: 
63: ## AI 辅助开发（推荐）
64: 
65: 大赛鼓励使用 AI Coding 完成开发并沉淀有效 Skill。openvela 官方提供了一套面向驱动开发的 AI 技能集（位于 [`.claude`](../../../../../../.claude/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/README_zh-cn.md) 仓库），与本赛道高度契合，推荐配合使用：

1: # 最小可运行 NSH 系统 defconfig 参考
2: 
3: \[ [English](../../../../en/contest_2026/hardware_porting/defconfig_reference/minimum_nsh_baseline.md) | 简体中文 \]
4: 
5: 本文档面向「新硬件适配赛道」的开发者，目标是帮助开发者在自己的开发板上**先启动到 NSH 命令行提示符**。建议的工作流是：先以本文给出的最小集启动，验证串口与 NSH 工作正常后，再按需逐步打开文件系统、网络、传感器等子系统。
6: 
7: ## 一、概述
8: 
9: ### 1、文档目标
10: 
11: 参赛者拿到一块尚未适配 openvela 的开发板后，最关键的第一步是让系统能启动到 NSH 命令行提示符。本文档提供一份**最小**的 defconfig 参考，仅包含启动 NSH 所必需的配置项，便于参赛者：
12: 
13: - 快速判断哪些 CONFIG **必须修改**（与目标硬件强相关）；
14: - 哪些 CONFIG **可直接复用**（与硬件无关的运行时支持）；
15: - 完成 L0 启动后，按子系统顺序**增量启用**功能。
16: 
17: ### 2、推荐工作流
18: 
19: ```
20: Step 0: 硬件就绪
21:         - 目标芯片在 nuttx/arch/<arch>/src/<chip>/ 下已有支持
22:         - 板级目录已建立 (boards/<arch>/<chip>/<board>/)
23:         - 串口 TX/RX 引脚与上位机连通
24:         ↓
25: Step 1: 套用本文最小集 → 编译 → 烧录 → 串口看到 NSH 提示符
26:         ↓
27: Step 2: 按硬件能力增量启用子系统
28:         - 文件系统 (FAT / LittleFS)
29:         - 网络协议栈 (Ethernet / Wi-Fi)
30:         - 图形 (LCD / framebuffer / LVGL)
31:         - 传感 (uORB / I2C / SPI sensors)
32:         ↓
33: Step 3: 移植稳定后做 release 瘦身
34:         - 关闭 DEBUG_*、ALLSYMS 等调试项
35:         - 调整 stack size 至实测需求
36: ```
37: 
38: ## 二、最小 NSH 必需配置
39: 
40: 本节配置项参考 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32/nucleo-f303re/configs/nsh/defconfig`（35 行）整理而来，并参考了 Mateusz Szafoni 的 [NuttX small systems 系列文章](https://www.railab.me/tags/small-systems/) 对最小化裁剪的实践经验。
41: 
42: ### 1、架构与板级标识（必须按目标硬件替换）
43: 
44: ```
45: CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
46: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32"
47: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
48: CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32F303RE=y
49: CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="nucleo-f303re"
50: CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_NUCLEO_F303RE=y
51: ```
52: 
53: #### 替换原则
54: 
55: | 配置项 | 替换原则 |
56: | ---- | ---- |
57: | `CONFIG_ARCH=` | 目标 CPU 架构，例如 `"arm"`、`"arm64"`、`"risc-v"`、`"xtensa"` |

107: 
108: ### 5、调度与运行时支持（直接复用）
109: 
110: ```
111: CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200
112: CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y
113: CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4
114: CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048
115: CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0
116: CONFIG_START_DAY=27
117: CONFIG_START_YEAR=2013
118: ```
119: 
120: #### 配置项说明
121: 
122: - `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL=200`：轮转调度时间片为 200 ms。
123: - `CONFIG_SCHED_WAITPID=y`：启用 `waitpid()` 系统调用，NSH 在执行内置命令时依赖此特性。
124: - `CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=4`：预分配 4 个 POSIX 定时器，满足基础需求。
125: - `CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048`：idle 线程栈大小，2 KB 适用于多数 Cortex-M 板。RAM 紧张时可下调至 1024。
126: - `CONFIG_TASK_NAME_SIZE=0`：禁用任务名称字符串以节省 RAM。如需 `ps` 命令显示任务名，可设为 16~32。
127: - `CONFIG_START_DAY` 与 `CONFIG_START_YEAR`：系统启动时的初始日期，可任意填写。
128: 
129: ### 6、调试与诊断（强烈建议保留）
130: 
131: ```
132: CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y
133: CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
134: CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y
135: CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y
136: ```
137: 
138: #### 配置项说明
139: 
140: - `CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y`：保留调试符号，便于使用 GDB 单步调试与 backtrace 分析。
141: - `CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y`：系统出现 hardfault 时输出栈内容，移植阶段是定位问题的重要手段。
142: - `CONFIG_INTELHEX_BINARY=y` 与 `CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y`：编译后同时产出 `.hex` 与 `.bin` 两种烧录格式。
143: 
144: ### 7、CPU 特性裁剪（按需调整）
145: 
146: ```

148: ```
149: 
150: #### 说明
151: 
152: `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU` 控制硬件浮点单元的启用。Cortex-M4F、M7 等带 FPU 的内核如需使用浮点运算，应改为 `CONFIG_ARCH_FPU=y`。Cortex-M0/M3 无 FPU，保持注释状态即可。
153: 
154: ### 8、板级辅助（可选）

<skill_content name="openvela-utils">
# Skill: openvela-utils

# OpenVela Utils Skill

## Role
You are a utility assistant for OpenVela D13x project. You handle miscellaneous tasks that don't fit into porting, review, or build workflows. This includes environment setup, error troubleshooting, git operations, and managing user preferences.

## ⚠️ CRITICAL RULES

### Rule 1: Ask Before Storing Sensitive Info
**ALWAYS ask user permission before storing any private information** (tokens, passwords, keys, etc.). Never store without explicit consent.

### Rule 2: Use Memory System
**Store important user preferences and credentials in the memory system** so they persist across sessions.

### Rule 3: Check Memory First
**Before asking about something, check if it's already in memory.** Don't ask for information that's already stored.

### Rule 4: MUST Consult Documentation
If something is unclear, STOP and read documentation. Never guess.

---

## Task Categories

### 1. Environment Setup (环境配置)

**Use when:** Build fails due to missing tools, dependencies, or environment issues.

**Common tasks:**
- Check and install missing tools
- Set up toolchain paths
- Install Python dependencies
- Configure build environment

**Example workflow:**
```
Build 报错: "riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc: command not found"

1. Check if toolchain exists
2. Find toolchain location
3. Add to PATH or create symlink
4. Verify installation
```

### 2. Error Troubleshooting (错误排查)

**Use when:** Build, review, or runtime errors occur that aren't related to code changes.

**Common tasks:**
- Analyze build error logs
- Check system dependencies
- Verify tool versions
- Debug runtime issues

### 3. Git Operations (Git 操作)

**Use when:** User needs to manage git repository.

**Common tasks:**
- Check git status
- Create/switch branches
- Commit changes
- Push/pull code
- Resolve merge conflicts

**Example commands:**
```bash
git status
git checkout -b feature/touch-driver
git add .
git commit -m "Add GT911 touch driver"
git push origin feature/touch-driver
```

### 4. Tool Installation (工具安装)

**Use when:** Required tools are missing.

**Common tools:**
```bash
# RISC-V toolchain
sudo apt-get install gcc-riscv64-unknown-elf

# Python dependencies
pip3 install image Pillow

# Build tools
sudo apt-get install build-essential cmake ninja-build

# UnionFS
sudo apt-get install unionfs-fuse
```

### 5. User Preferences (用户偏好)

**Use when:** User wants to save settings for future sessions.

**Examples:**
- Preferred editor
- Build parallelism
- Notification settings
- Default paths

### 6. Credentials Management (凭证管理)

**Use when:** User needs to store private information.

**ALWAYS ask permission first:**
```
是否要将以下信息存储到记忆中，以便后续会话使用？

信息类型: GitHub Token
信息内容: **** (hidden)

存储位置: 全局记忆 (所有项目可用)

1. **是** - 存储到记忆
2. **否** - 不存储

请选择:
```

---

## Memory System Integration

### Store Information

**To store user preferences:**
```
memory({
  operation: "save",
  scope: "global",
  key: "openvela-preferences",
  content: {
    "build_parallelism": 8,
    "editor": "vim",
    "git_user": "username",
    "github_token": "****"
  }
})
```

### Retrieve Information

**To retrieve stored information:**
```
memory({
  operation: "get",
  scope: "global",
  key: "openvela-preferences"
})
```

### Memory Scopes

| Scope | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `global` | All projects, all sessions |
| `project` | Current project only |
| `session` | Current session only |

---

## Common Error Solutions

### 1. Toolchain Not Found
```bash
# Check if installed
which riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc

# Find location
find /usr -name "riscv*gcc" 2>/dev/null

# Add to PATH
export PATH=/path/to/toolchain/bin:$PATH

# Or create symlink
sudo ln -s /path/to/gcc /usr/local/bin/riscv32-unknown-elf-gcc
```

### 2. Python Dependencies Missing
```bash
# Check Python version
python3 --version

# Install required packages
pip3 install image Pillow pyelftools

# Or from requirements file
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

### 3. Permission Denied
```bash
# Make script executable
chmod +x script.sh

# Or run with bash
bash script.sh
```

### 4. Disk Space Issues
```bash
# Check disk space
df -h

# Clean build artifacts
make distclean

# Remove old images
rm -f vendor/artinchip/pack/prebuilt/*.img
```

### 5. Git Issues
```bash
# Check git status
git status

1: # 2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛
2: 
3: > 一文读懂本次大赛：赛道方向、参赛流程、开发资源，帮助你快速上手。
4: 
5: ## 大赛简介
6: 
7: 本届大赛面向全球开发者开放报名，基于 openvela（小米开源 AIoT 操作系统），**全程不设固定命题、不限创新方向**，支持选手自由发挥。
8: 
9: 赛事全程约 4 个月，设置线上初赛、线下决赛、现场颁奖盛典。无论你是独立开发者、创业团队、开源爱好者还是在校学生，均可参赛。
10: 
11: ## 参赛流程
12: 
13: > 从报名到获奖一文看懂：先看关键时间，再按步骤推进，每步详情见对应文档。
14: 
15: | 阶段                | 时间                    |
16: | ------------------- | ----------------------- |
17: | 报名 + 提交作品方向 | 6 月 8 日起（长期开放） |
18: | 提交作品            | 7 月 1 日 – 9 月 20 日  |
19: | 作品初评            | 9 月 21 日 – 9 月 30 日 |
20: | 决赛名单公示        | 10 月（待定）           |
21: | 线下决赛答辩        | 即将公布                |
22: | 线下颁奖典礼        | 即将公布                |
23: 
24: **具体每一步：**
25: 
26: 1. **报名 + 提交作品方向**（6 月 8 日起）→ 等待组委会审核。可通过 [报名审核状态查询表](https://rcna6b54jm72.feishu.cn/share/base/query/shrcnLw0VxcviyUZjkupxM0IrRc) 查询审核进度。
27: 2. **审核通过**：解锁权益——申领开发板、Xiaomi MiMo Token、嘉立创打样券，并扫码进官方交流群（详见下方「赋能支持」）。可通过 [权益发放状态查询表](https://rcna6b54jm72.feishu.cn/share/base/query/shrcnLtUdjLqXiNkTjSwV1nRaoX) 查询开发板、MiMo 账号充值、嘉立创打样券等发放情况。
28: 3. **拿到专属仓**：组委会按 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>` 为你创建 GitHub 专属仓库并开通 push 权限。仓库创建后请**及时登录 GitHub 接受协作邀请**（邀请默认 7 天内有效，过期需重新申请）。详见 [《参赛代码提交指南》](./code_submission_guide.md)。
29: 4. **拉取工程**：用组委会提供的 `repo init` + `repo sync` 一键拉取「openvela 全量源码 + 你的专属仓」。详见 [《参赛代码提交指南》](./code_submission_guide.md)。
30: 5. **开发**：选择你的赛道指引（见下方「三个赛道方向」），鼓励使用 AI Coding；只在专属仓子目录内开发。
31: 6. **部署验证**：在 openvela 模拟器 / 真机上运行验证（详见各赛道指引）。
32: 7. **归集 AI 日志**：将与 AI 的对话主动导出到专属仓 `logs/` 目录。详见 [《AI Coding 日志归集与提交手册》](./ai_coding_log_guide.md)。
33: 8. **提交作品**（截止 9 月 20 日）：fork 专属仓 → 开发 → PR → 自行 review 合入。详见 [《参赛代码提交指南》](./code_submission_guide.md)。
34: 9. **评审**：初评（9.21–9.30）→ 决赛名单公示 → 线下答辩 → 颁奖。
35: 10. **获奖后**：按要求将作品 PR 至 openvela 上游对应仓库的 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 分支（标准 PR + CI 流程）。详见 [《参赛代码提交指南》](./code_submission_guide.md) 第五节。
36: 
37: ## 关于 openvela
38: 
39: openvela 是小米开源的 AIoT 操作系统，专为轻量化、低功耗、AI 原生的智能硬件场景设计，已在智能手表、手环、音箱、耳机、机器人等亿级设备上落地验证。
40: 
41: 详细的技术架构、核心优势与快速入门，请参考：[openvela 项目介绍](../../README_zh-cn.md)
42: 
43: ## 三个赛道方向
44: 
45: 本次大赛提供三个参赛指引方向（**不作为独立赛道，仅为选题参考**，鼓励多方向组合开发）：
46: 
47: | 方向                           | 说明                                                                     | 详细指引                                                   |
